name: 405. Malá cena Monaka
description: The 405th Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running event taking place on November 22, 2026, in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The event is part of the Monaka race series and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to take part and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. Exact details about the course and registration are not yet available, but the race is popular with both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: A traditional local race in the heart of the Pardubice Region
A welcoming atmosphere and friendly setting
The opportunity to take part in various categories and at different performance levels
additional: The race is part of the Monaka series, which has a long tradition in the region. Exact information about registration and course distance has not yet been published.

name: Čertovskej wintertrail
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 111 Kč

description: Čertovskej wintertrail is a trail race through the hills, forests and rocky terrain around Hamr na Jezeře. The race offers two distances, 33.3 km and 16.6 km, and runners can switch between them free of charge. Participants can expect challenging winter conditions, several aid stations and an unforgettable experience on the “hellish” course. Both distances start together at 10:00, and the time limit is 7 hours. The entry fee includes timing, gifts and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: Trail running through hills, forests and rocky terrain
Two distances: 33.3 km and 16.6 km, with the option to switch free of charge
3 aid stations on the long course and 1 on the short course, plus refreshments at the finish
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The time limit is 7 hours, with cut-off times at the aid stations at km 15 (3 hours) and km 25 (5 hours). Runners must bring their own drinking cup; a Čertovskej running cup is available to buy at race registration. The entry fee includes pre-race refreshments (coffee, homemade cake), gifts in the race pack (sports socks), chip timing and split times, and food and drinks at the finish (soup, main course, beer, soft drink, mulled wine, tea). Marked course, aid stations, bring your own drinking cup, accommodation nearby, registration on Friday and Saturday before the race.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – listopadový
description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – November is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and the chance to share your experiences at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer; suitable for achieving the Czech Championships qualifying standard over 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The 10 km race starts at 14:00 and the 5 km race at 14:05. Check-in is open from 13:00 in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, as well as refreshments at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. The race takes place in November 2026; registration is probably through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

name: Mikulášský běh Zlín
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Zlín-Louky is a traditional running race held in beautiful surroundings along the Dřevnice River. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses on flat loops with crossings over small bridges and cycle paths. The event also includes a 1.5 km family fun run in costume, activities for children, and St. Nicholas and devils’ festivities. Runners receive a race pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant Advent atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete bridge and an iron footbridge
Flat loops around the football pitch in Zlín-Louky
additional: A 1.5 km family fun run in costume, with gingerbread as a reward at the finish. The race pack includes gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. A charity raffle for Krtek, with prizes sold and awarded during the event. 5 km and 10 km races, family and children’s runs, a charity event, start and finish by the football pitch in Zlín-Louky, a varied programme of activities, and a race pack

name: Výběh na Lovoš
location: Lovoš, Lovosice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run up Lovoš is a traditional uphill race held in Lovosice, in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a challenging trail run climbing to the summit of Lovoš, a popular destination for runners seeking a challenge and beautiful views. The start is on Lovošská Street, and the race is suitable for runners who want to try uphill running in a natural setting. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with registration available in advance or on site.
course_highlights: Off-road uphill run
Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging climb to the summit of Lovoš
additional: Luggage transport is available from 12:30 to 13:30. The vehicle carrying the bags departs at 13:30, so be sure to watch the departure time. The race is part of the Král středohoří sports event series. Registration is available in advance or on site. The start is at 14:00, and luggage departs at 13:30.

name: Stupenská sedmička
location: TJ Sokol Stupno, Stupno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč do neděle 25. 10. 2026 (platba předem na účet)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 250 Kč do neděle 22. 11. 2026 (platba předem na účet)

description: Stupenská sedmička is the sixth edition of a trail running race, taking place on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race features a 7.2 km loop running mostly along forest paths with very little asphalt, suitable for experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with extensive facilities and refreshments after the finish. The entry fee includes a finisher’s medal, timing, race photos, prizes, and a raffle. The race is open to all athletes, taking their health and abilities into account.
course_highlights: A 7.2 km loop running mostly along forest paths with very little asphalt
A forest trail with tree roots and several wooded hills
A road crossing supervised by a volunteer and a section along an MTB route
additional: The entry fee includes refreshments after the finish, including tea, water, mulled wine, beer, lemonade, homemade cakes, savory pastries, Christmas breads, bananas, and energy bars. Winners are announced and raffle prizes are drawn after the race. The race bib has a timing chip that must be returned after finishing (a 500 Kč fee applies if it is lost). Race facilities include toilets, changing rooms, and parking at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. Runners are advised to write any allergies and an emergency contact on the back of their race bib in case of medical complications. A medical professional will be present at the start and finish area. Registration, including gift vouchers; proceeds support charity; a detailed route description is available.

name: Stupenská sedmička
location: TJ Sokol Stupno, Stupno, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Stupenská sedmička is a trail running race held on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race features a 7.2 km loop, mostly on forest paths with very little asphalt, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The atmosphere is relaxed and friendly, with plenty of amenities, including refreshments, medals, timing, and a raffle. The course runs along forest trails, fields, and cycle paths, with several hills and road crossings monitored by volunteers.
course_highlights: A 7.2 km loop, mostly on forest paths with very little asphalt
Forest trail with tree roots and several hills
Road crossings monitored by volunteers, with part of the route on a cycle path
additional: The entry fee includes post-race refreshments (tea, water, mulled wine, beer, lemonade, homemade cakes, savoury pastries, Christmas bread, bananas, and bars), a finisher’s medal, course marking, timing, race photos, prizes for the winners, and a raffle. Runners attend a briefing and course description before the start; the awards ceremony and raffle draw take place after the race. The race is also suitable for complete beginners and children. The sixth edition takes place on November 28, 2026. The first category starts at 10:00.

name: Pražská stovka
location: Milín, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Pražská stovka is a traditional winter long-distance hike and ultratrail race with a history dating back to 1994. The event takes place on a challenging route with significant elevation gain and distinctive winter conditions, bringing together runners, long-distance hikers, and enthusiasts of extreme trekking each year. The main Route A starts in Český Brod at midnight on Friday and finishes in Prague. The race is known for its friendly, supportive atmosphere, where helping one another matters more than rivalry, and it brings elite ultrarunners together with enthusiastic long-distance hikers.
course_highlights: Main Route A: 130 km with +4400 m elevation gain
Starts in Český Brod at midnight on Friday and finishes in Prague
Challenging terrain and winter conditions with significant elevation gain
additional: Luggage transport between the start in Český Brod and the finish in Prague is provided; only closed and labelled luggage is accepted. At the finish, warm showers, a gym for sleeping in your own sleeping bag and on your own sleeping mat, and light refreshments are available. It is recommended that participants have completed at least one off-road event of over 50 km as a qualifying recommendation. The start is accessible by PID suburban trains from Prague. Pražská stovka is the final stage of the EKUT 2026 series.

name: Vánoční večerní běh Líbeznice
location: Areál ZŠ a ZUŠ Líbeznice, Líbeznice, Czech Republic
description: The Christmas Evening Run in Líbeznice is a traditional sporting event held at the ZŠ and ZUŠ Líbeznice grounds. The run is paired with a competition for the best Christmas strudel, adding a festive atmosphere and a sense of community. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable experience in the lead-up to Christmas. It is organised by Monika Šponerová and takes place on Friday, 4 December 2026.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km long
Gently undulating terrain with both paved and off-road surfaces
Part of the route is unlit; a headlamp was mandatory in previous editions
additional: The event takes place at the ZŠ and ZUŠ Líbeznice grounds. It is paired with a competition for the best Christmas strudel. The event takes place at the ZŠ and ZUŠ Líbeznice grounds. The event also includes a competition for the BEST strudel.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Prague–Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail race held on 5 December 2026. The event offers three distances: 42 km with an individual start, and 21 km and 10 km with mass starts. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník, through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation ranging from 125 to 593 metres. Runners can use baggage transport from the start to the finish. Overall winners and age- and gender-based category winners are announced. The event is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m of elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník; finish in Kytín
Baggage transport for runners from the start to the finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start; the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. The 42 km course has aid stations at kilometres 10, 16, 27 and 33, and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish area. Runners take part at their own risk and must take extra care when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Online registration is available, along with course maps and information about race categories.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: The Mikulášský běh Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. It attracts local runners and visitors, who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Exact details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sporting calendar and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sporting calendar. Results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is a precisely measured asphalt loop; the children's course is 800 m long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. You can start by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11.

name: Mikulášský běh Olomouc
description: The Mikuláš Run in Olomouc is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The club specializes in promoting endurance running and organizes a number of races in the region. The race is part of a rich running tradition and is suitable for the general public as well as ambitious competitors.
course_highlights: 8.8 km course for men and 5.9 km course for women
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Traditional race in a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on December 5, 2026. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and on-site registration is also available.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race has a friendly atmosphere and encourages everyone to enjoy running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After the finish, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful setting in the Royal Game Reserve – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate (below the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age-adjustment coefficient used for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage facility, and toilet cabins are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. 3.2 km course, road surface, registration is voluntary, and running without a bib is permitted.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held on Ještěd at the ski jump venue. The race offers a challenging 22 km royal course with 1,180 metres of elevation gain, bringing the 2025 skyrunning season to a close. Shorter courses and children’s races are also available, making the event accessible to a wide range of runners. The atmosphere is rounded out by the winners’ presentation and an accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Winter SkyRace® royal course: 22 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children’s races: 200 m, 500 m and 1,200 m
additional: The winners’ presentation starts at 15:30. Canicross races are also available over the same distances as the main courses. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple courses, children’s races, canicross, registration, race equipment and refreshments

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace® is a trail-running race held on the Ještěd Ridge in the Liberec Region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery, appealing to both experienced runners and fans of mountain running. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and extensive accompanying program, including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: Veleslavín běží
location: Přerost a Švorc, Veleslavín, Prague 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Veleslavín běží is a 7.2 km run through the Veleslavínka Valley, past Libocký Pond in Prague 6. It takes place on December 5, 2026, at the Přerost a Švorc grounds. The race is part of the Běhej s námi 2026 series and offers events for children and adults. Children’s races of 100 m to 1,500 m, depending on age, take place in the morning, followed by the main adults’ race in the afternoon. The field is limited to 200 runners, and the race bib is also valid for other races in the series. The route runs mainly along park and field paths, with one more pronounced climb beyond the pond.
course_highlights: The 7.2 km route runs through the Veleslavínka Valley, past Libocký Pond
Mostly park and field paths with gravel and dirt, plus short sections of asphalt
One more pronounced climb of about 25 m of elevation gain beyond the pond
additional: The race bib with timing chip is also valid for other races in the Běhej s námi 2026 series. The field is limited to 200 runners. Check-in and bib pickup close 30 minutes before the start. Parking is included in the entry fee. Running with a dog is not permitted. There is no time limit. The adults’ race starts at 13:00, and the children’s races begin at 11:00. Online entry costs 200 Kč for adults; children can enter free of charge. Entry on the day costs 300 Kč for adults and 100 Kč for children. Check-in closes no later than 30 minutes before the start. Adults must be at least 15 years old to compete; running with a dog is not permitted.

name: Christmas Run Olomouc
location: Výstaviště Flora, pavilion E, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Christmas Run Olomouc is an atmospheric night run taking place on 5 December 2026 in Olomouc at Výstaviště Flora. It offers three race courses: the 5 km INTERSPORT CHRISTMAS RUN, the 2 km Fénix Run charity race, and the 1 km non-competitive NN KIDS CHRISTMAS RUN for children. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants may start only with written consent from a legal guardian. The programme also includes warm-ups with Santa and an awards ceremony. The event is organized by EVENT media s.r.o.
course_highlights: The 5 km INTERSPORT CHRISTMAS RUN course in the nighttime setting of Olomouc
The 2 km Fénix Run charity race
The 1 km non-competitive NN KIDS CHRISTMAS RUN for children
additional: Registration is valid only once the entry fee has been credited to the organizer’s account. Once race capacity is reached, no further registration is possible, either online or on site. Children under 15 must have written consent from a legal guardian. The race pack includes a bag with gifts from the event’s partners. The main race is intended for runners aged 12 and over; participants under 15 need written consent from a legal guardian. The children’s run is non-competitive, and children may run with their parents. The main race has a capacity of 1,000 runners.

name: Běh na 2 míle – Praha, Stromovka
location: Bruselská brána, Královská obora-Stromovka, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for the general public. The course follows paved paths through the beautiful Královská obora – Stromovka Park. Adults run two laps, while children up to 12 years old run one. The race is usually held on the first Saturday of every month, with an exact start time of 9:07. Every participant’s time is recorded, and results are published online. The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which recognizes performances adjusted using an age coefficient.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Beautiful setting in Královská obora – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area beneath the Marold Panorama building from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage service, and toilet cubicles are available. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is recommended by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate beneath the Marold Panorama building; online registration is also available.

name: Mikulášský vodácký půlmaraton
location: Eliščino nábřeží, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Hradec Králové, oddíl rychlostní kanoistiky a Vodní Sporty Hradec Králové, z. s.
price_range: 300–400 Kč; štafeta 500 Kč; dětské tratě a registrovaní vodáci zdarma

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 5 km a 10 km: 300 Kč, půlmaraton: 300 Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné smíšené štafety 4x5 km 500 Kč, pouze předem

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Mikuláš Water Sports Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Hradec Králové on Eliščino Embankment by the Elbe River. The race offers 5, 10 and 21 km distances, including a 4 x 5 km relay and children’s races over 400 and 800 metres. The course runs mainly along the Elbe Trail on mostly paved surfaces and is suitable for men, women and water sports enthusiasts. The start is always at 10:00 on the first Saturday in December, and participants can expect refreshments along the course and at the finish. The 50th anniversary edition will also include a small commemorative gift for participants.
course_highlights: Out-and-back course along the Elbe Trail, mostly on paved surfaces (asphalt, concrete, approximately 1 km of dirt)
Refreshment stations every 5 km on the 10 km and half-marathon courses
Start and finish on Eliščino Embankment by the Elbe River in central Hradec Králové
additional: The adult races are limited to 200 participants; on-site registration is available only for the children’s races. Race numbers bearing participants’ names are sent to those who pay in advance by 2 December 2026. On-course and finish refreshments include water, electrolyte drinks, tea and bananas. Water sports participants registered with the canoeing association can enter for free by listing their club as “water sports participant(s).” The half marathon has a time limit of 3.5 hours. Race facilities are at the Sokol Hradec Králové building; registration is through Sport-Base.cz.

name: Běh na 2 míle, Zlín – Příluky
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and covers just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake. Categories are divided by age and gender, with times recorded and prizes awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are Men (ages 13–127), Women (ages 13–127), Boys (up to 12 years) and Girls (up to 12 years); age categories remain the same throughout the calendar year. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The top three finishers in the men’s, women’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. The men’s course record is 9:31.8. Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building from 8:15 to 8:55, and the main race starts at 9:00. Times are recorded for all participants, and the top three in the women’s, men’s and children’s categories receive small prizes. Runners can look forward to a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish.

name: Adventní běh Žatec
location: Náměstí Svobody, Žatec, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Advent Run in Žatec is a traditional pre-Christmas race held through the city’s historic centre, starting at Svobody Square. The race offers various categories for men, women, youth and children, with distances ranging from 330 metres to 6.6 km. Every participant receives a medal and a cup of mulled wine at the finish, adding to the festive Advent atmosphere. Registration begins at 14:00, and the main races start from 15:55. The event is organised by the Hopman Triathlon team, which puts on events for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A 2,200 m loop through Žatec’s historic centre
Men run 3 loops (6,600 m); women and male youth runners run 2 loops (4,400 m)
Children’s and school-age races cover 330 m and 1,000 m
additional: Registration from 14:00; the first children’s races start from 15:15, and the main adult categories start from 15:55.

name: Adventní běh pro zdraví
location: Městský úřad Hodonín, Hodonín, Czech Republic
description: The Advent Run for Health is a traditional running event organized by Běžecký klub Hodonín, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the community. The race takes place in the center of Hodonín, by the Municipal Office, and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and ability levels. The club has a long history of organizing running competitions and supports the development of distance running in the region. The event is part of a wider running calendar and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the Municipal Office in Hodonín
The route runs through an urban setting on a pleasant surface
Friendly atmosphere and support for a healthy lifestyle
additional: The organizer is Běžecký klub Hodonín, which has a long-standing tradition. The club also organizes other running events in the region. Contact details for the club's chairman, Pavel Bíl, are listed on the website. Results from previous editions and information about other races in the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of Hodonín District are available on the website. In the 2025 edition, the first category started at 10:30; results are published on the Běžecký klub Hodonín website.

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Malá cena Velké Verandy is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Choceň. The race is 4,300 metres long and follows forest roads and trails, with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain. The course is marked with ribbons and includes a short stretch of asphalt. The race is also the Jirka Švadlena Memorial and is popular with runners looking for challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 m along forest roads and trails
Hilly profile with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Course marked with ribbons, approximately 400 m of asphalt
additional: The race includes approximately 400 m of asphalt and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting. It is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners earning points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00, and the start is by the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) route through Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A race suitable for all ages and running abilities
Picturesque park setting, with the fountain as the starting point
additional: The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is run on an asphalt course, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the event is part of a series of runs in Olomouc with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
location: Smetanovy sady fountain, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. Everyone competes primarily against themselves and runs for the enjoyment of it. The race takes place in the scenic Smetana Gardens, by the fountain in Olomouc. It also includes a cup competition, in which results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens, by the fountain
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Cup competition with points calculated using an age coefficient
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 on race day. The top three finishers are announced in each category.

name: Čertovský běh Damníkov
location: ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov, Damníkov, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 100 Kč, přihlásit se lze jen v den závodu při prezentaci.

description: Čertovský běh Damníkov is a traditional road race uphill from Damníkov to Anenská Studánka in the Lanškroun region, held since 1984. The 4 km course follows an asphalt road with about 150 metres of elevation gain and a challenging uphill profile, especially in the second half. The race is part of the ISCAREX POHÁR 2026 series and is suitable for the general public, including junior categories. The start is at ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov and the finish is at the cultural centre in Anenská Studánka, where refreshments and the awards ceremony are provided.
course_highlights: 4 km asphalt course with approximately 150 m of elevation gain
The climb becomes steeper after the railway crossing
The route runs from Damníkov to Anenská Studánka; in December, there may be snow or icy conditions
additional: Race-day check-in takes place from 9:00 to 10:10 in the ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov building. Changing rooms are available at both the start and finish. Refreshments and the awards ceremony are provided at the finish. Anenská Studánka railway stop is on the route about 1.2 km before the finish, making it easier to return after the race. According to the available information, registration takes place on race day during check-in at the ZŠ a MŠ Damníkov building; winter weather may affect the course surface.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow trails with stunning views and varied terrain, often near nature reserves and historical sites. The series is suitable for experienced runners and beginners alike, and aims to encourage regular running. Most starts are at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails with views of the Berounka River and the Český kras Protected Landscape Area
Challenging climbs and nature reserves, such as Klapice and Radotínské skály
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs
additional: Refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race bibs are available at the race venues. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. Rankings are based on the 10 highest-scoring races in the series. Most starts are near train stations and at local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races in the Berounka area; starts mostly accessible by train; winners announced in December; 12 categories; scoring based on the 10 best races

name: Prosincový běh Smetanovými sady Olomouc
location: Hudební pavilon, Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The December Run through Smetana Gardens in Olomouc is a 6.55 km race on a 1.3 km asphalt loop in the beautiful surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Running League and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a run in a pleasant urban park. The route is suitable for fast running on asphalt and is ideal for winter running outdoors near the city center.
course_highlights: 6.55 km race on a 1.3 km asphalt loop
The loop runs through the picturesque Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Part of the Olomouc Running League

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Mikulášský běh Petřkovice
location: Stadion MK Seitl, Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Mikulášský běh Petřkovice is a traditional race held in the village of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is part of the District Running League and welcomes runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the run-up to Christmas. Exact race distances and registration details have not yet been announced, but the race is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with a community experience and celebrate the approaching Christmas season in an active way.
course_highlights: Part of the District Running League
Traditional pre-Christmas atmosphere
Suitable for runners of all levels
additional: The race takes place on December 12, 2026, near the MK Seitl stadium in Petřkovice, and is part of the regional running calendar.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: CHRISTMAS RUN Praha
location: Rudolfinum, náměstí Jana Palacha, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Christmas Run Prague is an experiential 5 km night run held in the center of Prague in front of the Rudolfinum. The event is part of the INTERSPORT Christmas Run series and also features a children’s race and the charitable Fénix Run. The run is accompanied by a festive Christmas atmosphere, a warm-up with Santa, and the option to purchase a red “SANTA” hat. The race is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants may start with written consent from a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The course runs through the center of Prague in front of the Rudolfinum
A night run with a Christmas atmosphere and a warm-up with Santa
Option to purchase a red “SANTA” hat as part of the event
additional: People aged 12 and over may register; those under 15 may participate only with written consent from a legal guardian. Registration is valid only once the entry fee has been credited to the organizer’s account. No further registration is possible once race capacity is reached. The race package includes a bag with gifts from event partners. The children’s run is 1 km long, and children may run with their parents. The Fénix Run is 2 km long, and its proceeds support nonprofit organizations. Participants in the main race receive a medal at the finish.

name: Běh okolo náměšťského zámku
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Náměšť Castle is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the chance to experience the beauty of the area around Náměšť na Hané. The club specializes in recreational and competitive running and organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of Central Moravia’s running events and welcomes runners of all levels who want to test themselves in a picturesque setting. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and support for the running community.
course_highlights: The area around Náměšť na Hané, with views of the castle
A traditional endurance race in the Olomouc Region
Picturesque natural and historic surroundings
additional: In the previous edition, the start was at the KVS Náměšť na Hané grounds; the date and location for the 2026 edition have not been confirmed in the available information.

name: Christmas Run Most
location: 1. náměstí, Most, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: Hlavní závod 650–900 Kč; dětský běh 200–400 Kč; Fénix Run 250–300 Kč
description: Christmas Run Most is an atmospheric night run taking place on 13 December 2026 in the centre of Most. It offers three race options: the 5 km main race, the 2 km Fénix Run charity race, and a 1 km non-competitive children’s run. The event also features a warm-up with Santa and a festive awards ceremony. The race is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants may take part only with written consent from a legal guardian. The event is organised by EVENT media s.r.o.
course_highlights: Night run in the centre of Most
Main course: 5 km (2 × 2.5 km laps)
2 km Fénix Run charity race and 1 km children’s run
additional: Registration is valid only once the entry fee has been credited to the organiser’s account. No further registrations are possible once the race capacity has been reached. Children under 15 must have written consent from a legal guardian. The race pack includes a bag with gifts from the event’s partners. The main race has a capacity of 1,000 runners. The children’s run is non-competitive, and children may run with their parents. Participants in the main race receive a medal; proceeds from the Fénix Run and voluntary contributions support non-profit organisations.

name: Trailová Závist
location: TJ Sokol Zvole clubhouse, Hlavní 197, 252 45 Zvole, Czech Republic
description: Trailová Závist is a running race across three valleys in an area of rugged slopes and steep-sided ravines above the Vltava River. The approximately 17.3 km course runs through deep forests and combines challenging climbs, technical descents, and running sections with beautiful views. The race is open to runners of all abilities and is included among the UTMB Index Races, allowing participants to earn a 20 km Index. The start and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Zvole clubhouse, which also provides baggage storage and refreshments after the finish. After the race, participants receive soup, a medal, and a pin, all included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: The course crosses rugged slopes and steep-sided ravines above the Vltava River
Challenging climbs and technical descents, with a mix of asphalt, gravel, mud, and leaves
Beautiful views and running through deep forests with a Celtic historical backdrop
additional: The race is limited to 250 starters. Race numbers can also be purchased on site until 9:30. The entry fee includes a timing chip on loan, refreshments at the finish (soup), a medal, and a pin. After the race, outdoor seating and the clubhouse are available as shelter from bad weather. There are no showers or heated changing rooms. Entries can be transferred to another person until 11.12.2026 12:00 via sportovniservis.cz. T-shirts, hoodies, and caps featuring the race design are also available for purchase. The entry fee includes a timing chip on loan, refreshments at the finish, soup, a finisher’s medal, and a pin. The race is limited to 250 runners.

name: Běh cyklistů
location: Novoveská ulice, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh cyklistů is a challenging cross-country race in Prague’s Jinonice district, taking runners over hilly terrain on forest and meadow paths. The race offers 6 km and 3 km courses; in previous editions, the longer course was for men and the shorter one for women, juniors, and veterans. Expect a fast-paced off-road race with repeated climbs and steep descents.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course on forest and meadow paths.
A loop course with sharp climbs and steep descents.
Two course distances: 6 km and 3 km.
additional: Race facilities are on Novoveská Street in Prague-Jinonice.

name: Adventní charitativní běh Kuňka
location: Ráby, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic

location: Bistro U Vlka, Hradec Králové Municipal Forests, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic

tiers.description: 1. vlna – prvních 50 přihlášek: 600 Kč za individuální závod / 1 000 Kč za štafetu

description: The Christmas Half Marathon in Hradec Králové is a traditional winter running race held in the city’s forests near the U Vlka refreshment stand. The race offers an individual half marathon and three-person mixed relays, with each runner covering a 7 km leg. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish, and prizes are awarded to the top runners. The event has a friendly atmosphere and promotes a healthy lifestyle and the local sporting community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city’s forests in Hradec Králové
Three-person mixed relay with 7.0325 km legs
Refreshments on the course and at the finish
additional: Registration and race number pickup take place from 9:15 to 10:15. Entry is valid only after the entry fee has been paid. Categories are divided by age and weight, including the special Santa Claus category (over 100 kg) and Three Kings category (over 200 kg). Bistro U Vlka will be open throughout the event; refreshments will also be available at the finish.

name: 406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
description: Malá cena Monaka - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Malá cena Monaka series and gives runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. It is organized by KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: A traditional Christmas run in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany
A friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization
Part of the long-running Malá cena Monaka series
additional: The race takes place on 20 December 2026 in Slatiňany, Pardubice Region, and is part of the Malá cena Monaka series. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Vánoční běh Opava
description: The Opava Christmas Run is a traditional running race organized by the BěhOpava association team. The race covers a 4.7 km course starting on Englišova Street and heading toward Gappay (Latarna) along a farm track with an asphalt surface, with several turns before returning to the finish. Kilometer markers are placed along the course to help runners track their performance. The race is open to various age categories, from pupils to men across several age groups. The organizers provide small prizes for the top runners and hold a prize draw for additional prizes.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course along a farm track with an asphalt surface
Kilometer markers along the course for orientation
Start and finish by Englišova Street – the gate of the School Farm
additional: The course record is held by Petr Gebel, set in 1994 with a time of 13:39. Participants race at their own risk and are advised to take care when crossing roads and follow the organizers’ instructions. The finish judges are members and supporters of the BěhOpava association. The race takes place on an asphalt course with a slight uphill section, starts at the School Farm, and includes small prizes and a commemorative run.

name: Vánoční kros v Bělském lese
location: Areál zdraví, Bělský les, Ostrava-Zábřeh, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Christmas Cross-Country Race in Bělský les invites runners to enjoy the natural surroundings of Ostrava’s forest park. Participants can choose between 3 km and 6 km courses, combining a sawdust track with forest paths. The start and race facilities are at Areál zdraví in Ostrava-Zábřeh. The race is part of the Drahomír Gromotovič and Bohumil Prauzek Memorial.
course_highlights: The routes follow both the sawdust track and the forest paths of Bělský les.
Choose between 3 km and 6 km courses.
The start and finish facilities are located at Areál zdraví.

name: Vánoční běh v Ďáblickém háji
location: Ďáblický háj, Praha 8, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Christmas Run in Ďáblický háj is a non-competitive running event held at the health area in Ďáblický háj in Prague 8. The course consists of two loops through Ďáblický Forest. It is mostly flat, with one gentle hill, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event traditionally takes place on 24 December, with the first category starting at 10:00. It is organised by AVC Praha and is free of charge, fostering a friendly, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two loops through Ďáblický Forest
Flat terrain with one gentle hill
Woodland setting in the health area
additional: This is a non-competitive event. The start is at the health area in Ďáblický háj, and the run is free of charge. It is organised by AVC Praha. Contact: Zdeněk Weig, tel. 733 690 323. The course is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place on Christmas Eve, 24 December 2026, at the health area in Ďáblický háj.

name: Štědrodenní běh Jilešovicemi
location: Penzion Kamenec, Jilešovice, Háj ve Slezsku, Czech Republic
organizer: Maraton klub Seitl Ostrava a Sbor dobrovolných hasičů Jilešovice
description: The Štědrý Day Run through Jilešovice is a traditional Christmas running race organized by Maraton klub Seitl Ostrava and the Jilešovice Volunteer Fire Brigade. The race takes place on December 24 in the village of Jilešovice, near Háj ve Slezsku, and features a course approximately 4 km long, running from Jilešovice to Kozmice and back across the footbridge over the Opavice River. The start is in front of Penzion Kamenec, which also hosts registration and the finish. Shorter courses are prepared for children according to their age and the number of participants. Refreshments are provided after the race, including beer, non-alcoholic drinks, soup, and Christmas punch. The results are announced, and a raffle is held with valuable prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs from Jilešovice to Kozmice and back along the cycle path
Crossing the footbridge over the Opavice River
Approximate course length: 4 km
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:50 at Penzion Kamenec. Children start at 10:30. The maximum number of starters is 120. The first 100 runners to finish receive a commemorative medal. A raffle will be held among participants, with a trekking bicycle as the main prize. The entry fee is paid on site. Runners participate at their own risk. Race facilities are at Penzion Kamenec in Jilešovice.

name: Štěpánský běh Prachatice
description: The St. Stephen’s Run in Prachatice is a traditional sporting event being held for the 44th time, open to everyone from children to veterans. The morning program begins with children’s and youth categories. The 10 km main race and 5 km hobby race start at 11:00. The route follows paved roads, with an elevation gain of 176 metres on the main course and 68 metres on the hobby course. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice and is part of the 2025 South Bohemian Running Cup.
course_highlights: 10 km main course with an elevation gain of 176 metres
5 km hobby race with an elevation gain of 68 metres
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available to runners in the stadium stand, and refreshments (tea and pastries) are provided at the finish. Race numbers and timing chips are issued during check-in and must be returned to the organizers after the race. Trophies, prizes in kind, and cash bonuses for breaking the course record are awarded to the top finishers. The first 100 participants in the main races to register and pay will receive gifts from sponsors. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses. Registration is available via maraton.cz, and showers, refreshments, and facilities for runners are provided.

name: Štěpánský kros pro děti všech kategorií a Lidový běh
location: Svitavy, Svitavy District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: The Štěpánský Cross-Country Race for children of all age groups and the People’s Run is an open running event held in Svitavy, with courses for children and adults on a mixed asphalt and grass surface. The race is suitable for all age groups, from the youngest children running 100 metres to adults taking part in the 4,200-metre People’s Run. The event takes place in all weather and offers a sporting atmosphere and support for all participants. Registration is available online, by email or on site on race day.
course_highlights: Mixed course surface: asphalt and grass
Categories for children aged 4 and up, as well as adults
Adults’ 4,200 m People’s Run (2 × the large loop)
additional: On-site check-in runs from 8:45 to 9:45; children’s categories must check in by 9:30. Changing rooms are available in the stadium stand, but they are public and the organizers are not responsible for items left there. Entries can be submitted electronically by 23. 12. 2025, by email, using a QR code or in person on race day. The course has a mixed surface—both asphalt and grass; registration is available online or on site; there are different course lengths for different age groups; changing rooms are available; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Štěpánský běh Zlín
location: Příluk u Zlína, Zlín, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma (dětské běhy), ceny za dospělé od 300 Kč výše
description: The St. Stephen’s Run in Zlín is a traditional running race organized by the Běhy Zlín association in Příluky. The 10 km main race consists of three laps and starts at the football field at 10 a.m. The event also includes free children’s races, held after the main race. The race offers rewards for adult runners and original medals for category winners. It attracts runners from the wider area and is part of the Běhy Zlín series.
course_highlights: 10 km main course consisting of three laps
Around the football grounds in Příluky
Children’s races after the main race
additional: The awards ceremony takes place at 11:45 at the race registration area. Category winners receive original medals and, where applicable, non-cash prizes. Children’s races are free, with a small reward for every child and no winners’ awards ceremony. The race is part of the Christmas season celebrations, with the awards ceremony at 11:45, and offers various categories and prizes for winners. The event takes place around the football grounds in Příluky and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Vánoční běh Třtice
description: The Třtice Christmas Run is a traditional running race held annually on December 26 in the village of Třtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 4.8 km long, with categories based on age and gender. This popular sporting event continues a long-standing tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area. It is part of the village’s sporting activities and offers a pleasant atmosphere for athletes and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 4.8 km course
Categories by age and gender: A (up to 39 years), B (40–49 years), C (50–59 years), D (over 60 years), E (women)
Traditional Christmas run held since 1976
additional: The race uses the same categories as the summer Třtická Punčocha run. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the village website. Třtice offers sports facilities, including a children’s playground and a multi-purpose sports court. The race takes place on December 26, 2026, and is attended by approximately 200 runners. The course is around 4.8 km long, with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for the general public and fosters a festive Christmas sporting atmosphere.

name: Vánoční maraton, půlmaraton a desítka okolo Boleváku
description: The Christmas Marathon, Half Marathon and 10K around Bolevák is a winter trail run taking place on December 26, 2026, in the picturesque northern outskirts of Plzeň. This race is not about breaking personal records, but about enjoying a beautiful experience, a festive atmosphere and the pleasure of exercising together in a winter landscape. Participants can choose from three distances and enjoy the crisp winter air and the peaceful energy of nature. Race bibs are available from 8:40 a.m., and parking is provided near the start and finish.
course_highlights: A winter trail run in the picturesque northern outskirts of Plzeň
A loop with kilometre markers from 1 to 10 km
Parking near the start and finish at the intersection of Gerská and Ke Krkavci streets
additional: Check-in and race-bib collection start at 8:40 a.m. Slower marathon runners may start at 9:00 a.m. Parking is available at the intersection of Gerská and Ke Krkavci streets, with space for at least 50 cars.

location: Kyjov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

location: Severní předměstí, Plzeň, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic

name: Vánoční běh Hlučínem
location: Mírové náměstí, Hlučín, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: (Před)Silvestrovský běh Lysá nad Labem
location: Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Lysá nad Labem is a traditional race organized by the Sokol Lysá nad Labem sports association. Held at the end of December, it attracts runners who want to enjoy a sporting activity during the winter. After a two-year hiatus, the race is once again looking forward to welcoming participants, who can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and a sporting challenge in Lysá nad Labem. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and promotes physical fitness and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: The course runs along the city streets of Lysá nad Labem, including the town center
Routes of 6.2 km and 3.1 km are available
The race is part of a traditional year-end celebration with a Christmas-season atmosphere
additional: The race starts and finishes in Lysá nad Labem. It is a traditional annual event that promotes sporting activity in the community.

name: Hraběnčino běhání – memoriál Jaroslava Parmy
location: Petrovice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hraběnčino běhání - Jaroslav Parma Memorial is a traditional running race held in Petrovice in the South Moravian Region. The race is part of the Blansko District Running League, which has a long-standing tradition dating back to 1976. The course is demanding, with a challenging profile that tests the fitness of all participants. The race is ideal for runners looking for a challenge in the picturesque surroundings of the Moravian Karst.
course_highlights: The course profile is very demanding and tests physical fitness
The route runs through the Moravian Karst, with beautiful natural scenery
The climb below Karolín is a key and challenging section of the course
additional: The race is part of the Blansko District Running League, which also offers other running events in the region. The course is known for its difficulty and long-standing tradition. The start and finish are in Petrovice at Penzion u Hraběnky. Timing is done with chips embedded in the OBL race bibs.

name: Silvestrovský běh ulicemi města Soběslavi
description: The New Year’s Eve run through the streets of Soběslav is a traditional race for all age groups, including children and seniors. The main race starts at midnight, and its distance increases by one metre each year; this year it is 2026 metres. A rich cultural programme is held in the square during the race, and refreshments are provided for all participants. Winners in each category receive prizes.
course_highlights: The route is 2026 metres long and increases by one metre each year
The race runs through the streets of Soběslav
The run is accompanied by a rich cultural programme in the square
additional: The youth categories start at 21:00, and the main race starts at midnight. Winners in each category receive prizes. The youth categories start at 21:00 and the main race at midnight. Winners in the categories receive prizes.

name: Silvestrovský běh Jistebnice
location: Jistebnice, Jistebnice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: SPOLEK PRO SPORT VŠEHO DRUHU a Město Jistebnice
description: The Jistebnice New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race organized by the Association for Sports of All Kinds and the town of Jistebnice, held every year on New Year’s Eve. In 2025, the event will celebrate its 43rd edition. This popular event also includes a scooter race and children’s races. The race takes place in full road traffic, with organizers assisting at key intersections, and offers a sporting experience for the general public. The organizers warmly invite all sports enthusiasts to take part and wish them an enjoyable experience and a great start to the new year.
course_highlights: The race takes place in full road traffic, with organizers assisting at key points and intersections
The event also includes scooter races and children’s races
A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a long history (43rd edition)
additional: By registering, participants confirm that they are fit to complete the race and acknowledge the health risks. The organizer accepts no liability for health-related injuries. The race is part of the wider SPSVD Jistebnice sporting calendar and is accompanied by other sporting and cultural events. races, routes, schedule, facilities, start, health warning, road traffic

name: Silvestrovský běh Hrabovou
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Hrabová is a traditional race held at the end of the year in Ostrava-Hrabová. It gives participants the chance to end the year with some exercise in a friendly atmosphere. The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Hrabová and are suitable for a range of ability levels. The race is part of the Hrabová Runs series and is known for its long-standing tradition and community spirit.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Ostrava-Hrabová
A range of course distances suitable for runners of varying abilities
The race is part of the traditional Hrabová Runs series
additional: The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available after the race. Photos and videos are taken to promote the event. Participants can find relay partners and take part in the New Year’s Eve relay. The event takes place every year on 31 December. Participants can choose from various categories and courses, and registration is available on the website.

name: Silvestrovský běh okolo 3 přehrad
location: Jablonec nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
