description: The Silvester Run Around 3 Dams is a relaxed race held on the last day of the year in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route goes around three Jablonec dams and is approximately 5 km long. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere at the end of the year. Gifts are prepared for those who register in advance, and the winners receive interesting prizes from the partners.
course_highlights: The route goes around three dams in Jablonec nad Nisou
The route is 5 km long
Start and finish at the Volt Brewery grounds
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the start location from 9:30 to 10:30. In the event of adverse weather conditions, the organizer reserves the right to change the route. The start list and results are published at www.stopnito.cz. The event is open to the general public and is an ideal way to end the year actively.

name: Silvestrovský běh Karviná
price_range: 200 Kč předem, na místě zdarma pro děti
description: The Silvestrovský běh in Karviná is a traditional 10 km road race held every year on December 31. The route runs along the city’s outer streets and features more than 100 metres of elevation gain, making it a challenge for every runner. The event also includes free children’s races in the local forest park, over distances from 200 m to 1.8 km. The start and registration take place at the city stadium, which also serves as the event’s base. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and the medal ceremony for various categories.
course_highlights: The 10 km route runs along the outer streets of Karviná
More than 100 metres of elevation gain
Children’s races in the forest park over distances of 200 m, 350 m, 900 m and 1.8 km
additional: Registration is open from 8:30 to 9:45. The children’s races start at 10:05. The main route is on paved roads; the children’s races take place in the forest park. Refreshments after the race include goulash soup and tea, with rum available. Registered athletes are entered by their clubs; parents enter unregistered children. The race starts at 10:00, and the children’s races start at 10:05. Registration is open until December 28 or 29. The event takes place at the City Stadium and in the forest park.

name: Silvestrovský běh Havlovicemi
description: The Havlovice New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional running race organized by Maratonstav Physical Education Association Úpice and held annually on New Year’s Eve in Havlovice. The event offers a 6.6 km main race on a new four-lap course, as well as children’s categories with shorter distances. It is suitable for adults, juniors, and youth runners, and concludes with New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish. The race starts at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice, where runner registration also takes place. The event is part of a long-standing tradition of running races in the region.
course_highlights: Main race: 6.6 km — 4 laps on a new course
Start and finish at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice
New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish
additional: Children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. Registration is open until 9:30 for the children’s categories and until 10:30 for the main race. The event includes the main course and children’s categories; race day concludes with festive refreshments; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silvestrovský běh Zlín
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Zlín is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve, offering 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer courses. The main 10 km race consists of two laps on an out-and-back route along the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back. The race is suitable for the general public, including young people and juniors, and is part of the Běhy Zlín series. Winners are announced shortly after the race, with prizes awarded to the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The route follows the cycle path from Vršava to Kostelec and back
The main race is 10 kilometers long, split into two laps
A shorter 5-kilometer course is also available for young people and juniors
additional: Online registration is open until December 30 at 12:00; on-site registration on race day is open until 10:40. Winners are announced at 12:45 at the race registration venue. Age categories are according to the rules of the Běhy Zlín series. Category winners receive prizes, subject to the organizer’s options. 5 km and 10 km races, online registration, category winner announcements, photos and results available

name: Silvestrovský běh Stříbro
organizer: Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro, z.s. a TJ Baník Stříbro
description: The Stříbro New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race held in the picturesque town of Stříbro in the Plzeň Region. The race offers a 10.5 km course, mostly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI site. It is suitable for all runners who want to end the year on an active and enjoyable note, with the option to start in different waves according to pace. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, social gathering and refreshments for participants. The organizer, KERMI Stříbro, provides a friendly atmosphere and high-quality event organization.
course_highlights: 10.5 km course, mostly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI Stříbro site
Start at 10:00 or 10:30 depending on the runner’s pace
additional: The entry fee can be paid in advance by email or on site at the KERMI training center. The race includes a trail run at KERMI and a historic town run. Registration is available on site or by email. The start is at 10:00. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Silvestrovský běh - memoriál Richarda Plcha
location: Park Pod Plachtami, Brno-Nový Lískovec, Brno, Jihomoravský, Czech Republic
price_range: 120 Kč – při přihlášení předem do 29. 12. 2025, 18:00 hodin; 200 Kč – na místě
description: The Silvester Run – Richard Plch Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the AC Moravská Slavia Brno athletics club. It takes place on 31 December in Brno-Nový Lískovec, in Pod Plachtami Park, and offers races for all age groups, from children to veterans. Runners can choose between the main races of 9.84 km and 4.92 km, a 1.64 km fun run, and children’s races starting at 100 m. The course is asphalt with a mix of paved paths, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere as they end the year on the move.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface combined with paved paths
Routes for all age groups, from 100 m to 9.84 km
Held in Pod Plachtami Park in Brno-Nový Lískovec
additional: Check-in is required no later than 30 minutes before the start of each category at ZŠ Svážná 438/9; it opens at 8:00. Changing rooms are available at ZŠ Svážná and are for changing only; the organizers are not responsible for belongings left there. Results will be posted throughout the event in the start/finish area and later published on mslavia.cz and atletika.cz. The first three finishers in each category will receive prizes, and children will receive a small prize at the finish. In the fun run, prizes will be drawn among three runners. Entering two races is permitted only for categories up to and including older pupils. The course consists of asphalt and paved paths; online registration runs from 20. 11. 2025 to 29. 12. 2025; the event includes various age categories and a fun run open to all birth years.

name: Silvestrovský běh Kolín
location: Lesopark Borky, Kolín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The New Year’s Eve Run in Kolín is a traditional three-kilometre race held in Borky Forest Park. In 2026, the race will take place in an unusual format: the course will be marked from December 30 to January 1, and each participant can run it individually. Results can be sent to the organisers by email or SMS, after which the results list will be published. The start is by the FK Kolín football pitch, and the course follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue, finishing at the athletics stadium.
course_highlights: Traditional three-kilometre course in Borky Forest Park
Start by the FK Kolín football pitch with an artificial surface
The route follows a road, a cycle path and a chestnut avenue past STAP
additional: The race can be run individually between December 30 and January 1, and results can be sent by email or SMS. The results list will be published on January 2. The race will not be held as a traditional mass event due to anti-epidemic measures. Modified format due to pandemic, individual participation, course marked from Dec 30 to Jan 1, results submitted via email/SMS, results published Jan 2.

name: Půlnoční silvestrovsko - novoroční běh metropolí
description: The Midnight New Year’s Eve–New Year’s Day Metropolis Run is a unique sporting event held in Prague at night just before midnight on New Year’s Eve. The race starts at Galerie Butovice and offers the last run in Europe in 2025. It is intended for recreational runners as well as more experienced competitors who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year together in an active, sporting way. The start is scheduled for 23:50, and registration is available both in advance and on race day.
course_highlights: A night run in Prague’s unique atmosphere
Start at Galerie Butovice
The last race in Europe in 2025
additional: Registration is also available at the on-site race check-in on race day. Detailed information about the course, rules, safety measures, and videos from previous editions are available at www.behmetropole.cz. Start at Galerie Butovice, registration at www.behmetropole.cz, course and safety information on the website.

name: Silvestrovský běh Přerov
description: We invite you to the traditional Přerov New Year’s Eve Run, held on December 31, starting at 10:00 from the boathouse. Men run 7.5 km, while women, junior women and junior men run 5 km, consisting of two 2.5 km laps. The race offers a pleasant end-of-year atmosphere and the chance to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Přerov. You can register online in advance or at the race office on the day of the event. We look forward to seeing you!
course_highlights: The course runs around the boathouse and skatepark in Přerov
Men run 7.5 km; women and juniors run 5 km (two 2.5 km laps)
Start at 10:00 from the boathouse
additional: Registration is available in advance via an online form or at the race office on the day of the event. The course is a 2.5 km loop: boathouse – skatepark – boathouse. Men run three laps (7.5 km), while women and juniors run two laps (5 km). The race takes place on December 31, 2026. Registration is available online or on-site on race day. Start at 10:00.

name: Běh od Hasy k Hase
location: Roudnice nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Run from Hasa to Hasa is a traditional New Year's Eve run in Roudnice nad Labem, now being held for the 42nd time. The race offers a simple, easy-to-follow format, with times recorded using chip timing. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants enjoy a beautiful race at the end of the year. Check-in takes place from 8:30 in the Elbe River Board building in Roudnice nad Labem.
course_highlights: A traditional New Year's Eve run with high participation
Chip timing
Start and check-in at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228
additional: Check-in from 8:30 at the Elbe River Board building, Pod Katovnou 228, Roudnice n.L. The start is between 10:00 and 11:00. The race is simple and easy to follow, and suitable for the general public. It is part of a regional celebration attended by runners and organizers from Sokol and local partners. The course is approximately 5.2 km long, and registration is available online at naZávody.cz. The event is traditionally associated with celebrating the arrival of the new year.

name: Běh kolem Žabárny
location: Rtyně v Podkrkonoší, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh kolem Žabárny is a traditional winter running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club in Rtyně v Podkrkonoší. The event features children’s categories followed immediately by the main race. It is part of the Winter Running League and is suitable for the general public, including families with children. The start and registration are held in Rtyně v Podkrkonoší, offering easy access and a friendly race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Winter running race in Rtyně v Podkrkonoší
Children’s categories and the main race start at the same location
Part of the Winter Running League, with the race number valid for the entire series
additional: Registration until 9:30. Parking by the cemetery in Rtyně v Podkrkonoší. The race number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place on January 9, 2027. The main race starts after the children’s categories. Parking is by the cemetery in Rtyně v Podkrkonoší. The race is conducted in Czech.

name: Běh Partyzánskou stezkou
location: Restaurace Slavoj, Osek, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Slavoj Osek u Hořovic, Domeček Hořovice
description: The Run Along the Partisan Trail is a winter cross-country race held mainly on forest roads, with the first and last two kilometres on asphalt. The course is approximately 9 km long and is typically snowy and muddy, adding to the challenge and atmosphere of the race. The race starts in Osek near Hořovice, by the Slavoj restaurant, and also offers children’s races on asphalt. The event is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for anyone who enjoys running outdoors in winter.
course_highlights: A 9 km course combining asphalt and forest roads
Winter conditions, often with snow and mud
Children’s races on asphalt
additional: Registration is available both on site and in advance. The course surface is a combination of asphalt and forest roads. The organiser is Slavoj Osek u Hořovic. Children’s races are part of the event. Results are available in the system and as a PDF. The organisers also hold a pairs relay and other running events as part of the cup. Children’s and youth courses are approximately 200 to 2,000 metres long and run on asphalt.

name: innogy Winter Run Hradec Králové
location: Smetanovo nábřeží, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The innogy Winter Run Hradec Králové is a winter running event for everyone, held in all weather in the picturesque setting of Smetana Embankment. It offers individual 8 km and 4 km races, a 2 × 4 km relay, and a children’s race. The event is part of the Winter RUN series and is suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The start and finish are near the Aldis on Eliščino Embankment, providing convenient access and a pleasant atmosphere. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and the option to purchase an official technical T-shirt and headband.
course_highlights: A winter run in all weather in the centre of Hradec Králové
Individual 8.6 km and 4.3 km courses, with the option of a 2 × 4 km relay
Children’s races over 400 m and 800 m
additional: A 30% discount is available to students with an ISIC card when registering and paying online by the regular deadline. Official technical T-shirts can be ordered for 600 Kč and headbands for 200 Kč until 20.12.2026. The race pack includes a bag with leaflets and gifts from partners. On-site registration is available at a higher price. Children’s races start from 10:00, and the main races start at 12:00 and 13:00. The entry fee for the main races includes a race number, timing chip, refreshments at the finish, and a metal medal.

name: Desítka v Bezručáku
location: Bezručovo údolí, Chomutov, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic

name: Zimní běh na Blaník
description: The Winter Run to Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on 16 January 2027. The event offers two main races: a challenging 19.9 km main race over Velký and Malý Blaník, and an accompanying 11.2 km race. The routes pass through the beautiful Podblanicko countryside, with steep climbs, forest sections and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are right in the centre of Načeradec, with welcoming facilities. The race is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: The 19.9 km main race has 542 m of elevation gain and passes over Velký and Malý Blaník
The accompanying 11.2 km race has 238 m of elevation gain and views from Malý Blaník
Refreshment stations on the route in Býkovice and by the lookout tower on Velký Blaník
additional: The start and finish are behind the Načeradec Municipal Office, approximately 270 m from the race facilities. Parking is available in several designated areas, marked with traffic signs and managed with the help of volunteer firefighters. The organisers offer free safekeeping for valuables in the changing rooms at the primary school. The accompanying race starts at 10:45. The entry fee includes the option to order functional accessories from the J&O 2025/2026 collection. name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Praha
location: Výstaviště Praha, Stromovka, Prague 7, Prague, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Prague is a charity run held in the evening in the beautiful setting of Stromovka and Výstaviště. Participants can choose between two routes—a short 2.8 km loop and a long 4.5 km loop—which can also be walked. The start is at 21:00, and registration opens at 18:30. The event offers an accompanying programme, including a concert, and is open to all age groups. Proceeds support people with severe visual impairments. Capacity is limited to ensure runners’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: 2.8 km route – short loop in Stromovka
4.5 km route – long loop in Stromovka
Night run with a choice of entry option including a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards are admitted free of charge, without a headlamp or headband. Children under 15 accompanied by an adult are admitted free of charge, but do not receive a headlamp. A cloakroom and baggage storage, medical services and an accompanying programme including a concert are available on site. Dogs on a leash and wearing a muzzle are welcome, except in Jihlava. Information about the venue, route and price is based on the 2026 edition; the date 15. 4. 2027 has not been confirmed. In the 2026 edition, participants with a TP, ZTP or ZTP/P card and their companions were admitted free of charge.

name: 2. Běh pro zdraví
location: Lodičky, Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Jäkl Karviná, z. s. – oddíl atletiky
description: Běh pro zdraví is a friendly running event in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Participants can run a 3 km route at their own pace and support their health. The start is at Lodičky, and proceeds from the entry fee are donated to help those in need. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this community sports event.
course_highlights: A 3 km route through Božena Němcová Park
Start at Lodičky in Karviná
Run at any pace in pleasant natural surroundings
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, with the start at 17:45 at Lodičky. Proceeds from the entry fee go to help those in need. Proceeds from the entry fee are designated to help those in need.

name: Jarní běh v Pávově
description: The Spring Run in Pávov is an 8.8 km race that runs on roads and trails around Jihlava, specifically in Pávov. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny cup and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy a combination of paved and off-road sections in the scenic Vysočina landscape. It is suitable for the general public and offers a sporting experience in spring.
course_highlights: 8.8 km course
Combination of roads and trails
Around Jihlava, in Pávov

name: Horský půlmaraton Sušice
location: Ostrov Santos, Sušice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Sušice Mountain Half Marathon is a challenging and beautiful running race in the heart of Šumava, offering a unique experience with stunning views from three peaks and of iconic places such as Žižkův vrch, Kalich, Sedlo, Kalovy and Pustý Hrádek. The race base is traditionally on Santos Island by the Otava River, where runners can enjoy quality services, marked courses and a family-friendly atmosphere. The organizers focus on providing excellent conditions and an unforgettable day filled with sport and nature. The race also has a strong tradition and is organized in memory of Matěj Molcar, an enthusiastic athlete.
course_highlights: The main course is 21.1 km long with 800 m of elevation gain
The surface consists of 90% paved roads, singletrack, forest trails and rocky climbs
The route crosses three peaks and offers stunning views of Šumava
additional: The race base on Santos Island offers a restaurant, parking, a children's playground, a swimming pool, a pump track and a skatepark. Relay teams are provided with transport to the start and a shuttle after the race. The children's race has several age categories, with different loop lengths. Cancellation insurance for the entry fee can be arranged through Kooperativa. The race offers several distances, including a half marathon and 10.5 km, with challenging terrain and a family-friendly atmosphere in the Sušice and Šumava area.

name: 57. ročník Běhu vítězství, 53. ročník Hranické dvacítky a 10. ročník Hranické desítky
location: Stadion SK Hranice, Hranice, Czech Republic
description: The Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice. The races take place at the SK Hranice stadium and in the surrounding area, with the shorter distances of 100 to 500 metres run on the stadium track. The Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka partly follow forest paths, offering runners a pleasant natural setting. These races have a long tradition and are popular with runners of all kinds, as well as children and young people.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 m on the stadium track
The Hranická dvacítka follows forest paths
Natural surroundings near the stadium
additional: The races have children’s categories and a training schedule for children and young people. Photos from previous editions are available online. The races are part of SK Hranice’s activities and promote a healthy lifestyle. The programme also includes children’s and youth races; the 100 to 500 m runs take place on the stadium track. The main 20 km race is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje.

name: Mistrovství ČR v půlmaratonu mužů a žen
location: Společenské centrum IDEON, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Czech Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon Championships is a prestigious 21.0975 km athletics race held in Pardubice. The start is on Smetana Square by the East Bohemian Theatre, and the finish is also in Pardubice. The race is for men, women and, where applicable, juniors who are entered by their athletics clubs and approved by the technical delegate. Participants receive a JOMA performance T-shirt free of charge. The Czech Championships results are announced shortly after the race, including the half-marathon results.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Pardubice, on Smetana Square by the East Bohemian Theatre
Course distance: 21.0975 km
Sports drinks and water at every lap
additional: Registration and race-number and timing-chip collection take place on Friday, 9 April, from 16:00 to 19:00 at the IDEON Social Centre, Jiráskova 1963, Pardubice. Runners must compete in club vests registered with the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The race is technically organized by Oldřich Bujnoch in cooperation with the KPA Pardubice Sports Club. The Czech Championships results ceremony is at 15:40, and the half-marathon results ceremony is at 16:25. The race is scheduled for 10 April 2027, with a 14:00 start. The race office and race-number collection will be at the IDEON Social Centre. Runners receive a JOMA performance T-shirt, a medal and water at the finish; entries for the championship race are submitted by runners’ clubs.

name: Jarní běh Bílovice nad Svitavou
location: Palackého údolí, Bílovice nad Svitavou, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run in Bílovice nad Svitavou is a traditional athletics event organized by Sokol Bílovice nad Svitavou with the support of the municipality. The race takes place in Palacký Valley, approximately 800 metres beyond the Sokol gym, and is open to all age groups, from preschool children to adult men and women. The first race starts at 9:00, with categories divided by age and ability. The event offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere in beautiful natural surroundings and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through Palacký Valley in Bílovice nad Svitavou
Start approximately 800 m beyond the Sokol gym
Categories range from preschool children to adults
additional: The race is open to all categories, from preschool children up to age 6 through to men and women. It starts on Saturday morning at 9:00.

name: Pardubický vinařský půlmaratón – Mistrovství ČR v půlmaratonu
description: The Pardubice Wine Half Marathon is a traditional 21.097 km race held in Pardubice. It is also the Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Half Marathon Championship, with a scenic course through the city centre and the finish at Pernštýnské Square. The start is at Smetana Square, and runners complete two laps. Participants receive a technical T-shirt and a bottle of wine if they pay the entry fee on time. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and elite athletes.
course_highlights: The course runs through the centre of Pardubice, starting at Smetana Square and finishing at Pernštýnské Square
Two laps, with a total distance of 21.097 km
Isotonic drinks and water at every lap
additional: The start and finish are in the centre of Pardubice. Registration takes place at the IDEON Social Centre in Pardubice. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours. Registrations not paid by 4.4.2027 do not include a T-shirt or wine. Timing chips are non-returnable and assigned by number. Parking is available in front of the IDEON Social Centre and in nearby car parks.

name: Zlínská lesní hodinovka
description: The Zlín Forest Hour Run is a unique running race in the Czech Republic, held in the forest above the Lesní čtvrť district of Zlín. The race has a long tradition: it was originally run on a cinder track, moved to the forest at Vršava in 1995, and since 2006 has taken place on a gently rolling one-kilometre loop. The run lasts 60 minutes, and competitors try to cover as much distance as possible. The race is organized by Jirka Prokop and his team and is known for its friendly, regional character.
course_highlights: A gently rolling one-kilometre loop in the forest above the Lesní čtvrť district of Zlín
A unique forest course, the only hourly race in the Czech Republic run in a forest
The Gustav Bělský Loop at Vršava (historically)
additional: Race registration takes place at the observatory. The race lasts 60 minutes of running time. The best performance is over 17 km in an hour. The race is part of the year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region.

name: Jarní kros Okolo Dračí studánky
location: Malíkovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: ZD Hradečno a Obec Malíkovice ve spolupráci s MK Kladno a Pavlem Žlábkem
description: The Spring Cross-Country Race around Dračí studánka is a 6 km race that runs mainly along field and forest paths in Malíkovice. This cross-country race gives runners the chance to enjoy the natural terrain and woodland setting of the Central Bohemian Region. It is organized by ZD Hradečno and the Malíkovice Municipal Office in cooperation with MK Kladno, ensuring high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants to experience a springtime run.
course_highlights: 6 km course mainly along field and forest paths
Natural and woodland terrain in the Central Bohemian Region
Scenic surroundings of Dračí studánka in Malíkovice

name: Veřovská desítka
description: We invite you to the traditional Veřovská desítka run, held in the picturesque village of Veřovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all ages and abilities, including children’s categories and a race for non-registered participants. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful surroundings, inspiring active movement and a memorable sporting experience. Race information is available to download on the official website. We look forward to your participation and to sharing a great sporting experience.
additional: Race information and details of the children’s categories are available to download on the website. Orlovna’s contact telephone numbers and opening hours are listed for enquiries and reservations.

name: Běh Štěpánkou
location: Lesopark Štěpánka, Mladá Boleslav, Czech Republic
description: Běh Štěpánkou is a traditional running race organized by the AC Mladá Boleslav athletics club in the beautiful surroundings of Štěpánka Forest Park. The race offers runners of all ages and ability levels the opportunity to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and nature. The event is part of the club’s athletics calendar and supports community sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: Štěpánka Forest Park offers a natural setting for running
A traditional race with a long history in Mladá Boleslav
Courses suitable for different age groups and ability levels

name: Běhej lesy Karlštejn
location: Lom Velká Amerika, Bubovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Karlštejn is a trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Velká Amerika Quarry in Bubovice. The race offers various routes from 6 km to 30 km, with different elevation gains to challenge runners on demanding terrain. It also features special timed sections, the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, adding extra competitive elements and motivation. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, which means international ranking points and the opportunity to earn a UTMB Index based on performance and distance. Join this traditional event and enjoy both the beauty of nature and a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Routes pass by the Velká Amerika Quarry, with elevation gains ranging from 149 m to 1,011 m
A 150-metre Conti Speed Section on the 12 km, 18 km and 30 km routes
A 500-metre Generali Investments Finish straight with a timed section and a competition for the fastest time
additional: Routes are available to download in GPX format. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races, with international ranking points. The finish features an extended 500 m straight with the timed Generali Investments Finish section, where the fastest runners are announced. There is also a Conti Speed Section on the course, with prizes from Continental. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and was included in the UTMB Index Races in previous years.

name: 7 pohoří Jizerské hory
location: Ski areál Severák, Janov nad Nisou, Czech Republic
description: The Jizera Mountains race is part of the 7 Mountains Trail Run series and offers technical trails with epic views around Smržovka, Josefův Důl and Maxov. The start and race headquarters are at the Severák Ski Area in Janov nad Nisou. The course was designed by Mountain Rescue Service rescuer Michal Zavadil, and runners can choose from three distances with different elevation gains. The event takes place in all weather, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments along the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: Technical trails in the Jizera Mountains with up to 860 m of elevation gain
Routes follow paths and terrain around Smržovka, Josefův Důl and Maxov
Epic views and an atmosphere you won’t experience anywhere else
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 4 hours, after which a runner is marked DNF. Participants can leave small belongings at the registration booth. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked course, a race bib, chip timing, a commemorative medal, and refreshments along the course and at the finish. The listed distances and elevation gains are based on the previous edition; details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Běh Trojzemím
location: Rekreační areál Kristýna, Hrádek nad Nisou, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Trojzemím is a family-friendly race for all ages and fitness levels, held at the Kristýna recreation area in Hrádek nad Nisou. It features a very fast 5 km and 10 km course, mostly along flat cycle paths in the heart of the Three-Country Point. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all abilities and is supported by local partners and municipalities. The start and finish are located in a beautiful recreation area, with paid parking available nearby.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km and 10 km courses, mostly along flat cycle paths
Start and finish at the Kristýna recreation area in Hrádek nad Nisou
Pleasant surroundings in the heart of the Three-Country Point
additional: Check-in for children's categories is from 8:30 to 9:30, and for adults from 9:00 to 12:30 at the start and finish area. Paid parking is available in the immediate vicinity of the start; the car park is unattended. The race has reached capacity and registration is closed. It is not possible to register or enter on the day.

name: Běh Litní a zámeckým parkem
location: Liteňský zámek and park, Liteň, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Včasná registrace předem: 20,- Kč pro registrované do 30.3.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 4.4.2025, závodníci při dodržení včasné registraci obdrží startovní číslo se svým jménem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Registrace předem: 20,- Kč pro registrované po 1.4.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 4.4.2025

tiers.description: Včasná registrace předem: 150,- Kč pro registrované do 30.3.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 1.4.2025 závodníci při dodržení včasné registraci obdrží startovní číslo se svým jménem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Registrace předem: 200,- Kč pro registrované po 1.4.2025 s řádně uhrazeným startovným do 4.4.2025

description: The Spring Run through Liteň and the Castle Park is a public running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Liteň Castle and its park. The race is part of the Regional Youth Cross-Country Running Cup and offers courses for adults and children. The main race is 6,760 metres long, and the children’s races take place in the castle grounds. Winners of the main categories receive valuable stay vouchers in the Jizera Mountains, Šumava, or the Bohemian Forest.
course_highlights: The 6,760-metre main race course runs through the grounds of Liteň Castle and its park
Children’s races take place in the castle grounds
The race is part of the Regional Youth Cross-Country Running Cup
additional: Race bibs bearing the runner’s name are available to participants who register in advance. On-site payment is possible in cash only. Main organizer: Česká tábornická unie - Záskalák Liteň, p.s. According to the available context, winners of the main categories receive stay vouchers.

name: Štafetová POHÁDKA
location: Parkoviště U jasanů, Nový Šaldorf-Sedlešovice, Czech Republic
description: Štafetová POHÁDKA is a team race for three-person teams, covering more than 70 km from the village of Police through Podyjí and Lower Austria to Nový Šaldorf near Znojmo. The route is divided into six stages, each approximately 10 to 14 km long, which runners complete in succession with a relay baton. Along the way, the course passes through countryside with views of Bítov, Cornštejn and Hardegg castles, as well as other natural and historic sites. The race is open to men’s, women’s and mixed teams; the start is in Police by the sports ground, and the finish is in the U jasanů car park in Nový Šaldorf.
course_highlights: More than 70 km through Podyjí and Lower Austria
Six relay stages, each approximately 10 to 14 km long
Views of Bítov, Cornštejn and Hardegg castles
additional: Teams have three members. The minimum age is 18, or 15 with parental consent.

name: Rozeběhni Stráž
location: School sports facility, Stráž pod Ralskem, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Základní škola a Mateřská škola ve Stráži pod Ralskem
description: Rozeběhni Stráž is a running race held in the picturesque town of Stráž pod Ralskem, offering an opportunity for athletes of all ages. The event is organized by the Stráž pod Ralskem Primary and Nursery School and takes place at the school sports grounds, which feature a running track and other sports facilities. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the community. The website provides up-to-date information and photos from previous editions. Registration for the next edition is now open through an external registration system.
course_highlights: Running track and multipurpose sports facilities
Sports complex with a small-sided football pitch and high-jump and long-jump areas
Space suitable for runners of different ages and ability levels
additional: The sports complex includes a running track, multipurpose courts, and high-jump, long-jump, and shot-put areas. It is owned and managed by the Stráž pod Ralskem Primary and Nursery School. The pitch can be rented by prior arrangement. The website includes links to photo galleries from previous editions of the race.

name: Městský běh Brandýsem a Boleslaví
location: Zámecká zahrada, Brandýs nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The Brandýs and Boleslav City Run is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting of the castle garden in Brandýs nad Labem. The race is open to all age groups and runners of varying abilities, with distances ranging from children’s races and 3 km up to a quarter marathon. It also includes a team race, where the three fastest times of team members are combined. The event features a programme of accompanying activities and refreshments, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and their supporters.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly on asphalt, but also on cobblestones, concrete paving and a compacted path
The 5 km and 10 km routes follow the same loop; the 10 km race completes it twice
The children’s routes follow a compacted path in the castle garden
additional: Registration is available online or in person at Kočárovna. Race numbers and chips can be collected on 10 and 11 April at the information centre or Kočárovna. Teams must have at least 3 runners. The winning team receives valuable prizes, including a keg of beer and running gear. Finishers receive a commemorative medal, light refreshments and fruit. Changing rooms, a baggage storage area and water stations on the course and at the finish are available. Traffic restrictions apply from 13:30 to approximately 15:30. Parking is limited, so using the P+R near the train station is recommended. The event includes refreshments and prizes for the winners.

name: Radonický běh
description: Radonický běh is a traditional running race held in the grounds of Radonický park Amerika. The event offers courses for children and adults. The main races are 3.5 and 6.5 km long and follow field and forest paths, with part of the route on a paved road. The race is suitable for the general public and offers medals and prizes for the winners in each category. Refreshments and an accompanying program, including a Zumba workout, are provided after the race. The event takes place, with children’s races starting from 10:00 and the main races starting from 11:30.
course_highlights: The 3.5 and 6.5 km main routes follow field and forest paths
Part of the route follows a paved road in the grounds of Amerika Park
Children’s courses are marked within the park grounds
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 and closes at 9:40 for children and 11:15 for adults. The entry fee is voluntary. Prizes and medals are prepared for the first three finishers in each category, and all children in category D receive sweets. Tea, fruit, Tatranky wafers and soup are available at the finish. Breaks will be filled by a Zumba workout led by L. Burdová. Competitors run at their own risk; minors run at their parents’ risk. The listing for the 11th edition gives the date as 11 April 2026, not the target date of 10 April 2027. In 2026, registration began at 9:00; the children’s races started from 10:00 and the main races from 11:30.

name: Smrt krásných běžců (backyard ultra)
location: Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
description: null

name: Benefiční rodinný běh
location: Malý Újezd, Mělník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The charity family run in Malý Újezd is a community sporting event for families and people of all ages. The run offers an opportunity to spend an active day in the pleasant surroundings of the village of Malý Újezd and support a good cause. The event is organized by the Radost Sports and Entertainment Association, which provides a varied cultural and social program in the village. The course is suitable for runners and families with children, reinforcing the friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: A family-friendly atmosphere for people of all ages
The course runs through the picturesque surroundings of Malý Újezd
The event is part of the village’s cultural and sporting life
additional: The event is organized by the Radost Sports and Entertainment Association, which organizes a range of cultural and social events in the village for people of all ages.

name: ČEZ RunTour Hradec Králové
description: ČEZ RunTour Hradec Králové is a family-friendly running event with races for all ages, from children to adults. The event takes place at Malšovická Arena and offers distances of 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, including children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. It is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Běh cyklostezkou
organizer: AZ tým ve spolupráci se Sportovním zařízením města s.r.o. ve Světlé nad Sázavou
description: Běh cyklostezkou is a traditional race held in Světlá nad Sázavou. It offers runners a pleasant 5.2 km route along the Sázava River on the cycle path to the corn mill in Mrzkovice and back. The race is suitable for various age categories of men and women, as well as married couples, who compete concurrently. Separate races are organized for children, with different distances according to age. Participants can look forward to chip timing, commemorative medals, and prizes for the top finishers in each category. Refreshments and a raffle are available after the race.
course_highlights: 5.2 km route along the Sázava River on the cycle path
Finish at the tennis complex in Světlá nad Sázavou
Categories for men, women, married couples, and children, with different race distances for children
additional: Registration for the main race is open from 12:00 to 14:30. The children’s races start at 13:00, with registration from 12:00 to 12:30. The main race is chip-timed. After the race, a raffle and light refreshments are available at the finish, along with refreshments at the complex’s buffet. In case of bad weather, shelter is available in the covered tennis hall. The race includes chip timing, commemorative medals, prizes for the top finishers, and refreshments at the finish and at the complex’s buffet. In case of bad weather, covered facilities are available in the tennis hall.

name: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka a Hranická desítka
location: Hranice, Přerov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh vítězství, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice in the Olomouc Region. The races offer various distances, from children’s events on the stadium track to the main races in the forest and around the town of Hranice. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners of all ages, who can enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and a high-quality sporting atmosphere. The races are suitable for amateurs and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 m take place on the stadium track
The main routes follow forest paths around Hranice
Beautiful natural surroundings and changes in elevation along the routes
additional: Children’s races cover shorter distances of 100 to 500 m on the stadium track. Course maps for the main races, Hranická dvacítka and Hranická desítka, are available on the website. Photos from previous editions are also available on the website, helping runners get familiar with the courses and the race atmosphere.

name: Velká Morava
location: Mikulčice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Great Moravia Memorial – Cyril and Methodius Centre in Staré Město offers a multimedia exhibition devoted to the history of the Great Moravian Empire and life at a Slavic hillfort in the 9th century. The exhibition is built around the story of the archaeologist Mojslav and features historical dioramas, 3D models and computer animations. Visitors can learn about important moments in Great Moravian history and use audio guides in several languages. The exhibition is accessible to blind and partially sighted visitors, and the recommended visit time is 60 minutes.
course_highlights: Historical dioramas with life-size figures
3D models of reconstructed churches and the fortifications of Veligrad
Multimedia exhibition with computer animations and an audio guide
additional: The exhibition is wheelchair accessible and has a lift and a toilet for visitors with physical disabilities. Texts and audio guides are available in Czech, English, German and Russian. The virtual guide also offers Russian. A printed guide is available in four languages.

location: Goethova vyhlídka, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic

description: Jarní bahno - Goethovka is a traditional race in Karlovy Vary offering three disciplines: mountain biking, running, and canicross. The race takes place on challenging routes with elevation changes and technical sections that test competitors’ abilities. The event is suitable for the general public, including young people, and offers a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and original medals for the winners. It is organized by the A.M.bike z.s. association, which prioritizes safety and fair competition.
course_highlights: A 7 km MTB course with 250 m of elevation gain
An off-road running race over 1 lap
A canicross race with mandatory equipment for dogs
additional: A timing chip is provided at registration; a fee of 500 Kč applies for any chip not returned. The organizer does not provide parking services; parking approximately 200 m from the start is recommended. Competitors start at intervals of several dozen seconds. Canicross dogs must be healthy and over 12 months old, and must start wearing a harness and an elasticated lead. The organizer reserves the right to postpone or cancel the race in extreme conditions. Winners are announced and diplomas awarded after the race; complete results are published online. The Jarní Bahno series is intended for different age groups and ability levels.

name: Jarní rozBěh
location: Husinec-Řež, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Jarní rozBěh is a cross-country and trail running event in the picturesque surroundings of the villages of Husinec and Řež in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers three distances—11.4 km, 7.4 km and 5.7 km—and is suitable for runners of all fitness levels. The event is family-friendly and welcomes runners of all ages who want to enjoy a run in nature and a pleasant atmosphere. It is organized by the municipality of Husinec–Řež, which invites all runners to take part in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail-style courses
Routes run through the villages of Husinec and Řež
Distances of 11.4 km, 7.4 km and 5.7 km

name: Štěpánovský trhák
location: U Dubu, Trhový Štěpánov, Czech Republic
description: Štěpánovský trhák is a traditional running race held at the U Dubu site in Trhový Štěpánov. The route runs mostly through the forest, along forest paths and partly on a cycle path, offering runners a pleasant experience in a natural setting. The event includes children’s categories and a main race that starts in the afternoon. It is known for its community atmosphere and support for charitable activities.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forest and along forest paths
Part of the route follows a cycle path
New venue at the U Dubu site
additional: Registration for the main race is available online and in person on race day from 12:30. The children’s races start at 13:40, and the main race starts at 15:00. Parking is available on Lesní Street, Lipová Street and nearby streets. Driving onto the cycle path beyond the no-entry sign is prohibited. Previous available information lists both children’s and main races.

name: Jarní běh Plzeň
location: Park Homolka, Doudlevce, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Jarní běh Plzeň is a friendly cross-country and trail race held in Plzeň, with courses for children, adults, and relay teams. The event is known for its joyful atmosphere and great athletic performances, and is open to all generations and runners of every ability level. The race takes place at Park Homolka in Doudlevce, with registration available online and on site. It’s an ideal opportunity to enjoy a sporting experience in nature with family and friends.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail courses
Course distances of 6 km, 2 km, and a relay
Park Homolka, Doudlevce, Plzeň
additional: The race is open to all generations, including children, and includes relay teams. The main category starts at 11:00, and the first category starts at 10:00.

name: Jarní stodůlecký kros
description: The Jarní stodůlecký kros is a challenging, one-lap cross-country race that passes through almost every corner of Prague 13. The 9.6 km course runs through the Stodůlky housing estate, Central Park and the rocky areas above Prokopské údolí. The race offers medals and certificates for the top finishers in each category, and material prizes for the fastest runners. After the race, all participants are welcome to tea and a small sweet in the friendly atmosphere of a small race.
course_highlights: One-lap course, 9.6 km long
Passes through the Stodůlky housing estate and Central Park
Climb over the rocky outcrops above Prokopské údolí
additional: Medals and certificates await the top three in each category; the fastest runners receive material prizes. The organiser is TJ Stodůlky Praha; contact: Martin Žežulka. The top three runners in each category receive medals and certificates; material prizes are prepared for the fastest.

name: 57. Běh vítězství, 53. Hranická dvacítka a 10. Hranická desítka
location: Areál DDM Ježkovka Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický
description: The Victory Run, Hranice Twenty and Hranice Ten are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice. They take place at the DDM Ježkovka grounds in Heřmanův Městec. The races offer a range of distances, from short children’s runs on the stadium track to longer off-road courses. The event is open to the public and offers a sporting experience in pleasant surroundings, with a history stretching back decades. The races attract runners of all ages.

name: Běh lipovou alejí – Nymburská desítka
location: Tyršův ostrov and athletics stadium, Nymburk, Czech Republic
description: Běh lipovou alejí is a traditional road race in Nymburk, held since 1996. The race features a 10 km loop course, running mainly on paved paths on Tyršův ostrov and on the athletics stadium’s synthetic track. It is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who have their own categories and courses. The race is organised by Sportovní klub POLICIE Nymburk, z.s., and takes place at the athletics stadium in Nymburk.
course_highlights: A 10 km loop course running mainly on the paved paths of Tyršův ostrov
The opening and closing sections, approximately 1,800 m in total, are on the athletics stadium’s synthetic track
The course complies with IAAF/AIMS rules for measuring courses outside a track
additional: Children’s and youth categories have separate starts from 8:30 to 10:55, with course distances ranging from 100 m to 2,700 m. The main 10 km race for men and women starts at 11:15. Registration for the children’s and youth categories is available only on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The course is measured and can be run individually using GARMIN and STRAVA segments.

name: Horské běhy v Novohradských horách
location: Hojná Voda, Horní Stropnice, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Martin Brožka a tým Sportcentra Novohradské hory
description: The Mountain Runs in the Novohradské Mountains are traditional spring races held amid the beautiful scenery of the Novohradské Mountains, with their hub in Hojná Voda. They offer a variety of courses, from children’s categories and shorter runs to a challenging 63 km ultra trail with 2,050 m of elevation gain. The races are suitable for a wide range of runners, from amateurs to experienced athletes, and also include a canicross category. The start and finish are both in Hojná Voda, where you can also register on race day. The event is organised by Martin Brožka and the Sportcentrum Novohradské hory team.
course_highlights: Ultra trail: 63 km with 2,050 m of elevation gain
Canicross Classic: 19 km with 660 m of elevation gain
Zážitek: 12.4 km with 430 m of elevation gain
additional: You can register online at maraton.cz or in person on race day in Hojná Voda. Race numbers are distributed from 9:30 to 10:30 for adults and from 12:00 to 13:45 for children. Detailed course maps are available in the Mountain Runs Course section, along with course videos for each category. A prize raffle with valuable prizes, including accommodation and a subscription to the Svět běhu magazine, is planned for participants.

name: Kyfův Jarní běh
location: Louka pod bývalým lyžařským můstkem, Hrušov, Senohraby, Czech Republic
description: Kyfův Spring Run is a traditional running race organised by TJ Sokol Senohraby. It takes place in a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov, Senohraby. The race is part of the Ladův kraj Cup and offers a springtime sporting experience with various courses, including a special stream crossing for younger pupils. Participants can also look forward to a mobile café serving hot drinks and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and encourages sporting activity among children and adults.
course_highlights: The courses run through a meadow below the former ski jump in Hrušov
A special stream crossing on the 1.8 km course for younger pupils (born in 2011–2012)
Natural terrain with gentle uneven sections and a springtime atmosphere
additional: A mobile café serving coffee and hot chocolate will be on site. Bringing a change of shoes is recommended because of the stream crossing on the younger pupils’ course. The courses follow traditional routes, and marking is done the evening before the race. The terrain may be uneven in places due to animal activity. A mobile café serving hot drinks is usually on site.

name: Kros Sázava
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Pikovice, Hradištko, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kros Sázava is a running race held in Pikovice, by the football field, in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gains, all entirely on natural terrain. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain with beautiful views. The routes are 15.5 km, 10 km and 5 km long, with elevation gains ranging from 120 to 500 metres, offering a varied experience for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Long route: 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain
Medium route: 10 km with approximately 230 m of elevation gain
Hobby route: 5 km with approximately 120 m of elevation gain
additional: All routes run entirely on natural terrain. A photo gallery of the course is available at krosovypohar.cz/kros-sazava/fotky-z-trasy/.

name: Žďárská 10
location: Žďár nad Sázavou, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic
description: Žďárská 10 is a fast 10 km road race that opens the spring season in the heart of the Žďárské vrchy. The route starts in the center of Žďár nad Sázavou, follows cycle paths to the end of the Pilská Reservoir, and then returns, offering beautiful scenery and minimal elevation gain. The race has a mass start and is precisely measured, making it ideal for runners looking for a fast, enjoyable race in the picturesque Vysočina region. It is organized by Sportovní klub Žďárák z.s., with Vojtěch Bořil as the race representative.
course_highlights: Road route along a paved cycle path with minimal elevation gain
The route runs from the center of Žďár nad Sázavou to the Pilská Reservoir and back
A short 200-meter section on Dvorská Street with controlled road traffic
additional: Registration is also available on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 at the start area behind the House of Culture. Parking is available at the Municipal Office and in nearby areas. The awards ceremony will take place at 12:30. The route follows a cycle path with minimal elevation gain; the race has a mass start and is precisely measured.

name: Korunou za korunu
location: Cihelský rybník, Nové Město na Moravě, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s.
description: Korunou za korunu is a short cross-country race around the dam of Cihelský Pond in Nové Město na Moravě. The race is suitable for all runners who want to enjoy a pleasant running experience in the natural surroundings of Vysočina. The course is 3.2 km long, and spikes may be worn. The event is organized by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s., which ensures a friendly atmosphere and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: A short cross-country race around Cihelský Pond
A 3.2 km course in the natural surroundings of Vysočina
Spikes may be worn
additional: The first category starts at 9:30, and the main category starts at 11:20. The race is organized by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s., and the contact person is Petr Hubáček. The race is also suitable for runners wearing spikes. The event is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running activities.

name: Běh u Chlumce
location: Chlumec, Ústí nad Labem District, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Plné vstupné: 50 Kč Startovné 50 Kč platí pouze dospělí.

description: We invite you to the traditional NaPOLEon run in Chlumec, an event for the whole family. The race takes place in the beautiful Chlumecko countryside and offers courses of varying lengths and difficulty, so everyone can find a suitable route. The event is friendly and suitable for all ages, with registration available in advance or on the day of the race.
course_highlights: Courses of 500 m, 1 km, 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km loop)
Beautiful Chlumecko countryside
Start and finish in the meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec, under a shelter
additional: You can register in advance by emailing chvatalova@mesto-chlumec.cz or in person on the day of the race from 9:00 to 10:00. The start and finish are under a shelter in the meadow by the pear orchard in Chlumec.

name: Bratrušovské vrchy
description: Bratrušovské vrchy is a traditional cross-country race organized by the volunteer firefighters in Bratrušov. The race starts at the football pitch and offers a course of approximately 10.7 km with 418 meters of elevation gain, making for a challenging and enjoyable run through natural terrain. Children can take part in a shorter 2 km race with 80 meters of elevation gain. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series and attracts runners of various age groups.
course_highlights: 10.7 km course with 418 meters of elevation gain
Start at the football pitch in Bratrušov
Children’s 2 km course with 80 meters of elevation gain
additional: There are usually around 65 starters in the adult categories and around 24 in the children’s categories. The race is regularly organized by the Bratrušov Volunteer Firefighters Association.

name: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Praha-Zbraslav railway station, Zbraslav, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY is a challenging mountain race in Prague, offering a 7 km course with 500 metres of elevation gain. It takes place on trails with three demanding climbs and descents, giving the race its distinctive difficulty and challenge. The race starts at Praha-Zbraslav train station and is suitable for runners looking for an intense trail experience in an urban setting. It is organised by VAŠE LIGA under the direction of Petr Lundák, who ensures the event is professionally run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with 500 m of elevation gain
3 demanding climbs and descents
Mountain cross-country race in Prague
additional: The race starts at Praha-Zbraslav train station. It is a mountain cross-country/trail race with significant elevation gain and demanding sections. The organiser is VAŠE LIGA; Petr Lundák can be contacted. The race is part of the VAŠÍ LIGA series. The start is at 18:00 at Praha-Zbraslav train station.

name: Jarní běh Olympu
location: Sportovní areál OLYMP CSMV, Stromovka, Praha 7, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run of Olympus is a cross-country and trail race held at the OLYMP CSMV grounds in Prague’s Stromovka Park. It offers courses of 5.5 km, 4.4 km and 3.3 km through natural surroundings with varied terrain. The race is suitable for the general public and is organised by PSK Olymp Praha. Registration is online only, and the event is traditionally popular with runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail courses
Course distances of 5.5 km, 4.4 km and 3.3 km
Set in Prague’s Stromovka Park at the OLYMP CSMV grounds
additional: Registration is online only and closes at midnight on 8 October 2026. The organiser does not accept entries on race day. The first category starts at 16:00, and the main category starts at 18:55. According to the available context, the main category is scheduled to start at 18:55.

name: Olomoucká desítka
description: Olomouc Ten is the third edition of a 10 km running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and offers runners an asphalt course 3.343 km long, which they must complete three times. The first lap is slightly shorter, giving the race its distinctive character. Winners in each category will receive sweet gifts, and the awards ceremony takes place at the Music Pavilion in Smetana Gardens.
course_highlights: A 3.343 km loop on asphalt paths through Smetana Gardens
The course is run three times; the first lap is 28 m shorter
Start and finish by the Music Pavilion in Smetana Gardens
additional: Bags can be left in the start and finish area. Registration takes place at the race venue; runners must present a chip card with sufficient credit. The race is run according to road-running rules, and everyone takes part at their own risk. The winners’ announcement and prize-giving will take place next to the Music Pavilion. The race offers age categories and a fitness run with no age distinction.

name: Krčská 10
location: Krčský les, Prague 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčská 10 is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. The race offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy running in nature in a friendly atmosphere. The route follows forest paths and offers beautiful views and pleasant terrain. The event is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: The route runs through Krč Forest in Prague 4
Forest paths with natural surfaces
Picturesque views and peaceful surroundings

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Olomouc
location: Výstaviště Flora Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Olomouc is a charity running event held in Flora Park. Participants can choose between a 2.5 km course (1 lap) and a 5 km course (2 laps). The run starts at 21:00, and registration opens at 19:00. The event is both a sporting challenge and a way to support the Světluška project, which helps people with severe visual impairments. Participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or a sports headband, adding to the safety and atmosphere of the night run.
course_highlights: The course runs through Flora Park in Olomouc
A choice of 2.5 km or 5 km course
A night run with an entry option that includes a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration is available through the GoOut.cz portal. Capacity is limited for participants’ safety and comfort. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards are admitted free of charge, but are not entitled to a headlamp or sports headband. Children under 15 accompanied by an adult are admitted free of charge, but do not receive a headlamp or headband. A cloakroom and baggage storage are available on site. Refreshments and medical services are provided throughout the event. The accompanying programme includes a concert and other activities.

name: Kateřinský běh Hrabovou
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kateřinský běh Hrabovou is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová, held in spring. The main course passes the historic Church of St. Catherine, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event offers 5 km and 2.5 km races, including children’s races and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Participants can enjoy not only a sporting challenge but also an accompanying program and refreshments after the race.
course_highlights: The course passes the historic Church of St. Catherine
Main race: 5 km; shorter course: 2.5 km
A 5 km Nordic Walking event is available
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. Registration and the start take place on Bažanova Street in front of the Hrabová Municipal District Office. The entry fee includes a medal for participants who register by 13 April 2026, participation in the Hrabová and Moravian-Silesian Running Cups (for the 5 km race), a reusable race number with a chip, SMS results service, refreshments after the race, changing rooms and toilets, and an accompanying program. Participants are advised not to wear headphones during the race, and their race number must be attached to their chest. Photos and videos will be taken for promotional purposes.

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu + 24. Hanácký půlmaraton
description: The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships, held alongside the 24th Haná Half Marathon, is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletický klub Olomouc. The race takes place on the athletics track in Olomouc and attracts runners from across Moravia and Silesia, who compete for championship titles. The event is known for its excellent organization and an atmosphere that supports both elite athletes and amateurs. The race starts at 9:00 in the morning and is part of the club’s wider athletics program.
course_highlights: The course follows the athletics track in Olomouc
Part of the Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships
An atmosphere that supports both elite runners and amateurs
additional: The race is part of the club’s wider athletics program, which includes youth categories and para athletics. The organizer is Atletický klub Olomouc, which has a rich tradition and experience organizing athletics events at the home stadium of TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc. The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships are also held as part of the event.

name: Běh Javorkou
location: Park Javorka, Česká Třebová, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Javorkou is a traditional spring running race with a long history, held every April in the beautiful setting of Javorka Park in Česká Třebová. The fast main race covers 6 km on firm park paths and is mildly undulating, making it suitable for strong performances. The race is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers categories for children, a main race, and team relays. Race facilities are located by the outdoor stage next to the Javorka restaurant.
course_highlights: 6 km loop course (with shorter options) on firm park paths (gravel, paving)
Mildly undulating course profile, suitable for fast running
Course markings in different colours by category
additional: Registration is available online in advance or on race day, no later than 20 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The race takes place on Saturday: the first children’s categories start at 9:30, the main race at 11:30, and the team relays at 12:10. Race facilities are located by the Music Pavilion in Javorka Park, next to the Javorka restaurant. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup series.

name: Žehrovický Kalspotkros
location: Kamenné Žehrovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Žehrovický Kalspotkros is a 6.2 km cross-country race with a rolling profile, held in Kamenné Žehrovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging natural terrain. The course is suited to cross-country enthusiasts who appreciate a mix of hilly sections and natural scenery. A long-standing regional event, it welcomes runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 6.2 km cross-country course
Rolling profile with hilly sections
Natural scenery in Kamenné Žehrovice

name: Listonošův krpál
description: Listonošův krpál is an uphill race in Prague-Jarov near Zbraslav, measuring 2.88 km with 150 metres of elevation gain. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The course is short but intense, making for a dynamic and exciting racing experience.
course_highlights: Course length: 2.88 km
Elevation gain: 150 m
Uphill race on terrain in Prague

name: Cena Tolštejnského panství Jiřetín pod Jedlovou – Jedlová
location: Jedlová Mountain summit, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: The Tolštejn Estate Cup Jiřetín pod Jedlovou–Jedlová is a 6 km uphill race with 340 metres of elevation gain, finishing at the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running and offers runners a challenging, scenic course. The route passes through picturesque countryside and is suited to fans of mountain running and a challenge. This traditional event attracts runners from across the country.
course_highlights: 6 km course with 340 m of elevation gain
Finish at the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains
Part of the Czech Cup in Mountain Running

name: SAFARIBĚH
location: Main Entrance, Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Safariběh ČSOB is a running race held at Safari Park Dvůr Králové, offering a unique experience of running through an African and walking safari. The race is open to the general public and offers three distances: a 2 km family run, and 5 km and 10 km races. The start and finish are at the main entrance to the safari park, and the routes run mostly on paved asphalt paths. The entry fee also includes free admission to the safari park on race day and support for the conservation of maneless zebras.
course_highlights: The 10 km route follows the same 5 km route twice through the African and walking safari
The 2 km family race runs through the Lion Safari
additional: The race bib has a built-in chip that participants keep. The entry fee includes a contribution to the conservation of maneless zebras and free admission to the safari park, valid only on race day. After finishing, participants receive a meal voucher (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, and a small refreshment (water and fruit). The family run includes activities for children at the ČSOB main partner stand. The entry fee includes admission to the safari park on race day. The race supports the conservation of maneless zebras.

name: Jarní běh Dražovkou
location: Dražovka Forest Park, Hořovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Run through Dražovka is a traditional running race in Hořovice, offering runners of all ages the chance to enjoy a run in the picturesque Dražovka forest park. The course follows forest paths through varied terrain, providing interesting challenges and beautiful natural scenery. After the race, refreshments are available at the finish, including hot drinks and homemade pastries. The event is suitable for runners with a reasonable level of training, who take part at their own risk. Registration is online, preferably through the Brdský pohár.
course_highlights: Forest paths through the varied terrain of Dražovka forest park
Start by the children’s playground on Lesní Street in Hořovice
Refreshments at the finish, including tea, coffee, homemade pastries, and fruit
additional: Registration is online, preferably through the Brdský pohár. Runners take part at their own risk. Hot refreshments and homemade pastries are available at the finish after the race.

name: Husínský kros
location: Tajanov, Klatovy District, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic
description: Husínský Cross is a traditional and prestigious cross-country race held every spring since 2012 in Tajanov near Klatovy. The race was created as a replacement for the discontinued Klatovská patnáctka and takes place in the birthplace of Czech running legend Vlastík Zwiefelhofer, who serves as chief referee. Men run three laps, while women and girls run two. Each lap is approximately 3.6 km long and follows forest paths for two-thirds of the course and smooth asphalt for one-third. Since 2022, runners have once again followed the original, longer route around the perimeter of the Husín forest.
course_highlights: Approximately 3.6 km lap, mostly on forest paths with smooth asphalt
The course follows the perimeter of the Husín forest
Men run 3 laps; women and girls run 2 laps
additional: The race is part of the Ešus League series in the Klatovy district. Course records are 38:22 for men (2012) and 29:56 for women (2018). The race starts by the courts in Tajanov. The organizer is Jiří Přibík (tel. 608279305).

name: Bakovský půlmaraton
location: Náměstí, Bakov nad Jizerou, Czech Republic
description: The Bakov Half Marathon is a traditional road race with a long history, held in Bakov nad Jizerou. The certified course is exactly 21.097 km long and follows a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality. It offers several refreshment stations. The race starts in the town square at 10:00 and is open to a wide range of runners across different age categories. It is organized by TJ Bakovský půlmaraton with the support of the municipal office and other local organizations.
course_highlights: Certified course measuring 21.097 km
Hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality
Refreshments at 9.7 km, 14.5 km, and at the finish
additional: Registration is also available on race day at the venue for 400 Kč. Check-in takes place from 8:00 to 9:45, approximately 150 m from the start. Categories are divided by age for men and women. Cash and in-kind prizes are offered, including bonuses for breaking records. The course records are 1:05:01 for men and 1:17:46 for women. According to the available description, advance registration has a lower entry fee than registration on race day.

name: Run for ProCit

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Na místě 600 Kč registrace 8:30–10:00 · hotovost i karta

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Na místě 600 Kč registrace 8:30–10:00 · hotovost i karta

description: Run for ProCit is a charity family run held in Borský Park in Plzeň, supporting families of children with autism. The event offers three distances: a children’s run of up to 600 metres, a 2 km run suitable for Nordic walking, and a 5 km run. Dogs are welcome (canicross), and the course follows flat loops with an optional colour zone. Entry fees go directly towards educational and sport-and-relaxation stays for families with children on the autism spectrum. The atmosphere is relaxed and free of competitive pressure, making the event suitable for all ages and for runners with strollers or trekking poles.
course_highlights: Flat loops in Borský Park
Optional colour zone along the course
Dog-friendly run (canicross) and Nordic walking with an instructor
additional: On-site registration is available from 8:30 to 10:00, with payment by cash or card. The entry fee includes a commemorative medal and prizes for the three fastest runners. The programme includes children’s runs at 10:00 and 10:10, the 2 km start at 10:15 and the 5 km start at 10:45, followed by the results ceremony and a raffle at 11:30. The run is also suitable for runners with strollers and walkers with trekking poles. This charity event supports families with children on the autism spectrum; runners with dogs are welcome.

name: Dačická 14
location: Rybník Peráček, Dačice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Dačická 14 is a traditional running race in Dačice, with a main course measuring 14 kilometres. The event also offers courses and categories for children and young people, so runners of different age groups can take part. The route crosses mixed terrain, following field and forest paths as well as paved sections. The event is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup.
course_highlights: Main course: 14 km
Mixed surface with field and forest paths as well as paved sections
Separate courses and categories for children and young people
additional: Race facilities are listed near Peráček Pond in Dačice.

name: ŘepoRun
description: Řepo Run is a running race held in Prague, offering courses for children and adults. The race route goes through the area around Řeporyje and is suitable for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the enthusiastic group of runners Run Labe Run, who want to offer a high-quality sporting experience. All participants receive a race pack and a medal after finishing; the winners receive prizes from sponsors.
course_highlights: The route goes through the area around Řeporyje
Children’s races: 200 m, 600 m and 1,300 m
Chip timing using a chip on the race bib
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:00 to 11:45, depending on the category. Time is measured by a chip on the back of the race bib, which does not need to be returned.
