A bag drop and changing room are available. Using public transport is recommended due to limited parking. On-site registration is possible until capacity is reached.

name: Děčín RunFest
description: Děčín RUNFEST 2027 is a spring running festival in the heart of Bohemian Switzerland, offering a fast, certified course along the Elbe River and a family-friendly atmosphere at the event base on Mariánská Meadow. The race is for a broad running community, from elite distance runners to beginners and children. The festival combines athletic performances with a community spirit and an accompanying program that appeals not only to competitors but also to their families and friends. Mariánská Meadow provides an ideal setting with beautiful views of Děčín Castle and the Elbe River.
course_highlights: Certified, extremely fast course along the Elbe River
Event base at Mariánská Meadow with views of Děčín Castle
Family-friendly atmosphere and accompanying program for all age groups
additional: Registration and results are managed through the RaceTeam system. The race is inclusive and also offers activities for supporters and families. Places in the main races often sell out in advance, so early registration is recommended. The program also includes Nordic Walking.

name: Kotva race
description: Kotva Race is an OCR race held in Děčín, offering a challenging obstacle course for competitors born in 2011 or earlier. The race is known for its demanding course, and competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Registration is available online and on-site for an increased entry fee. Competitors must sign a liability waiver and follow the race rules.
course_highlights: A challenging OCR course with obstacles in Děčín’s natural surroundings
Open only to competitors born in 2011 or earlier
Competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 11:30 to 12:15 for the children’s race, for an increased entry fee. Competitors under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian and sign a liability waiver (REVERZ). Information about the courses, prices, and registration published on the website applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 17 April 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Žákovský běh Bakovem
location: Atletická dráha u základní školy, Bakov nad Jizerou, Czech Republic
organizer: Školní sportovní klub při ZŠ Bakov nad Jizerou
description: The Bakov Schoolchildren’s Run is a traditional children’s running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou since 2002. Races take place on the athletics track by the primary school, with courses run in laps of approximately 300 metres. There are several age categories, from preschoolers to juniors, including relays. The event is held alongside the Bakov Half Marathon and is known for its friendly atmosphere and appearances by prominent athletes as guests. There is no entry fee, and registration takes place at the venue on race day.
course_highlights: Laps around the primary school’s athletics track, approximately 300 m per lap
Run on a paved path; running spikes may be used
Categories from preschoolers to juniors, including 4 × 300 m relays
additional: Registration takes place on race day in the theatre hall on the square and closes 30 minutes before the start of the relevant category. There is no entry fee. Relays have four members, including at least two girls; relay categories are determined by the age of the oldest member. The race is part of the Bakov Half Marathon programme, which starts at 10:00. The top finishers receive diplomas, medals and gifts from sponsors.

name: VALAŠSKÝ TRHÁK
location: Městský park střed, Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: Valašský trhák is a half marathon held in the heart of Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, which comes alive with a sporting atmosphere every spring. The race runs through the town park and offers runners an enjoyable experience in the beautiful surroundings of the Zlín Region. The event is suitable for the general public and brings a traditional sporting occasion with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A half marathon in the town park of Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Beautiful natural and urban surroundings in the Zlín Region
A sporting atmosphere in the heart of the town

name: Běh do vrchu Jiřetín - Jedlová
description: The Jiřetín–Jedlová Uphill Run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Varnsdorf Running Club and held in the beautiful surroundings of Jiřetín pod Jedlovou. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and features a challenging 5.7 km course with 340 m of elevation gain. It starts at the Jiřetín pod Jedlovou sports complex and finishes at the summit of Jedlová Mountain. The race is suitable for a wide range of age categories and offers cash prizes for the top runners, as well as special awards for records.
course_highlights: Course distance: 5.7 km with 340 m of elevation gain
Surface: 10% asphalt, 60% gravel, 30% forest trails
Start at the Jiřetín pod Jedlovou sports complex (434 m above sea level); finish at the summit of Jedlová (774 m above sea level)
additional: Cash prizes are awarded to the top three in each category and for breaking the course record (500 CZK). The fastest man and woman based on the combined times from this race and the race at Studenec receive a 1,000 CZK prize. A running raffle is held, with starting numbers entered into the draw. Runners must wear their race number visibly on the front and participate at their own risk. Basic medical care is provided.

name: Dehtářská 10°
description: Dehtářská 10° is a running race in the Vysočina region, open to the general public and all age groups. It offers 5, 10 and 20 km courses through beautiful countryside with gentle elevation changes. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and its emphasis on personal achievement. It starts at the Kletečná recreational resort near Humpolec, with on-site registration on race day. The main 10 km race has approximately 85 metres of elevation gain and starts at 14:00.
course_highlights: 5, 10 and 20 km courses
Approximately 85 m of elevation gain in the main race
Beautiful Vysočina countryside around the Kletečná recreational resort
additional: Runners can register on race day at the venue from 11:00 to 13:30. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels. Capacity is limited, and registration often fills up quickly.

name: Běh O pohár století
description: The Běh O pohár století is a running race held in the picturesque Castle Park in Pacov. The race features a challenging course full of hills, descents, and turns that tests runners’ endurance and technique. The event is part of Český běh, a Czech Athletics Federation service focused on promoting running and running races in the Czech Republic. Registration is online only, and the race is suitable for the general public, including children.
course_highlights: A 3.2 km course with hills, descents, and turns
The race takes place in Castle Park in Pacov
Children’s races are also held
additional: Registration is online only. The race is part of Český běh, which also offers other running services and races. The course runs along a cinder track and country paths.

name: Bolatická 20
location: Local swimming pool, Bolatice, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatek účastníka pochodu 30kč (děti do a včetně 15 let zdarma).

description: Bolatická dvacítka is a traditional running race and walking event held annually in the area around Bolatice. The race offers 20 km and 10 km courses, mostly through woodland, combining cross-country sections and asphalt. The start and finish are at the local swimming pool. The route is marked in yellow, and the race takes place in regular road traffic, so participants must follow the rules. The event is suitable for runners and hikers, and is followed by a social gathering with country music.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly through woodland around the Strahovské ponds and Chuchelnický Forest
A combination of cross-country sections and asphalt roads
The route is marked in yellow
additional: On-site registration for runners is open from 8:00 to 8:55; those who registered in advance only need to collect their race number. The walk starts between 7:30 and 9:00. From 12:00 after the race, there is a social gathering with the country group CARAVANA. The race takes place in regular road traffic, and participants must follow the rules of the road.

name: Běh kolem Hluboké 25 km - Krajský přebor v silničním běhu
description: The Run Around Hluboká is a traditional regional road-running championship over 25 km, held in the picturesque setting of Hluboká nad Vltavou. The race offers a high-quality course suitable for experienced runners and competitors vying for regional titles. The event is part of the South Bohemian Region athletics calendar and attracts a broad running community.
course_highlights: 25 km road course
Picturesque surroundings of Hluboká nad Vltavou
Part of the regional road-running championship

name: Racio běh kolem Dyje
location: Parkoviště u Racia, Břeclav, Czech Republic
description: RACIO Run Around the Dyje is a traditional running race in Břeclav organized by the TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav Athletics Club. Programs in previous years have included races ranging from 100 meters to the 5-kilometer main race, so both children and adults can take part. The main race runs along the Dyje River, and the start is usually near the parking lot by Racio. The date and details for the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed in the available race information.
course_highlights: 5 km main race
The route runs along the Dyje River
Previous editions also featured children’s races from 100 m to 1,000 m
additional: In 2026, the entry fee for the 5 km race was 50 Kč; all other categories were free. This price has not been confirmed for the 2027 edition.

name: CRAFT Brněnský půlmaraton a Brněnská desítka
location: Brno Velodrome, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The CRAFT Brno Half Marathon and Brno 10K are traditional running races held in the centre of Brno, with the event hub at the Brno Velodrome. The event is open to the general public, from elite runners to recreational athletes, and also includes children’s races. The races have international significance and regularly attract runners of all ages. In addition to the half marathon, 10.5 km and 5 km routes are available, including a relay option.
course_highlights: Event hub at the Brno Velodrome
Road routes of 21.1 km, 10.5 km and 5 km through the city centre
The race is suitable for the general public, including children and veterans
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club project. The first category starts at 10:00, and the main category starts at 11:00. The organisers are BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s. The event also includes children’s races and relays. The race is a traditional event of international significance, attracting runners of all ages.

name: Chřibská – Studenec
description: We invite all runners to the 15th edition of the Cena města Chřibská Studenec Uphill Race, held in the picturesque, rugged terrain of the Lužické hory. The race is suitable for elite competitors as well as recreational runners and serves as a qualifier for the World Mountain Running Championships for youth. The start is in the town square in Chřibská and the finish is at the Studenec lookout tower. The course is 6.1 km long with 397 metres of elevation gain. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Course through the rugged terrain of the Lužické hory
6.1 km long with 397 metres of elevation gain
Finish at the Studenec lookout tower
additional: Registration from 8:30 at the Chřibská Municipal Office. Prizes for the first three finishers in each category and a running raffle. According to the information provided, the start is at 10:00 in the square in Chřibská and registration begins at 8:30 at the Municipal Office.

name: Petřín třikrát jinak
description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where runners tackle Petřín Hill in three different ways: an interval start up the 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, a mass-start uphill run, and an interval climb up a slope on an unpaved path and steps. The total time is the sum of the times from all three races, with bonuses for the top competitors. Children can compete in ten age categories on courses around the Hunger Wall below the tower. The race also offers a relay in which a team of three runners completes all three disciplines.
course_highlights: Interval-start climb up the 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower
1 km uphill run with 118 m of elevation gain, with a mass start
Interval-start 1 km climb up a slope on an unpaved path and steps
additional: Race registration and facilities are in tents near the Petřín Lookout Tower. Interval starts are every 30 seconds, with a break after every 30 runners to allow them to descend from the tower. Children’s races cover 200 m, 365 m and 730 m, with the awards ceremony immediately after the finish. Relay teams consist of 3 runners, each running one discipline, and start together with the individual competitors. Time bonuses also apply to relays. Children’s races include ten age categories, with courses around the Hunger Wall. A three-person relay is also available, with each runner completing one section of the race.

name: Šaratický běh
location: Šaratice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Šaratice Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in the village of Šaratice in the South Moravian Region. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to test themselves on a fast, well-marked course. The main category is scheduled to start in the morning, making for an enjoyable race day in a community setting. The event is organized by the Municipality of Šaratice, which ensures high-quality organization and support. The race is part of the official Czech Running calendar and is open to the general public.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Start and finish by the municipal office in Šaratice
Race in the South Moravian Region with a pleasant setting
additional: The first category starts at 9:00; the main category starts at 10:30. The event is organized by the Municipality of Šaratice. Contact by phone: 606 333 997. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Association’s services for runners and running events.

name: Charitativní běh Karlštejn
location: Karlštejn Castle, Karlštejn, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Karlštejn Charity Run is a sporting event organized by Charita Beroun, giving runners the chance to combine a sporting experience with supporting a good cause. The run takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Gothic Karlštejn Castle and the Velká Amerika quarry, offering a unique combination of adventure and trail running. The start is right in the castle courtyard, and the event is suitable for everyone who wants to run with heart and support Charita Beroun. This year, the run starts at 10:00.
course_highlights: Start right in the courtyard of Karlštejn Castle
Trail run around the Gothic Karlštejn Castle
The route passes by the Velká Amerika quarry
additional: The event is charitable, and the entry fee is donated to Charita Beroun. The run is suitable for all runners who want to combine athletic performance with supporting a good cause. The organizer is Charita Beroun, located at Cajthamlova 169, Beroun.

name: Craft Brněnský půlmaraton | desítka | pětka
description: The Craft Brno Half Marathon offers half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races. The start and finish are at the Brno Velodrome, and the route passes through the BVV exhibition grounds and along the footpath behind the Riviéra swimming pool. The event also includes children’s races at the Velodrome. The race distances let runners choose a course to suit their abilities.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Brno Velodrome
The route passes through the BVV exhibition grounds
Footpath behind the Riviéra swimming pool

name: 15 brodů Bílého potoka
location: Javůrek, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: 15 Fords of the Bílý Potok is an off-road running adventure through the beautiful valley of the Bílý Potok, passing the settlement of Šmelcovna. There are three routes: a 22 km long route with 16 fords, a 15 km medium route with 7 fords, and a non-competitive 7 km short route for those who want to enjoy the race atmosphere. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. It is well marked and suitable for moderately fit athletes. The race is ideal for recreational runners who want to enjoy nature and the challenge of fording streams in one of the most beautiful places near Brno.
course_highlights: Off-road route with 16 fords on the longest, 22 km option
Mainly forest and meadow paths, away from paved roads
A steep 1.7 km climb at the end
additional: The time limit for the long route is 3 hours. The route is thoroughly marked with arrows and course ribbons. Most fords can be bypassed using a footbridge or a log. You can change your route distance during the race. The route surface includes unpaved terrain, gravel paths and asphalt. Three route distances are available: approximately 7 km (non-competitive), 15 km with seven fords, and 22 km, which includes an additional loop and a climb. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours.

name: Silniční běh kolem Hluboké nad Vltavou
location: Stadion TJ Hluboká, Hluboká nad Vltavou, Czech Republic
description: The road race around Hluboká nad Vltavou is a traditional 25 km race that starts and finishes at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The route follows paved cycle paths and third-class roads through picturesque villages such as Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí and Zliv. The race is suited to runners looking for a combination of athletic challenge and a beautiful experience in the South Bohemian Region. It is organized by TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice under the direction of Růžena Smolíková.
course_highlights: 25 km route along paved cycle paths and third-class roads
Passes through the villages of Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí and Zliv
Start and finish at the TJ Hluboká stadium
additional: The race is organized by TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice. The start and finish are at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The organizer is Růžena Smolíková, who can also be contacted by phone.

name: Paskovská devítka
location: Paskov, Frýdek-Místek District, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Hlavní závod a běh pro paskovský zámek

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: Hlavní závod a běh pro paskovský zámek 100 Kč

description: Paskovská Devítka is a traditional running race organized by the town of Paskov, now being held for the eighth year. The event is open to the general public, from young children to adults, and features several categories, including the 9 km main race, youth races, and a non-competitive run for Paskov Castle. This year, the registration and start location for the main race have changed. The race starts at 9:15. The event is an important sporting occasion in the region and also brings traffic restrictions along the route to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9,000 metres
Youth races: 940 m, 480 m, and 160 m for the youngest participants
Non-competitive run for Paskov Castle: 3,000 metres
additional: The race takes place in Paskov, with traffic restrictions on Nádražní, Mírová, Fučíkova, Krátká, U Potoka, Bezručova, Boženy Němcové, Jiřího Wolkra, and U Parku streets from 9:00 to approximately 12:00. Each competitor takes part at their own risk. The race is suitable for all age groups, including the non-competitive run for participants born in 2014 or earlier.

name: Běh Chýní
location: Chýně, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Chýně Run is an athletics race held in the municipality of Chýně in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the running activities of the ASK Dipoli club, which offers professional and recreational training. The event is open to the general public, including youth, juniors, men, and women. It is a traditional part of the regional athletics calendar and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in pleasant surroundings.

name: Běh okolo Češíku
location: Lesní hřbitov, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Češík is a running race held in the beautiful Hradec Králové forests near the Forest Cemetery in Hradec Králové. The event offers children’s categories with shorter distances and a main race for adults. It is suitable for families and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a day of sport in nature. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: Forest “Finnish” running trail in Hradec Králové
The course passes through beautiful woodland
Close to the Forest Cemetery and an outdoor workout area
additional: Children’s categories start between 09:30 and 10:15, followed by the main race between 11:00 and 11:45. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three runners in each category. Results are published within 24 hours of the race. The program includes children’s untimed races and a main race for adults.

name: Prunéřovský půlmaraton
location: Cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice, Kadaň, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s.
description: The Prunéřov Half Marathon is a certified running race held on the cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice. The out-and-back course consists of two laps with minimal elevation gain, making for a fast and enjoyable run. The race is part of the Summer Running Cup and also offers shorter distances for children and young people, with different lengths and turnarounds. It is organised by Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s., which ensures high-quality organisation and runner comfort.
course_highlights: Certified out-and-back course
Two laps with minimal elevation gain
Cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice
additional: Children’s races over shorter distances (250 m, 750 m and 1,500 m) are also available. Registration and payments are handled through the naZávody.cz system, which provides start-list management, automatic categorisation, statistics and other features. Runners can edit their registration themselves, transfer it to another person or invite additional runners.

name: Běh Čedoku
description: The Čedok Run is a 3.7 km race run mostly on asphalt in Prague 4. This run is part of the SABZO series and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a fast, pleasant race in an urban setting. The course is suitable for those who prefer asphalt and want to experience a competitive atmosphere as part of the running community.
course_highlights: 3.7 km course
Mostly asphalt surface
Urban setting in Prague 4

name: Okolo stadionu - silniční pětka
location: Městský stadion Ostrava-Vítkovice, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: Okolo stadionu - Road 5K is a traditional 5 km road race held at Vítkovice Stadium in Ostrava. The race offers a fast course suitable for all runners looking to test their speed on asphalt. It is organized by Sdružení sportovních klubů Vítkovice, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The main category traditionally starts in the early evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 5 km road course
A loop around Vítkovice Stadium in Ostrava
Fast asphalt surface suitable for personal bests
additional: The first category starts at 17:20, and the main category starts at 18:00. The organizer is Sdružení sportovních klubů Vítkovice, z.s.; contact person: Mgr. Šárka Mokrá, telephone 773 004 098. In 2025, the first category set off at 17:20 and the main category at 18:00.

name: 399. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running race organized by the Chrudim Recreational Runners Club at the Monako restaurant in Slatiňany. The race offers 10 km and 3.6 km courses, suitable for the general public and runners of all levels. The event is popular for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of the Pardubice Region.
course_highlights: 10 km and 3.6 km routes
Start and finish at the Monako restaurant in Slatiňany
Scenic surroundings of the Pardubice Region

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Brno – Špilberk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Brno is a charity running event held at Špilberk, offering participants a choice between a 3 km course (2 laps) and a 6 km course (4 laps). The run starts at 9:00 p.m. and is accompanied by a cultural programme, including a concert. The entry fee is 500 CZK, half of which supports the Světluška project and half goes towards direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event is suitable for runners and walkers and is open to anyone who wants to support a good cause.
course_highlights: The course runs through Špilberk, with a choice of 3 km or 6 km distance
A night run with a choice of entry option that includes a headlamp or a sports headband
An accompanying programme, including a concert during registration
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option that includes a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P disability cards receive free entry, but are not entitled to a headlamp or headband. The run has limited capacity for participants’ safety and comfort. A cloakroom and baggage storage are available on site. Medical staff will be present, and participants may also run with a dog (except in Jihlava).

name: Běh okolo Kraví hory

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: The Run around Kraví hora is a traditional race in Brno, offering runners an interesting 2.7 km loop. Men and women run two laps, for a total of 5.4 km, while children can race over a distance suited to their age. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Kraví hora, with refreshments and baggage storage available on site. Men and women start together, and the atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to all age groups.
course_highlights: A 2.7 km loop in the natural surroundings of Kraví hora
Men and women run two laps (5.4 km); children race over an age-appropriate distance
Start and finish by the swimming pool, with refreshments and baggage storage
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 17:15. The children’s race starts at 17:45 and the main race at 18:00. Parking is available in a limited number of spaces near the venue. Public transport is available via bus 68 and tram 4 to Náměstí Míru stop. Water is available for refreshments after the race. Competitors start at their own risk. According to the available information, the entry fee is paid on site during registration.

name: Běh SABZO v Ďáblickém háji
location: Ďáblický háj, Ďáblice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The SABZO Run in Ďáblický Grove is a race in the Prague nature area of Ďáblický Grove. According to the available description, the race features 5.6 km courses for men and 2.8 km courses for women, mostly on forest paths. The race is part of the SABZO series and offers a chance to test your strength on natural terrain.
course_highlights: The routes run mostly along forest paths.
The race takes place in the natural surroundings of Ďáblický Grove.
The stated course distances are 5.6 km for men and 2.8 km for women.

name: Běh na Vysoký kámen
location: Autokempink Jihlava Pávov, Jihlava, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Vysoký kámen is a race in Jihlava held as part of the Běžec Vysočiny series. Race facilities are at Autokempink Jihlava Pávov, and the course runs through the hilly terrain of the Vysočina Region. According to available information, courses of 3.5 km and 10.4 km are offered for various age categories.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain of the Vysočina Region
Courses of 3.5 km and 10.4 km
Race facilities at Autokempink Jihlava Pávov

name: Běh na Rozálku
location: Rozálka, Žamberk, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Žamberk, SVČ ANIMO a SK Žamberk
description: Běh na Rozálku is a traditional uphill race held in Žamberk, welcoming runners of all ages. There’s something for adults and children alike, with shorter courses available for younger participants. The main race starts individually at 20-second intervals. Refreshments and awards for the winners round off the race afternoon.
course_highlights: An uphill run to Žamberk’s Rozálka hill
Individual starts for the main race at 20-second intervals
Shorter courses for the youngest children
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX CUP series; winners receive diplomas and prizes.

name: Trhovosvinenská padesátka
location: Buškův hamr, Trhové Sviny, Czech Republic
description: Trhovosvinenská Padesátka is a long-distance walk through the Trhové Sviny region and its surroundings, offering two main routes of 50 km and 100 km. The event is intended for both hikers and runners, who can choose their start time. The route passes through picturesque countryside, with several refreshment stations, and finishes at the historic Buškův hamr site in Trhové Sviny. The organizers emphasize safety, compliance with traffic rules, and environmental protection. The walk has a long tradition and is popular with both locals and visitors to the region.
course_highlights: The route crosses the Trhové Sviny region and offers scenic views
Refreshment stations along the route (2 on the 50 km route, 4 on the 100 km route)
Finish at the historic Buškův hamr site
additional: The start time for the 50 km route can be chosen freely between 6:00 and 9:00; the 100 km route is a long-distance event, starting at 21:00 for walkers and 22:00 for runners. Mandatory equipment includes a charged mobile phone, a working headlamp, and reflective elements as required by law. Refreshments along the route include water, drinks, fruit, chocolate, and slices of cake. Sausages are available at the finish. Dogs are allowed, provided the rules are followed. The organizers ask participants to respect nature and comply with traffic rules and the Forest Act. The walk is intended for both hikers and runners and takes place in all weather. There are refreshment stations along the routes; refreshments and overnight accommodation are available at the finish.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Kuřim
location: Kuřim, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Excalibur Race MOON Kuřim is an OCR race offering a challenging and varied course around Kuřim. The race combines a quiet forest, Srpek Pond, the challenging Zlobice hill, and the mysterious atmosphere of Kuřim Stonehenge. The course is ideally mixed with flat sections, hills, forest trails, and water sections that will test every brave knight. The main category starts in the evening at 20:30, adding a unique atmosphere to the race.
course_highlights: Quiet forest and Srpek Pond
The challenging Zlobice hill
The mysterious atmosphere of Kuřim Stonehenge
additional: The race is an OCR event and starts in the evening. The course combines flat sections, hills, forest trails, and water sections. It is organized by Překážkové sporty, z. s., Jan Kolář.

name: Brnišťský půlmaraton
description: The Brniště Half Marathon is a traditional running event in the area around the village of Brniště, offering several races, including a half marathon, a shorter run, a relay race and Nordic Walking. The routes pass through the scenic countryside of Podralsko, combining paved and off-road sections and taking runners past ponds, through the forest and along village roads. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in races across several age categories. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and support from the local community, creating an unforgettable experience for runners.
course_highlights: The route passes through Brniště, along the Water Goblin Trail, past ponds and grazing horses
The course is approximately half paved and half off-road
There are three refreshment stations along the course, including a newly added station on the village green by the Ekocentrum Včelín
additional: The first children’s race starts at 10:00, and the main race starts at 12:00. The entry fee includes a drink, a protein bar, a commemorative medal and small prizes from the organizers and sponsors. Runners who register by the end of March also receive a technical T-shirt with the BPM logo. Changing rooms with showers, baggage storage, three refreshment stations for competitors and food stalls for the public are available. The courses are marked with colored arrows, and course marshals are stationed at intersections. Competitors run at their own risk; traffic is not completely restricted.

name: ČEZ RunTour České Budějovice
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour in České Budějovice is a family-friendly running event offering distances for recreational runners and elite athletes: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in Přemysl Otakar II Square and is part of a series of eight races across the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the run but also a family-friendly programme and quality services, including a race pack, refreshments and medical support. Every runner contributes to charity by taking part, giving the event a sense of purpose and a friendly atmosphere.

name: POŠUK – Pošemberský ultra kros
location: Údolí Šembery, Český Brod, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Klub pro sportovce a cyklisty českobrodska
description: The Pošemberský Ultra Kros is a challenging running race in the beautiful Šembera Valley near Český Brod. The 16 km course features 500 metres of elevation gain and runs 85% through forest and 15% on roads. The race is for fans of cross-country and trail running who want to experience sweat, mud and tears, as well as panoramic views, climbs and descents. The start and finish are on a meadow deep in the forest, adding to the race’s relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: 16 km course with 500 m of elevation gain
85% forest terrain, 15% road
Panoramic spots, climbs and descents in the Šembera Valley
additional: The race starts on a meadow deep in the forest between Český Brod and Doubravčice, in the direction of Kostelec. The race is organised by the Club for Athletes and Cyclists of the Český Brod Region. The course is challenging, with 500 m of elevation gain, and combines forest and road sections. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere awaits on the start and finish meadow.

name: Vysocký krosový půlmaraton
location: Vysoká u Holic, Pardubice District, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vysoká Cross-Country Half Marathon is a traditional running race in Vysoká u Holic, featuring a challenging cross-country course in the beautiful Polabí countryside. The 21.1 km main race consists of three laps through forest terrain, with no asphalt, making it one of the hilliest half marathons in the region. Shorter 7 km and 3 km options are also available, suitable for a wide range of runners. The organisers emphasise both the sporting challenge and the friendly atmosphere that has attracted runners for fifteen years. The start and finish are located at the sports field in Vysoká u Holic.
course_highlights: The main course consists of three 7 km laps through forest terrain, with no asphalt
Shorter 7 km and 3 km options are also available
The course is considered the hilliest half marathon in Polabí
additional: In-person registration is required at the start venue from 8:30 to 9:45. Race numbers are non-refundable; the chip must be returned after finishing. The time limit for the main race is 3 hours. The organiser donates CZK 33 from each entry fee to Základní škola speciální Neratov. The race sponsor awards a financial amount for every kilometre run.

name: Obřanský kros
description: Obřanský kros is a traditional running race organized by Orel unit Brno-Obřany, bringing together athletes of all generations. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Obřany and is part of activities that support sports education and community life. The event is suitable for children and adults and emphasizes fair play and the joy of sport. Obřanský kros is an important sporting event in the South Moravian Region.
course_highlights: A traditional running race in the Obřany area
Suitable for all age groups
Organized as part of the sporting activities of Orel unit Brno-Obřany
additional: The race is part of the broader sporting activities of Orel unit Brno-Obřany, which also include other sports and cultural events. Registration forms are available in PDF and DOC format on the website. Results from previous editions are published regularly.

name: Běh Přerovským luhem
location: Restaurace Base Camp, Kainarova 3260/13a, Přerov, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Přerovský luh is a hiking race organized by the Czech Tourist Club in the beautiful natural surroundings of Přerovský luh. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy active movement outdoors and is part of the KČT calendar of major hiking events. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and the region’s hiking tradition in the Olomouc Region.
course_highlights: The route runs through the picturesque woodland of Přerovský luh
A natural, peaceful setting ideal for running and hiking
Part of the Czech Tourist Club’s calendar of major events
additional: The source gives conflicting time limits: 80 minutes in the text and 100 minutes in the meta description.

name: Cross Coutry Race – Hruboskalský půlmaraton
location: Kemp Sedmihorky, Sedmihorky, Karlovice, Czech Republic
description: The Hruboskalský Half Marathon is a running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Český ráj, at Sedmihorky campsite. It offers two main routes: a half marathon of approximately 21 km with 500 m of elevation gain, and a shorter route of around 12.5 km with 300 m of elevation gain. The course follows both paved and unpaved roads, trails, and, in places, stairs and rocks, making for varied and challenging terrain. The race is suited to nature lovers and trail runners, who will appreciate the marked, safe course and refreshment stations. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a raffle, all in the friendly atmosphere of Sedmihorky campsite.
course_highlights: A rolling route with 500 m of elevation gain (21 km) and 300 m (12 km)
The course follows paved and unpaved roads and trails, with stairs and rocks
Every kilometre of the half-marathon course is marked for reference, and the route is clearly marked with streamers and signs
additional: The start and finish are at Sedmihorky campsite, where parking is available (50 Kč/car); you can also arrive by train or bus (1.3 km from the stop). Changing tents, luggage storage, toilets, and hot showers (20 Kč per use via a machine) are available for participants. Weekend stays and trips around Český ráj are also available at the campsite. Participants will receive payment instructions by email after registering; payment must be made within three days or the registration will be cancelled. The awards ceremony and raffle take place after the race.

name: Běh na rozhlednu Veselý vrch
location: Prostřední Lhota, Chotilsko, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Veselý vrch Lookout Tower is a forest cross-country race run mostly over trails along the Vltava River in the Chotilsko–Prostřední Lhota area. The race is 5.3 km long and suitable for all age groups, including children, who start shortly after the main category. The organizer is Libuše Vlachynská, who ensures a friendly atmosphere and smooth organization. The race is part of Český běh, a set of services provided by the Czech Athletics Federation for runners and running in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: Forest cross-country terrain along the Vltava River
Course length: 5.3 km
Suitable for children, who have their own start
additional: Children start at 10:35, shortly after the main category. The event is a cross-country/trail race and is part of Český běh, which also offers other services for runners and organizers. The event also has separate children’s categories. The main race traditionally starts at 10:30.

name: Posázavská trilogie
location: Týnec nad Sázavou, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Posázaví Trilogy is a multi-discipline race combining running, water and cycling around the Sázava River. It starts in Týnec nad Sázavou, and the route passes through Hradištko and Pikovice. Individuals and pairs can take part; the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and retro refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Start in Týnec nad Sázavou
The route passes through Hradištko and Pikovice
Combines running, water and cycling
additional: The race is open to individuals and pairs and offers retro refreshments after the finish.

name: Běh veltruským parkem 2026
location: Areál letního kina Veltrusy, Veltrusy, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Veltrusy Park is a traditional race for children and adults, held in the picturesque grounds of Veltrusy Chateau Park. The event offers a pleasant spring atmosphere and the chance to enjoy sport for all age groups. Hundreds of runners take part each year, including families with children, and the race is known for its friendly, community atmosphere. It is suitable for beginners as well as experienced runners, who can enjoy the park’s beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of Veltrusy Chateau Park
Categories for children and adults, with different course distances
A pleasant spring atmosphere and a community event
additional: The race has categories for children and adults, with distances ranging from 50 m to 10 km. In 2026, a record 432 runners took part, including 291 children. Results are published online, including live results during the race. Registration for 2027 will open in February 2027. The race takes place at the Veltrusy open-air cinema grounds.

name: Prčický 1/2 maraton
location: TJ Sokol Sedlec-Prčice, Sedlec-Prčice, Czech Republic
description: The Prčický Half Marathon is a road race organized by TJ Sokol Sedlec-Prčice, offering distances of 21.097 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km. All races start and finish at the same location in the TJ Sokol grounds, creating a friendly, family atmosphere for both runners and spectators. Fan zones along the route cheer on runners and contribute to a special experience. The race is suitable for the general public and supports the running community in the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Road race distances of 21.097 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Sedlec-Prčice grounds
Fan zones along the route to support runners
additional: All races start and finish at the same location, creating a great atmosphere for runners and spectators. The organizer is TJ Sedlec Prčice; the contact person is Michal Davídek. There are fan zones along the route, and the race also offers shorter distances for different ability levels.

name: MUTRAVERZ – MIKULOVSKÝ ULTRA TRAIL RUN
location: Mikulov, Teplice District, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAVERZ - Mikulov Ultra Trail Run is an extreme ultra-trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Ore Mountains in Mikulov. The race is intended for experienced runners over 18 who want to experience challenging terrain and beautiful natural scenery. The organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and high-quality organization so that participants can fully enjoy the atmosphere and challenge of the race. The race is part of the MUTR series, which has become popular among running enthusiasts in the region.
course_highlights: Off-road ultra trail in the Ore Mountains
Hiking-marked trails
Challenging mountain conditions with high-altitude features
additional: The race is open only to people over 18. Participants must be physically and mentally fit and are required to follow the race rules, including those on safety and fair play. The organizer is not responsible for the condition of the course or for any damage or injuries. Runners consent to audiovisual recording of their performance for the purpose of promoting the race.

name: TRAIL HRADEC KRÁLOVÉ
description: Trail Hradec Králové is a race that takes you into nature, with varied courses offering a challenge for your legs and stunning views of the surrounding countryside. Every step takes you through beautiful forest hideaways that you’ll fall in love with. Get ready for a true running experience combining nature, movement and the joy of running at 100%. The race offers an original medal, a race pack, an electronic timing chip, and an accompanying programme with prizes for the best finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Varied nature trails with views of the surrounding countryside
Beautiful forest hideaways
A running experience combining nature and movement
additional: The race pack includes an original medal, a Gladiator Race-branded gift, a race bib and an electronic timing chip. Changing rooms, bag storage, toilets, medical services, refreshments during the race and at the finish, photos and a downloadable certificate are available (photos are not guaranteed for everyone). Parking is available near the race centre. Gladiator Race clothing is also available for purchase, alongside an accompanying programme.

name: Dobroběh Slováckem  – Bílovice
location: Sportovní areál u Základní školy, Bílovice, Czech Republic
description: Dobroběh Slováckem in Bílovice is a running race held at the sports grounds by the elementary school in Bílovice. It offers an 11 km main race with gentle elevation and a separate 5 km race, suitable for various age groups. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need written consent from their legal guardians. Registration is available online and on-site on race day, with entry fees offered in several price brackets. The event has a friendly atmosphere and promotes sporting activity in the Slovácko region.
course_highlights: 11 km main race with 38 m of elevation gain and 38 m of descent
Separate 5 km race with 31 m of elevation gain and 31 m of descent
Start and finish at the sports grounds by the elementary school in Bílovice
additional: Race-day check-in takes place from 8:45 to 9:45 at the sports grounds by the elementary school. Runners receive a timing chip and refreshment vouchers. Participants under 18 must have written consent from their legal guardians. The on-site entry fee does not include a race package. Registration is also available on race day. Race-day check-in is scheduled from 8:45 to 9:45. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need written consent from a legal guardian. The race package includes a timing chip and refreshments.

name: Obora Trail Run
location: Dolní Lhota u Ostravy, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní a Kulturní spolek Dolní Lhota, z.s.
description: Obora Trail Run is a challenging nine-hour extreme endurance trail race held in Dolní Lhota near Ostrava. Participants complete as many 5 km laps as possible on demanding terrain. The race starts at 9 a.m. and ends at 6 p.m. The organizers provide facilities at the start and finish, including a party tent for resting, and recommend bringing your own sleeping mat or blanket for added comfort. The race is open only to individuals over 18 and emphasizes fair play and safety.
course_highlights: Nine-hour continuous trail race
5 km loop on demanding terrain
Headlamps are mandatory from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m.
additional: Headlamps are mandatory from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. Bringing your own sleeping mat and blanket is recommended. The race is limited to 50 participants. Runners must wear their race number visibly on their outer layer throughout the race.

name: Nížkovský běh u koupaliště
description: Nížkov Run by the Swimming Pool is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Nížkov and held every spring by the swimming pool in Nížkov. The race has a long-standing tradition and is popular with both local and visiting runners. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the pleasant natural surroundings of the Vysočina region and is part of the activities of the local Sokol association. The organizers focus on a friendly atmosphere and high-quality race organization.
course_highlights: A cross-country race in the natural surroundings by the swimming pool in Nížkov
A traditional spring date, usually one week after the Easter holidays
Organized by TJ Sokol Nížkov, with a long-standing tradition
additional: The race is part of the activities of TJ Sokol Nížkov, which has a rich history and tradition in the physical education movement. Nížkov Run is held as part of Sokol’s sporting events and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization. The organizers also hold other athletics races and events in the region.

name: Rychlebský maraton
description: The Rychlebský Marathon is a popular trail ultramarathon that takes you along a network of superb mountain trails to the most remote parts of the Rychlebské Mountains, the most forgotten mountains in the Czech Republic. The race offers routes of various lengths, passing through deep valleys, remote ridges and beautiful viewpoints, including the highest peak of the adjacent Góry Bialskie in Poland. The routes are mainly on forest trails and paths, with minimal asphalt, making for a challenging yet scenically rewarding experience. The event also includes an evening programme of talks and entertainment, adding to the race’s sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A network of superb mountain trails in the Rychlebské Mountains
Routes passing through deep valleys, remote ridges and mountain meadows
Views from deserted rocky outcrops and a route passing over the highest peak of the Góry Bialskie in Poland
additional: Parking is available around the venue in Račí údolí, including a paid car park with a bus to the venue. Competitors are divided into two age categories (up to 39 and 40 and over) on all routes. Registration fees are non-refundable, and registration changes are not possible after the specified deadline. The routes are mainly on forest trails, with minimal asphalt; the race is challenging and scenically attractive.

name: Běh na Mědník
description: The Run to Mědník is a sporting event held in the Ore Mountains, with the event hub and registration at the Fénix Restaurant in the village of Měděnec. Runners are transported by bus to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří. The event offers beautiful running experiences amid the picturesque scenery of the Ore Mountains and is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts alike.
course_highlights: Start in Klášterec nad Ohří
Runners are transported by bus from Měděnec to the start
Picturesque scenery of the Ore Mountains
additional: The event hub and registration are at the Fénix Restaurant in the village of Měděnec. At 10:15, runners are transported by bus to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří. Bus transport for runners from Měděnec to the start in Klášterec nad Ohří.

name: VC Krkonoš Horní Maršov - Pomezní Boudy
location: Horní Maršov to Pomezní sedlo, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: VC Krkonoš Horní Maršov - Pomezní Boudy is a mountain trail race with 540 meters of elevation gain. It starts in Horní Maršov and finishes at the former customs house on Pomezní sedlo at an elevation of 1,050 m above sea level. The course is 13.6 km long, and the race is suitable for anyone who enjoys uphill running. A cross-country race is also held for children and young people, making the event appealing to families. The race is organized by Jiří Kostadinov and is part of the official Czech Athletics Federation race calendar.
course_highlights: Mountain trail race with 540 meters of elevation gain
Finish at the former customs house on Pomezní sedlo at 1,050 m above sea level
Course length: 13.6 km

name: Bratčická desítka
location: Bratčice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Bratčická desítka is a running race held in the village of Bratčice in the South Moravian Region. It offers a main 10 km race and a 6.5 km accompanying run. The course is 80% on field and forest paths and 20% on asphalt. The main category traditionally starts at 11:00, and the entry fee includes lunch and refreshments at the finish. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable run in nature with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 80% field and forest paths
20% asphalt
Main race: 10 km; accompanying race: 6.5 km
additional: The first category starts at 9:00; the main category starts at 11:00. The event is organized by the Municipality of Bratčice and Roman Mazal (contact: 602 280 394).

name: Běh Semicemi
location: Semice, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Semice Run is a traditional running race organized by Semice Elementary School in the Nymburk District. The race has a long history and is held regularly in spring. Participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere and a sporting experience in the picturesque surroundings of Semice. The race is open to the general public, including children, young people, and adults. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the school’s official website.

name: O Krušovický soudek
location: Památný dub sv. Václava, Stochov, Czech Republic
description: We invite all runners and spectators to the traditional Krušovický Soudek cross-country race, held in the picturesque surroundings of Stochov. The race starts at the memorial oak of St. Wenceslas and follows a 20 km route along country and forest paths, partly on asphalt, finishing at the Krušovice Brewery grounds. The winner receives the Krušovický Soudek travelling trophy. Registration opens at 8:00 at the Sokol hall in Stochov, and the race starts at 9:30.
course_highlights: 20 km route along country and forest paths
Start at the memorial oak of St. Wenceslas
Finish in the courtyard of the Krušovice Brewery
additional: Runners can register from 8:00 at the Sokol hall in Stochov. The Krušovický Soudek travelling trophy is the main prize for the winner. The winner receives the Krušovický Soudek travelling trophy.

name: Memoriál Quida Štěpánka
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: The Quido Štěpánek Memorial is a traditional running race held in Jablonné nad Orlicí and part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers various categories for adults and young people and is known for its high-quality organization and atmosphere. Participants can expect challenging courses with beautiful views and the chance to earn points toward the cup. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from the youngest participants to veterans.
course_highlights: Various course distances from 0.25 km to 7.5 km
Challenging terrain with uphill running courses
Part of the ISCAREX Cup, with points awarded in categories
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup series and awards points by category. Winners in each category receive an ISCAREX Cup trophy. The race has a long history, with more than 4,200 participants in previous editions. In previous editions, prizes included goods and cash; the programme and course distances may vary from year to year.

name: Běh Škarmanem, memoriál Vladimíra Reta a Marka Kubalíka
organizer: Školní policejní středisko, SKP Psohlavec, SKP Domažlice
description: Běh Škarmanem, the memorial race for Vladimír Ret and Marek Kubalík, is a cross-country race through the area around Domažlice in the Plzeň Region. Men run a 5.1 km course and women a 3.4 km course. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves in a natural setting with varied terrain. The event honors notable members of the running community and supports the region’s sporting tradition.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Domažlice
5.1 km for men and 3.4 km for women
Part of the Běžec Chodska Cup

name: Montacké vlny
description: Montacké vlny is part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP series, which brings together traditional road and trail races in the Náchod region. The event offers a 7.5 km main course with 230 m of elevation gain through Montace forest park, along a varied route combining asphalt, dirt, and grass. Shorter courses from 150 m to 3.8 km are available for children and juniors, making the event suitable for all ages and levels of running experience. The event takes place at the PRIMÁTOR brewery grounds in Náchod and includes a wide-ranging athletics program for children.
course_highlights: Main 7.5 km course with 230 m of elevation gain through Montace forest park
Varied course surface: asphalt, dirt, and grass
Children’s and junior categories with courses from 150 m to 3.8 km
additional: The race office opens at 8:15 at the brewery grounds. Children’s categories start in sequence from 9:15 to 10:15. The 7.5 km main race and the 3.8 km fitness race start together at 11:00. Medals and prizes are prepared for the top runners, and the youngest competitors will receive a reward. The first runner to enter the second lap of the main race will win a gift pack of beer. A non-competitive athletics program for children takes place on the grounds from 9:00 to 11:00. The program also includes shorter races for children and juniors at the PRIMÁTOR brewery.

name: Modřany Ravine Run!
location: Louka U Liščích děr, Brunelova 960/12, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Modřany Ravine Run is a traditional running race in Modřanská Rokle Nature Park in Prague, with courses suitable for the whole family. The race follows hilly routes linking the former villages of Libuš, Cholupice and Písnice, mostly along forest and field paths, with several steep climbs and descents. Adults can choose between two main courses: a tougher 10 km route with 215 m of elevation gain and an easier 6 km route with 110 m of elevation gain. The youngest children can run 50 metres accompanied by their parents. The event is part of the Modřany Running Triathlon, a series of three races for different age and ability categories.
course_highlights: Hilly routes through Modřanská Rokle Nature Park linking Libuš, Cholupice and Písnice
Forest and field paths with several steep climbs and descents
Two main adult courses: 10 km with 215 m of elevation gain and 6 km with 110 m of elevation gain
additional: The youngest children, up to 4 years old, can run the 50 m course accompanied by their parents. After the race, diplomas, medals, prizes and light refreshments are provided. The event is part of the Modřany Running Triathlon, which has no entry fee for children and a low fee for adults. Changing rooms are available. After the winners’ awards, there is a campfire gathering with the option to roast food. The race is part of the Modřany Running Triathlon, which comprises three races held throughout the year, with shared scoring and an overall awards ceremony.

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v běhu do vrchu – Contica běh na Radhošť 2026
location: Kemp Rožnov, Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Czech Republic
description: Contica Run to Radhošť 2026 is the 3rd Moravia and Silesia Mountain Running Championships, held at Kemp Rožnov pod Radhoštěm. The race is part of the 40th edition of the Krakonoš Czech Cup in Mountain Running and features a challenging 6.5 km course with 734 metres of elevation gain. The start is at the Rožnov campsite and the finish is by the chapel on Radhošť at an elevation of 1,129 m above sea level. The race is open to all runners over 15 and offers categories by age and gender. The event also includes an accompanying programme and children’s races.
course_highlights: 6.5 km course with 734 m of elevation gain
The first kilometre is on asphalt, followed by rocky terrain and forest paths
Finish by the chapel on Radhošť at an elevation of 1,129 m above sea level
additional: Transport of belongings to the finish is provided by car from the start at 9:30; transport for people is not provided. The award ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:00 in the campsite grounds. Vehicles are prohibited from driving to the summit of Radhošť without a permit. Runners compete at their own risk; participants under 15 may take part only with written consent from a legal guardian. The race is intended for participants aged 15 and over; children’s races are also part of the programme. According to the available information, refreshments, chip timing and a participant medal are provided.

name: Vratislavický Běhoun 2026
location: Koupaliště Sluníčko, Vratislavice nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Vratislavický Běhoun is a traditional cross-country race, held for the 32nd year at the Sluníčko swimming pool complex in Vratislavice nad Nisou. The courses run mainly along field and forest paths, with a short section on asphalt, offering a pleasant running experience in a natural setting. The race is also part of the Mayor of Vratislavice nad Nisou’s Traveling Cup and is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages. The event is organized by RunBo Team, which ensures the race runs smoothly and has a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The courses follow field and forest paths, with a short section on asphalt
Start and finish at the Sluníčko swimming pool complex in Vratislavice nad Nisou
A long-standing cross-country race (32nd edition)
additional: The start and finish for all categories are at the Sluníčko swimming pool complex. The race is part of the Mayor of Vratislavice nad Nisou’s Traveling Cup.

name: Hodinovka Veselí nad Lužnicí
location: Veselí nad Lužnicí, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hodinovka Veselí nad Lužnicí is an hourly race organized by the South Bohemian Marathon Club and held on a tartan surface in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a one-hour run with precise performance measurement. This traditional event is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners looking to improve their endurance and pacing strategy in a timed race. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.
course_highlights: One-hour race on a tartan track
Precise performance measurement over 1 hour
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: The race counts toward the South Bohemian Running Cup standings. It is organized by Martin Gazda, the cup manager. Results and photos from previous editions are available. The organizer can be contacted with any questions. The race starts at 10:00. The race is organized by Martin Gazda.

name: Bělkovický kros
location: Bělkovice-Lašťany, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Bělkovický Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bělkovice-Lašťany near Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners and gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves in a fitness and performance run. The Liga stovkařů club is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who have their own race series.
course_highlights: Run in the natural surroundings of Bělkovice-Lašťany
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners
Traditional endurance race with a long history

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run of the Metropolis, Prague 6 District, is part of a series of public running races held across Prague’s city districts. The series promotes a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race is open to all ages, from children to seniors, as well as to people with disabilities, who represent their district. Every participant contributes points to their district’s score in the series. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, and original medals for each category serve as a memento of the race.
course_highlights: Ladronka Park in Prague 6
Part of the Run of the Metropolis running series
Runners represent their city district
additional: The race is part of a series in which each participant represents the district where they have permanent residence and contributes to the competition to find Prague’s most athletic district. Special medals are prepared for each category as a memento of the race.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
location: Říčany, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Říčany Forest Half Marathon is a cross-country and trail race through the picturesque countryside around Říčany near Prague. It offers 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km courses suitable for runners of different abilities. The race is organized by Jan Kalkus and is part of the Czech Running Club under the Czech Athletics Federation. The main category traditionally starts at 11:00, and the race attracts runners looking for an enjoyable run in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail courses
Course distances of 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km
Picturesque countryside around Říčany near Prague
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletics Federation. The organizer is Jan Kalkus. Entry fees start at CZK 329. The race offers several course distances suitable for different runners. The listed start time for the main category is 11:00.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Abertamy
location: Abertamy, Karlovy Vary Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s., Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím Abertamy is part of a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The event offers a 7 km main running race, an experience route of 20 to 30 km with participants choosing their own route using a map, a walk with checkpoint hunting, and children’s races of various distances. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children, seniors, and nature lovers. It starts in Abertamy, a town with a rich history and beautiful nature at an altitude of around 900 metres.
course_highlights: 7 km main race in the Ore Mountains
20–30 km experience route, with participants choosing their own course using a map
Children’s races from 200 m to 1,400 m, plus a walk with checkpoint hunting
additional: Registration opens at 07:00. The experience route starts between 07:30 and 08:00, with individual start times. The main canicross race starts between 08:15 and 08:45, also with individual start times. Prize-giving takes place from 11:00 (canicross, children’s races, walking and dog trekking) and at approximately 13:00 (running and the experience route). The course for the experience route and the walk/dog trek is available at registration before the start. Routes are available for children according to age category, and the main race course is also suitable for runners with dogs.

name: Štěpánkovický kros
location: Štěpánkovice, Opava District, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Štěpánkovice Cross is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Štěpánkovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers two courses, 12.1 km and 6 km long, which run mainly over natural terrain and trail sections. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a community sporting event. The organizer is a local sports club with a long tradition, and the race is part of the official Czech Running calendar.
course_highlights: Two courses: 12.1 km and 6 km
Cross-country and trail character
The surroundings of Štěpánkovice and the local countryside
additional: The organizer is TJ Sokol Štěpánkovice. Contact: Jiří Bořucký, phone 773 482 572. The race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners and running events in the Czech Republic.

name: Chrastavská desítka
description: Chrastava Ten is a successful 10 km running race starting from 1 May Square in Chrastava. The first edition took place at the end of August, and the course was very popular with runners. The race is held under the auspices of the town of Chrastava and offers a pleasant road course suitable for the general public.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre road course
Start and finish at 1 May Square in Chrastava
Pleasant weather and a course popular with runners

name: Sherwood kros
location: Porubský les, Ostrava-Poruba, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: Sherwood Cross-Country is a running race held in Poruba Forest in Ostrava-Poruba. The course runs mainly along unpaved forest paths through natural, more challenging terrain. The race is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts, and running shoes with suitable tread for cross-country and trail running are recommended. The event also includes children’s races on a paved loop near Porubská Myslivna, with children competing in different age categories. The main race is divided into categories by age and gender, and every participant who completes the course receives an original finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Race mainly along unpaved forest paths in Poruba Forest
Children’s races on a paved loop near Porubská Myslivna
Challenging natural terrain suited to trail-running shoes
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited to 400. The children’s races start at 10:00, with approximately 10-minute intervals between categories. The children’s category awards ceremony is at 11:00, and the main race starts at 12:00. Every participant who completes the race receives an original finisher’s medal; children also receive a sweet treat. Trophies and prizes are prepared for category winners. The main race has age and gender categories. Everyone who completes the course receives a finisher’s medal; winners receive trophies and prizes.

name: Přeštická desítka
description: Přeštická desítka is a traditional running race in Přeštice, offering a fast, flat ten-kilometre course on soft terrain along the Úhlava River. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and is open to both competitive and recreational runners of all ages. In addition to the main 10 km race, there is also a 5 km Fit Run and children’s races. The start and finish are at the Loděnice venue, which offers comfortable facilities, including a buffet, heated changing rooms and hot showers.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km course on soft terrain along the Úhlava River
Part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup
Facilities at the Loděnice venue include a buffet, changing rooms and showers
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 at the Loděnice venue. The awards ceremony takes place after the last runner finishes, usually around noon. Facilities include an open buffet, heated changing rooms, hot showers and toilets. Homemade treats prepared by the organizers are included in the entry fee. Race facilities are at the Loděnice venue.

name: 6666m
location: Chotěšov, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: The 6666m Run in Chotěšov is a cross-country race covering 6666 metres, held in the picturesque surroundings of the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy natural terrain and the sporting atmosphere of regional running events. The start is traditionally in the afternoon, and the race is suitable for a wide range of people who enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain in the natural surroundings of Chotěšov
A course exactly 6666 metres long
An afternoon start with the atmosphere of a regional running event
additional: The organiser is O. Maršík, who can be contacted by phone at 606 248 978. Registration takes place directly on the race website. Results from previous editions are archived on the website. The start time is 16:00. The email address is protected against spam and is not directly available.

name: Macurův memoriál
organizer: DSO – Prostřední Bečva a Horní Bečva
description: The Macura Memorial is a legendary run held in the picturesque surroundings of Martinák in Horní Bečva. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, from the youngest runners on short courses to the main 4.15 km race. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of a traditional run, with changing rooms and a valuables storage facility available. After the race, a refreshment area with broth and drinks will be ready. The main categories start at 16:00, with the results announced at 17:00.
course_highlights: A 4.15 km course for the main categories
Children’s categories with courses from 170 m to 960 m
Start and finish in the grounds in front of the primary school in Horní Bečva
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in the small gym at the primary school. A valuables storage facility is also provided and is accessible only with a race number. Participants will receive a chip, race number, voucher for a beer or Kofola, and broth at the finish. The last transport to the start of the main categories leaves at 15:45. The program includes children’s categories. Showers and a valuables storage facility are available to participants.

name: Běh Hvězdou - Memoriál Vladimíra Fiřta
description: Běh Hvězdou – Vladimír Fiřt Memorial is a running race in Prague 6, offering men a 6.6 km course and women a 3.3 km course. The race is part of the SABZO series and attracts runners looking for a quality race atmosphere in an urban setting. The event is open to the general public and offers a chance to test your strength on an interesting course.
course_highlights: 6.6 km course for men
3.3 km course for women
Part of the SABZO series

name: Memoriál Luboše Svobody – cena Běžce Vysočiny
description: The Luboš Svoboda Memorial – Vysočina Runner’s Prize is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various categories for men, women, juniors, youth and children, with distances ranging from 1.2 km to 8.8 km. The course follows paved and unpaved paths through the forest park, including a 2.2 km loop, and is suitable for recreational runners. The race commemorates runner Luboš Svoboda and has been held regularly since 2008 as a major sporting event in the Vysočina Region.
course_highlights: A 2.2 km loop along paved and unpaved paths in Heulos Forest Park
Part of the course runs along the Jihlávka River and past the Summer Cinema amphitheatre
Various distances for all age groups, from 1.2 km to 8.8 km
additional: The start is at the Na Stoupách Athletics Stadium in Jihlava. Changing rooms are available beneath the stadium grandstand, along with toilets. Online registration is open until 12:00 on race day; a season ticket for race entries can be used. The course is run in the opposite direction to the one shown on the map. The race is divided into age categories with different course distances. The main course is 8.8 km; the race includes categories for children and veterans.

name: Běh na Doubravku
location: Tenisové kurty Panorama, Teplice, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Doubravka is a traditional sporting event held in Teplice, celebrating the arrival of spring each year. The race is part of an all-day sports event at Doubravka, where participants and visitors can enjoy a range of sporting and cultural activities in addition to the run. The course has been changed from previous years and starts at the Panorama tennis courts. The event is suitable for the general public, including those who don’t want to run but would like to have fun and take part in other sports.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Panorama tennis courts in Teplice
Course changed from previous years
Includes an accompanying sports and cultural programme
additional: The event is part of a sports day at Doubravka, featuring games, strength events, shooting, axe throwing and live music. Chip timing was introduced in 2022 for accurate timekeeping.

name: Karlovský kopcovák
location: Karlov Hill (svah Karlova), Benešov, Czech Republic
description: Karlovský kopcovák is a traditional running race held on the slope of Karlov in Benešov. The race is 4.5 km long and is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series, which offers a varied calendar of running events in the region. This race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a spring run in picturesque surroundings. Registration is available online in advance, making it easy for a wide range of runners to take part.
course_highlights: Race distance: 4.5 km
Hilly terrain on the slope of Karlov in Benešov
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka series
additional: The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series, which includes 11 races per year. Categories are divided by age and gender, with points awarded to the first 9 places. Participation in at least 4 races is required to be included in the overall standings.

name: Běh KERMI
location: Areál společnosti KERMI, Stříbro, Czech Republic
organizer: KERMI ve spolupráci se Sdružením vytrvalců Stříbro

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 150 Kč, přihlášky na místě v areálu KERMI, školící centrum

description: The KERMI Run is a traditional 10.5 km race that runs mostly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI company premises in Stříbro. The race is suitable for the general public, including runners of different speeds, as participants can start at 10:00 or in the main start at 10:30. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a social gathering and refreshments for participants. It is organised by the Stříbro Endurance Runners Association, which supports amateur athletes and runners in the region.
course_highlights: A 10.5 km route, mostly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI premises in Stříbro
Choice of a 10:00 or 10:30 start
additional: Registration takes place on race day at the KERMI premises, in the training centre. Refreshments and drinks will be available after the race. The organisers allow slower runners to start as early as 10:00 so everyone can enjoy the race at their own pace. Participants can start at 10:00 or in the main start at 10:30; the race is followed by an awards ceremony, a social gathering and refreshments.

name: Jarní přespolní běh Nýrsko
location: Areál pod Sjezdovkou, Nýrsko, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Cross-Country Run in Nýrsko is a traditional race organized by TJ Nýrsko z.s., held at the venue below the ski slope. The race offers courses in the sports area below Pajrek, with 20 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event is open to the general public, including children’s categories, and is part of the Ešus League series of off-track races in the Klatovy District. The organizers provide refreshments and prizes for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The courses run through the Sports Area below Pajrek
