Each lap has 20 metres of elevation gain
The race is part of the Ešus League series of off-track races in the Klatovy District
additional: On-site registration opens at 12:00, and closes 15 minutes before the start of each category. Competitors take part at their own risk; children compete under their parents’ responsibility. Refreshments are available at the venue below the ski slope. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each category. Children’s categories start at 13:00, and the main race starts at 14:00.

name: Májový běh okolo rybníka Nezmaru
location: Penzion Kamenec, Jilešovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The May Run around Nezmar Pond is a running race in Jilešovice, by the Kamenec guesthouse. Its name refers to the route around Nezmar Pond and its traditional May date. The race is organized by Maratón klub Seitl Ostrava.

name: Boskovické běhy
location: Boskovice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Boskovice Runs are a major sporting event in the Boskovice region, offering routes of various lengths, including the main 12.5 km Run over the Seven-Toothed Ridge. The event is for athletes as well as families with children, who can compete in children’s categories. Alongside the races, there is a varied program of activities, and hikers can join the runners. The Boskovice Runs promote a healthy lifestyle and community gatherings in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: The main Run over the Seven-Toothed Ridge course is 12.5 km long
The route includes two long forest sections
Children’s races for all age groups
additional: Registration is also possible on site, and race numbers can be collected as early as the Thursday before the race. A new feature is a race for teams of three. The opportunity to receive a race number bearing your name is available for a limited time. The Boskovice Runs are held under the patronage of the town’s mayor, Jaroslav Dohnálek. The event also features a varied program of activities, including a cycling skills demonstration.

name: Memoriál Huberta Šuláka
location: Osada Údolí oddechu, Libečov 19, Czech Republic

name: Jestřebí kros
location: Chlíve 62, Stárkov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park, Horšovský Týn, Czech Republic
organizer: Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, z. s.
description: Běh zámeckým parkem is a running event organized by Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, held in the picturesque setting of the Castle Park in Horšovský Týn. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and Běžec Chodska, offering a high-quality sporting atmosphere and competition for runners of all levels. The event is scheduled for the afternoon of April 30, 2027, and offers an enjoyable outdoor experience with opportunities for active recreation and sporting achievement.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Castle Park
Part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and Běžec Chodska
Picturesque natural setting in Horšovský Týn
additional: The race traditionally starts at 14:00. The venue is Castle Park in Horšovský Týn. The organizer is Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn. In 2026, the race was scheduled for May 1 at 14:00.

name: Vrcholy
description: Vrcholy českých hor is a unique collectible set of bottle stickers featuring the 25 highest peaks of Czech mountains and ranges. Hand-drawn and exclusively designed, the stickers are inspired by real peaks and destinations, adding an original, personal touch of adventure for everyone who loves Czech nature and outdoor activities. They are made from high-quality, durable material with UV-resistant lamination to protect them from fading and damage. They are also waterproof and suitable for demanding conditions, making them an ideal accessory for outdoor enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The 25 highest peaks of Czech mountains and ranges
Hand-drawn, exclusively designed stickers
High-quality material with UV protection and waterproofing
additional: The stickers are designed to withstand demanding conditions, including the dishwasher. They provide an offline reminder of peaks reached and trips taken.

name: Běh Krásné vyhlídky
location: Hliněný rybník, Struhařov, Benešov District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Beautiful Views Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Struhařov near Mnichovice. The race follows a unique panoramic route along the new Krásné vyhlídky nature trail, built by the Mnichovice and Surroundings Seniors’ Club in cooperation with local municipalities and the school. The main race is 7.4 km long and is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series. In addition to the main race, accompanying races are held for children and juniors. The event venue and race start are at Hliněný Pond in Struhařov.
course_highlights: Unique panoramic route along the Krásné vyhlídky nature trail
7.4 km loop for the main race
Accompanying races around the pond for children and juniors
additional: Registration for the main race is open from 14:00 to 16:00, and the main race starts at 16:30. Registration for the accompanying races for children and juniors is open from 13:00 to 14:30, and they start at 14:45. Categories include preschoolers (200 m), schoolchildren (620 m) and juniors (1860 m). The fastest man and woman from Struhařov are recognized in the main race. The race is made possible by volunteers, local associations and partners. It is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series; accompanying races for children are also held.

name: Běh Údolím vzdechů
location: Sudoměřice u Tábora, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Valley of Sighs Run is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora. It has been held in the spring for several years. The race attracts enthusiastic athletes of all ages and offers an opportunity to enjoy a run in the picturesque surroundings of Sudoměřice u Tábora. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and community spirit, which promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through a picturesque valley
Traditional spring date on May 1
Suitable for children and adult runners
additional: Race results are published after the event. The event is organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora. In previous editions, photos and downloadable results lists were available. The run is part of local sporting activities and community events.

name: Běh údolím samoty
location: Radvanec, Nový Bor, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Valley of Samota is a traditional district running race held in the picturesque setting of Radvanec near Nový Bor in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and gives runners the chance to test themselves on natural routes with varied terrain. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle amid the region’s beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Natural terrain in the Valley of Samota
Picturesque surroundings of Radvanec near Nový Bor
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Chomutov
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Chomutov is a charity event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps them. The race takes place at Wakepark Chomutov and is part of a series of runs held throughout the Czech Republic. Participants run with a mass start, and the entry fee is a donation to a good cause, helping fund the recording and processing of eyewitness stories. The event is open to the general public and also offers the option of running symbolically anywhere outside the official course.
course_highlights: Mass-start run at Wakepark Chomutov
Charity event supporting the memory of the nation and eyewitnesses
Option to take part in a symbolic run anywhere in the Czech Republic or abroad
additional: Registered runners receive their race number at check-in on race day. It is recommended that they write any allergies and emergency contact details on the back of their race number in case of medical complications. Results are announced after the last runner has finished. The event is part of a wider series of runs throughout the Czech Republic and includes a corporate team run and a run anywhere. The race offers a timed 5 km course and an untimed 1 km family run.

name: Král Zvičiny 2026
description: King of Zvičina 2026 is a mass-start individual road race uphill, ideal for kicking off the season. The race starts in Dvůr Králové nad Labem and finishes at Raisova chata on Zvičina. The main race course is approximately 10 km long, on asphalt, with a continuous climb. A shorter 3 km course ending in Dehtov is prepared for children. After the race, the results are announced at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť.
course_highlights: Main course: Lipnice → Dehtov → Třebihošť → Zvičina, approx. 10 km, asphalt, continuous climb
Children’s course: Lipnice → Dehtov, 3 km, asphalt, continuous climb
Finish at Raisova chata on Zvičina
additional: Registration takes place from 8:30 to 9:30 in Dvůr Králové – Lipnice – Zaháj. The results are announced at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť. Parking is available at Motorest U Lípy and at the Rodos company (the start location). Categories are divided by age and gender, including youth and children.

name: Memoriál Karla Raise
description: The Karel Rais Memorial is a traditional road race organized by the ELNA Počerady Athletics Sports Club in Louny. The race takes place on closed roads along a certified 15 km course that descends from an elevation of 219 m to 178 m. The program also includes a roller-skating race and a fun run for all ages and fitness levels. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and an accompanying cultural program, and is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Course on closed class II and III roads, with no motor vehicle traffic
AIMS-measured certified course, 15 km long
Start at an elevation of 219 m; finish at an elevation of 178 m
additional: Race-day registration takes place from 7:30 to 9:30 in Pavilion B at the exhibition grounds in Masaryk Gardens. Changing rooms and showers are available at the swimming pool sauna next to the exhibition grounds. Personal belongings are transported by van from the start to the finish. The race starts in four waves according to category. Buses to the start run from 9:30 from the car park in front of the Municipal Swimming Pool in Louny. The fun run starts at 10:45 and is open to all ages and fitness levels, including participants on roller skates, in strollers, or in wheelchairs. All fun-run participants receive a T-shirt and can enter a prize draw with valuable prizes. The day also includes a Children’s Day with athletics competitions and a cultural program. Facilities, including changing rooms and showers, are available at the finish; the organizers provide transport to the start.

name: Kačický lesní běh
location: Obora, Kačice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kačice Forest Run is a trail race in the Obora forest and around Kačice, for children, young people, and adults. It offers courses of various lengths, from short children’s runs to longer races for adults. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and welcomes runners and families for a sporting get-together in nature.
course_highlights: Forest setting in Obora and around Kačice
Courses of various lengths for children, young people, and adults
Race included in the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup
additional: Children’s races are free to enter; the previous edition also included refreshments and a sauna after the race.

name: Maloskalský půlmaraton
location: Žlutá plovárna, Malá Skála, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Maloskalský Half Marathon is a traditional running race on a scenic route from Malá Skála to Turnov and back. The race offers a half-marathon course with approximately 25 metres of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt, gravel and farm tracks. It starts in the afternoon at Žlutá plovárna in Malá Skála. Runners can enjoy refreshments along the course and at the finish, a medal and other services. The race is suitable for runners across a wide range of ages and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: 21.098 km course with approximately 25 m of elevation gain
Surface: 80% asphalt, 10% gravel, 10% farm track
The route follows a cycle path and hiking trail, crossing a railway footbridge and passing Hrubý Rohozec Chateau
additional: The half marathon starts at 17:00; the 10 km race starts at 17:10. The race is at capacity, and on-site registration is not available. The entry fee includes a race number, with the option to have your name printed on it if you register by 26 April; STOPNITO chip timing; refreshments along the course and at the finish (water, isotonic drinks, glucose tablets, salt, homemade cakes, bananas, oranges and a bottle of Mattoni); a metal finisher’s medal; baggage storage; small gifts from sponsors; medical services; and a race photo gallery. Race-day registration is open from 14:45 to 16:40, and baggage storage closes at 16:40. A T-shirt with the race logo can be added to your order at Stopnito.cz. Parking is available at the central car park by the GBO petrol station in Malá Skála. According to the available description, the race provides chip timing, refreshments along the course and at the finish, baggage storage and medical services.

name: K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival
location: Konstantinovy Lázně, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival is a prestigious ultramarathon held in Konstantinovy Lázně, featuring six races on a 2,854-metre loop. The longest event is a six-day race, which attracts ultramarathon runners from many countries. In 2026, the 24-hour race will also be the Czech Republic Championship. The event offers a challenge for experienced runners and the experience of long-distance road running.
course_highlights: A 2,854-metre loop in Konstantinovy Lázně
The longest race lasts six days
The 24-hour race is the Czech Republic Championship
additional: The race takes place on roads and includes several timed events: 24 hours, 48 hours, 72 hours and 144 hours. It is organized by Rumning klap z.s. The first category starts at 12:00.

name: Otrokovická 100
location: Otrokovice, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: Otrokovická 100 is a traditional long-distance walk in the Moravian-Silesian Region, offering a challenging 100 km route and a shorter 50 km option. The event is for experienced hikers and athletes looking to test their endurance and navigation skills in beautiful natural surroundings. Both the start and finish are in Otrokovice, and the route crosses varied terrain with GPS tracking available. The event is part of a series of timed long-distance walks with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km and 50 km routes in the Moravian-Silesian Region
Challenging terrain with varied surfaces and scenic views
GPS tracking to follow participants
additional: A total of 578 runners registered in 2026. The event is part of a series of timed long-distance walks with GPS tracking.

name: Kokina běh
location: Horka nad Moravou, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: The Kokina Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc and held in Horka nad Moravou. It is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The Liga stovkařů Olomouc club is known for its long-standing tradition of promoting endurance running and organizes several races in the region. The race is suitable for the general public and supports the running community in Central Moravia.

name: Přespolní běh Říp - Roudnice nad Labem
location: Tyršův stadion, Roudnice nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem
description: The Říp Cross-Country Run in Roudnice nad Labem is a traditional athletics event organized by T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem. The race offers various distances for children, youth and adults, including challenging runs up Mount Říp and a longer endurance course. The start and registration take place at Tyrš Stadium, where a friendly atmosphere and sporting spirit prevail. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes outdoor activity and community gatherings.
course_highlights: Various distances, from 300 m for preschool children to 15,200 m for endurance runners
A challenging 8,700 m run up Mount Říp for men, women and veterans
Start and finish at Tyrš Stadium, with courses passing through Alej Sv. Čecha and by the small cross
additional: Registration is from 8:00 at Tyrš Stadium: until 8:45 for children and youth, and until 9:30 for adults. Entry fees are paid at registration. Categories are divided by age and course distance, with separate categories for women’s mile runners and women veterans in the 8,700 m race. The event is part of Sokol Roudnice nad Labem’s traditional sports program. According to the available information, entry fees are paid at registration.

name: Běh Klobasnou
location: Stadium TJ Lokomotiva, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Czech Republic
description: The Klobasna Run is a traditional running race organized by the TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí athletics club. The race is open to the general public, including children and adults, and offers various categories and distances. The race starts at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium in Veselí nad Lužnicí. Participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere, awards for the top runners, and activities for children. The race is part of the rich running tradition in the South Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí stadium
Categories for all age groups, from preparatory classes to adults
Short children’s races take place right on the stadium track
additional: Athletes from Veselí nad Lužnicí can enter for free. An inflatable castle and face painting are available for children. All participants in the children’s categories receive a medal and refreshments at the finish. Parking is available at the sports complex.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Marathon Championships is a prestigious race over the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, held in Prague’s historic centre, with the start at Old Town Square. The race is for men and women over 18 who met the qualifying standards in previous years. It is organised by Juniorský maratonský klub, z.s. in cooperation with RunCzech. Runners can use modern timing services, and professional photography is available after the race. The start is traditionally at 08:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Start and finish at historic Old Town Square in Prague
A 42.195 km course through the centre of Prague
Professional timing and the option to download the GPX course
additional: Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order during registration and order after the race. Entries are accepted only from runners who met the qualifying standards from 1 January 2025 until the entry deadline. Participation is subject to the qualifying standards and placement by the technical delegate. The available information relates to the 2025 and 2026 editions, not to 9 May 2027.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
description: The Prague International Marathon is a traditional running race held in Prague’s historic center. The race offers a unique opportunity to run through picturesque streets and past the city’s iconic landmarks. Both the start and finish are in Old Town Square, giving the race a festive atmosphere. The marathon is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts a wide range of runners, from amateurs to professionals.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Old Town Square
The route runs through Prague’s historic center, with views of its landmarks
Firm asphalt surface with minimal elevation changes
additional: Marathon weekend includes accompanying runs such as the LAVAZZA Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), the dm Family Mile (1.609 km), and the dm bambini run (100–200 m). Photography is provided by witisi.photo and can be pre-ordered during registration or ordered after the race. The time limit and rules are available on the RunCzech website. The race pack and further information are available in the RunCzech mobile app.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious race held in Prague’s historic city centre. It also serves as the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women. The race offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a city rich in history and enjoy beautiful views. The course passes iconic Prague landmarks and is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners. The running weekend also includes companion races for families and children, highlighting the community spirit of the event.
course_highlights: The course runs through Prague’s historic city centre, with views of its landmarks
A flat, fast course profile suitable for setting personal records
Also hosts the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women
additional: The race pack contains everything participants need for the race. Timing is electronic, with official results. Photography is provided by witisi.photo and can be pre-ordered during registration or purchased after the race. The running weekend also includes family and children’s races, an accompanying programme and a virtual package in the RunCzech mobile app.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Řevnice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series in Řevnice is a race held in beautiful natural surroundings, starting and finishing at the Řevnice Brewery. The route follows a green educational trail for most of its length, is well marked with red-and-white ribbons, and features a combination of long climbs and descents with views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests. The race is ideal for runners who want to enjoy a pleasant run through picturesque countryside, with refreshments and a baggage drop available on site. After the race, category winners receive diplomas.
course_highlights: The route mostly follows a green educational trail marked with red-and-white ribbons
Two long climbs, including a stretch past the Forest Theatre to Píšťák Pond
Views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests on the descent back to Řevnice
additional: Registration is available online or on site from 17:00; please arrive by 17:30 at the latest. Refreshments and a baggage drop are available on site. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas. The start and finish are at the Řevnice Brewery; refreshments and a baggage drop are available on site.

name: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař
location: Hostivař Forest Park, Prague 10, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Hostivař Forest Park Run in Prague is a trail race offering two distance options: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men. The race is part of the SABZO series and takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Hostivař Forest Park in Prague 10. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge on natural terrain with varied surfaces. Come enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and test your strength against other runners.
course_highlights: Trail course in Hostivař Forest Park
Two distances: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men
Part of the SABZO series

name: Žďárák – Čerňák
location: Parking lot by the Church of St. John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora, Žďár nad Sázavou, Czech Republic
description: Čerňák is a trail race along the paths of the Černý les forest around Zelená hora and across meadows towards Vysoké. The 7 km route, with 180 m of elevation gain, features challenging climbs and descents, including two crossings over the summit of Černý les. The race starts and finishes in the car park by the church on Zelená hora, a significant UNESCO site, and offers beautiful views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the surrounding countryside. Trail shoes are recommended, as 90% of the route is off-road and 10% is on asphalt.
course_highlights: The route crosses the summit of Černý les twice and has 180 m of elevation gain
A circuit around the pilgrimage Church of St. John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora (a UNESCO site)
Views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the beauty of Černý les and the area around Konventský Pond
additional: The race starts and finishes in the car park by the church on Zelená hora. The route is marked. Trail shoes are recommended. Photos from the race are available on the club website for 2023, 2024 and 2025. The start and finish are both by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. The entry fee will go towards a charity collection for a sports prosthesis for student Alex Vondra.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice
location: Sportovní hala u Stromovky, České Budějovice, Czech Republic
organizer: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in České Budějovice is a charity run supporting people with severe visual impairments. The start is at 9:00 p.m. by the sports hall near Stromovka, and participants can choose between a 2.3 km course (1 lap) and a 4.6 km course (2 laps). The event offers an accompanying programme, including a concert, and registration is available through the GoOut.cz portal. The entry fee is 500 Kč, half of which goes directly to helping people with visual impairments. The event has a limited capacity for participants’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Night run with a choice of 2.3 km and 4.6 km courses
Start and finish by the sports hall near Stromovka in České Budějovice
Charity run with an accompanying programme and concert
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards can enter free of charge, but are not entitled to a headlamp or headband. A changing room and bag storage are available on site, and refreshments and medical services are provided. The run has a limited capacity for participants’ safety.

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen
description: The Czech Championships in the 1-mile and 5 km road races for men and women take place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa park in Poděbrady. The course is very fast, with no elevation gain and accurately measured 1 km laps along the spa colonnade, offering ideal conditions for personal bests. The race is officially recognized by the Czech Athletics Federation and is part of the prestigious Poděbrady Walking program. The event also features an accompanying program and the chance to receive an original finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain.
course_highlights: 5 km race over 5 × 1 km laps along the spa colonnade
1-mile race with an initial 609 m section and a 1 km lap along the spa colonnade
Very fast course with no elevation gain, certified for the European Race Walking Championships
additional: Registration is available online only, with payment due within 7 days of registering. Later registrations will have no name on the race bib. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the race starts. Finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain. Accompanying program throughout the day along the spa colonnade. Available information about the program, registration, and prices applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 14 May 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány
location: Zámecký park Lány, Lány, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Lány a Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové
description: The Victory Run through the Lány Castle Park is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1972. It is held annually on May 7 in the castle park in Lány. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, with distances from 60 to 7,800 metres, running mainly on gravel paths and grass. It is organised by TJ Sokol Lány and Charlotta Garrigue Masaryk Primary School in Lány under the auspices of the Municipality of Lány. The race is suitable for all ages and takes place in the pleasant surroundings of a beautiful park.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly on gravel paths and grass in the castle park
The main race follows the 3,900 m red loop; men run two laps and women one
Children’s distances range from 60 m to 1,500 m, with loops marked in different colours
additional: You can register online until 14:00 on the day before the race, or in person on race day, no later than 30 minutes before your category’s start. Check-in takes place on race day from 7:30 at the main entrance to the castle park, below the castle greenhouse. Race numbers are collected at check-in, and participants line up at the start 5 minutes before their category starts. Participants in the “Run for Health” do not pay an entry fee. The race is traditionally held on May 8; the listed date for the 2027 edition is May 7.

name: Čavisovská stovka
location: TJ Sokol sports field, Čavisov, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Čavisovská Stovka is a long-distance walk in the area around Čavisov, with routes of 30, 50 and 100 km. This traditional event offers routes of varying difficulty, from a relaxed 30 km route and a challenging 50 km route to the royal 100 km route for experienced participants. The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov. The event is suitable for athletes who want to experience the beauty of the Moravian-Silesian Region on a long-distance walk.
course_highlights: 30, 50 and 100 km routes around Čavisov
Royal 100 km route for experienced participants
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov
additional: The routes are divided into a relaxed 30 km route, a challenging 50 km route and a royal 100 km route. GPS coordinates for the start and finish: 49° 49' 47.4'' N, 18° 04' 59.1'' E. Registration is via a form on the website, which opens automatically once the time interval has elapsed. Tourist and aerial maps, as well as the route elevation profile, are available on the website. The organizers provide refreshments, toilets and a shower at the start. Participants may bring dogs, with no time limit.

name: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice
location: Čechtice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice is a 6 km running race on trails around the town of Čechtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves in a natural setting with some gentle terrain challenges. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.
course_highlights: Trail course around the town of Čechtice
Race distance: 6 km
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup

name: Strážnická stovka
location: Strážnice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné dle datumu přihlášení (pouze pro prvních 150 registrací)

description: Strážnická Hundred is an extreme 100 km ultra trail marathon through the beautiful countryside of the White Carpathians in the heart of South Moravia. This race is only for people over 18 and requires real determination and physical fitness. The course is carefully marked, and runners have access to aid stations and the option to have drop bags transported. The entry fee includes an original race bib with the runner’s name and a metal badge as a reward for pushing their limits. The event offers two start waves with time limits of 15 and 24 hours, so everyone can choose their race goal.
course_highlights: The route passes through the beautiful countryside of the White Carpathians and the heart of South Moravia
The course is marked with red flags, spray-painted arrows and reflective stickers
Aid stations and the option to have drop bags transported to the Května aid station
additional: The race offers two start waves: the 24-hour time limit starts on Friday at 19:30, and the 15-hour time limit starts on Saturday at 5:00. Check-in takes place on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00; reserves should report at 18:45. Drop bags must be smaller than 30 L, labelled with the race number and handed in on Friday at 18:45. After the race, belongings can be collected from Saturday at 14:00. The entry fee includes refreshments at the race venue and aid stations, an original race bib with the runner’s name, and a logo T-shirt (if ordered). Runners receive their race number and chip at check-in. A race bib with the runner’s name is not included in the entry fee for the first 150 registrations. The race is only for people over 18.

name: Poděbrady Running - MČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km a veřejný běh na 5 km
description: Poděbrady Running is the inaugural open Czech Republic Championship in the road mile and 5 km, complemented by a public 5 km run. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady and features certified, very fast and flat courses, ideal for setting personal records. Come and run alongside the best Czech runners and enjoy the atmosphere of a high-quality road race. Organized by the Czech Athletics Federation with the support of the running community.
course_highlights: Certified courses suited to fast times
A very fast and flat course
Picturesque surroundings of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady
additional: The first and main category starts at 12:00. The organizer is the Czech Athletics Federation. The course is certified and suitable for attempts at personal records. The race is part of the official Czech Running calendar.

name: Běh osvobození
location: Lišany, Rakovník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: SK Lišany, z.s. / TJ Sokol Díly
description: The Běh osvobození (Liberation Run) is a traditional 7 km road race between the villages of Lišany and Lužná, held on a low-traffic third-class road. It has a long history dating back to 1972 and is also known as the Lišany Road Seven. The race starts in Lišany, follows a route to Lužná and back, and finishes in front of the U Hřiště restaurant. The race is divided into six age categories and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Cash prizes and bonuses motivate competitors to beat the course records.
course_highlights: A 7 km route along the low-traffic Lišany–Lužná–Lišany third-class road
Start and finish by the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Bonuses for the first approximately 500 m and cash prizes for winners and record-breakers
additional: Race registration opens at 9:30 at the U Hřiště restaurant (Sokol hall) in Lišany and closes 30 minutes before the start. Competitors walk to the start in front of the municipal office. The results ceremony is at approximately 12:30. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories. Cash prizes of up to CZK 19,900. Protests may be submitted within 15 minutes after the race with a deposit of CZK 200.

name: Běh Kamenickým Šenovem
location: Prácheň, Kamenický Šenov, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Kamenický Šenov a Klub biatlonu
description: The Kamenický Šenov Run is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, held in the picturesque surroundings of Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race gives runners the chance to test themselves on courses that pass through beautiful countryside and parts of Kamenický Šenov. The event is suitable for the general public and is part of a regional running-race series. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and support your fitness in a friendly setting.
course_highlights: An urban course with mostly paved surfaces
Two laps on the main course
Children’s races over shorter distances
additional: Past editions have listed main courses of approximately 6 and 11 km; the date and details for the 2027 edition have not yet been confirmed.

name: Memoriál otce Jožky
location: Stěbořice, Opava District, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Orel jednota Stěbořice, Farnost Stěbořice, Obec Stěbořice
description: The Father Jožka Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Stěbořice, honoring the memory of priest Josef Motyka. The race offers various distances for men, women, seniors, and children, including a main course of over 10 km and shorter circuits of around 4 km. The event is organized by local organizations and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a day of sport in the pleasant surroundings of the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race has a long tradition and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Main course of over 10 km, with different categories (men, women, 50+)
Short courses of around 4 km for different age groups, including boys and girls
Special 100 m races for preschoolers
additional: The race is organized by Orel jednota Stěbořice, the Stěbořice Parish, and the Municipality of Stěbořice. Course maps and event posters are available. The race has multiple age- and gender-based categories, including categories for seniors and children. Race records are kept for individual categories.

name: Běh Černou Horou
location: Zámek Černá Hora, Černá Hora, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Černou Horou is the fourth-oldest cross-country running race in the Czech Republic, with its first edition held in 1928. Since 1933, the race has been called Běh Černou Horou - memoriál MUDr. Jaroslava Hubky and has been part of the Blansko District Running League. The course passes around Černá Hora Castle and offers a challenging but beautiful running experience for all age groups, including children. Hundreds of runners take part every year, from children to adults. A new feature is a four-person relay, allowing friends and colleagues to race together.
course_highlights: The course passes around Černá Hora Castle
A challenging and beautiful 9.2 km course for adults
Children’s categories, with courses for up to 200 children
additional: Registration is available online via the OBL website or in person on race day from 8:00. Relays (4 people) can only be registered in person on race day. Runner check-in takes place in the old changing-room building at the sports complex in Černá Hora. Parking is available in the adjacent lot by the sports complex. The relay is open to men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with no age restrictions.

name: Běh Mánesovou stezkou
location: Sigma Lutín Stadium, Lutín, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sigma Lutín a TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc
description: The Run Along the Mánes Trail to Kosíř and Back is a traditional running event held in Lutín and its local part of Třebčín. The race follows a scenic route to the summit of Kosíř and back, offering a sporting experience in a natural setting and a chance to discover the surrounding landscape. The event is part of local sporting activities and is suitable for a wide range of people who enjoy running and hiking.
course_highlights: The route goes to the summit of Kosíř and back
Natural and scenic surroundings
Start and finish at the Sigma Lutín stadium
additional: The event is part of the sporting activities of the municipality of Lutín; both the start and finish are at the Sigma Lutín stadium. The route is suitable for runners and hikers and is held as part of local sports club and community events. The first category starts at 9:00 at the Sigma Lutín stadium. The 16.5 km course is for women and men over 60. The information provided comes from the 2025 and 2026 editions; the 2027 edition has not yet been confirmed.

name: Kros Merklín-Plešivec
location: Merklín, Karlovy Vary District, Karlovy Vary Region, Czech Republic
description: The Merklín-Plešivec Cross-Country Race is a 6.5 km uphill running race that follows forest trails and begins on a ski slope. It is part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners’ League and gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain amid the natural beauty around Merklín. The race is suited to fans of mountain running and outdoor running challenges.
course_highlights: 6.5 km uphill course
Forest trails and an opening section on a ski slope
Part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners’ League

name: Memoriál Jana Janovského
location: Sokolovna and Blatná Castle Park, Blatná, Czech Republic
description: The Jan Janovský Memorial is a traditional sporting event held annually in Blatná, offering races for various age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The races take place in the area below Sokolovna and in the chateau park, with routes on asphalt and forest paths. The first race starts at 9:00, and in-person registration takes place no later than 15 minutes before the start of the relevant category. The event is supported by the South Bohemian Region and has facilities including toilets, changing rooms, and luggage storage.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt and forest paths in the chateau park
The start and finish are below Sokolovna in Blatná
Categories for all age groups, from age 3 to seniors
additional: Toilets, changing rooms, luggage storage, and washrooms are available. The races receive financial support through grant programs of the South Bohemian Region. The race is supported by the South Bohemian Region.

name: Novojičínský půlmaratón
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Nový Jičín, Czech Republic
description: The Novojičín Half Marathon is an open race with a maximum capacity of 430 runners aged over 18. It takes place in picturesque surroundings along the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path from Nový Jičín to Hostašovice and back. The course is mostly asphalt, with a small section of paving, and both the start and finish are at Masaryk Square in Nový Jičín. The race also offers a two-leg relay and children’s categories. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish. The organizer is Zážitky v pohybu, z.s. The race takes place in all weather conditions, with a maximum time limit of 2 hours and 45 minutes.
course_highlights: The route follows the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path from Nový Jičín to Hostašovice and back
95% asphalt, 5% paving
Refreshments on the course at kilometres 6.5, 11 and 17, and at the finish
additional: Race packets are handed out on race day from 07:00 to 08:30 at the start venue. A changing room is available at the start venue for storing belongings. Runners are required to return their timing chip after the race; failure to do so incurs a 500 Kč fine. Medical services are available at the start, refreshment stations and finish. The relay consists of two 10.5 km legs, with bus transport between the legs. The maximum time allowed to complete the race is 2 hours and 45 minutes.

name: Přísnotický kros
location: Přísnotice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Přísnotický kros is a traditional running race held in Přísnotice as part of the Zajíc League, where it is the second round. The race offers a wide range of categories, from the youngest children to veterans, with courses adapted to different age groups and abilities. Men and women of all ages can take part, on routes through natural terrain suitable for runners of all levels. Registration and race-number collection take place on race day from 8:30. Children who do not score points in the series may also enter directly at the venue.
course_highlights: A range of course distances, from 110 m for the youngest children to 7,500 m for men and veterans
Natural terrain suited to cross-country running
Categories for all age groups, from children to veterans
additional: Registration and race-number collection begin at 8:30 and are available until 30 minutes before the start of each category. Children who do not score points in the series and adult-category entrants may register directly at the venue until 30 minutes before their start. The youngest children who do not score points in the Zajíc League may register directly at the venue. Race-number collection begins at 8:30.

name: 50 mil železnohorských
location: Náměstí Míru, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: The 50 Miles of the Iron Mountains is a challenging trail race held in the Pardubice Region, offering runners a unique experience of running through beautiful countryside with significant elevation gain. The race is part of professionally organized events with quality facilities, refreshments, and GPS tracking to support runners and their fans. The race starts at Náměstí Míru in Heřmanův Městec, in front of the church, and participants can use modern technology to track their performance and results. The race is suitable for experienced ultramarathoners looking for a challenge in the picturesque forests of the Iron Mountains.
course_highlights: A challenging trail with significant elevation gain in the Iron Mountains
Start at Náměstí Míru in Heřmanův Městec, in front of the church
GPS tracking with Queclink GL320MG technology
additional: GPS tracking works with or without the QS Trail registration module. The entry fee includes the option to order a T-shirt, drop bag, and overnight accommodation. Apps for Android and iOS are available for tracking the race. After the race, a replay is available, and results are sent by email. The start location is listed as Náměstí Míru in Heřmanův Městec, in front of the church.

name: Vrchlabí - Strážné
location: Kulturní dům Střelnice, Vrchlabí, Czech Republic
description: Vrchlabí–Strážné is a traditional off-road hill race that runs from Vrchlabí to Strážné over three hills and two descents. The varied course features challenging climbs, technical descents and fast flat sections, making it suitable for hill-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and the Hradec Králové Region Championships. The start is at the Střelnice Cultural Centre in Vrchlabí, and the finish is in the car park in Strážné. The race is named in honour of Jan “Píďa” Herbs, its spiritual founder.
course_highlights: The route runs mostly off-road along forest and meadow paths
A challenging climb up Jankův kopec and a technical descent past Jankův háj
A fast, nearly 1.5 km-long flat section ending with a short climb and a sprint on asphalt
additional: The start is at the Střelnice Cultural Centre in Vrchlabí (Švejk restaurant). The route is marked with ribbons and arrows, and kilometre markers are provided. Cross-country or trail shoes are recommended. Refreshments are available at the finish. Transport for runners from the finish back to the start is not provided; using the yellow hiking trail is recommended. The race is held in memory of Jan “Píďa” Herbs.

name: Na dvě rozhledny s Nadačním fondem Bernard
description: The Na dvě rozhledny charity run with the Bernard Foundation is a sports and social event organized by the Bernard Family Brewery in Humpolec. Runners start at intervals and aim to pass through two checkpoints: the Bernard lookout tower and the lookout tower at Orlík Castle. The route follows both paved and unpaved paths, and participants may use a map, compass, or GPS navigation. All participants are entitled to refreshments at the finish, and a medal is prepared for the first 100 people to register. The race is for people over 15; younger participants must have the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: Staggered start: 30-second intervals for runners and 5-minute intervals for walking groups
Two checkpoints: the Bernard lookout tower and the lookout tower at Orlík Castle
Route along paved and unpaved paths; navigation by map, compass, or GPS is possible
additional: A medal is provided for the first 100 registered runners. Water is available to runners at the checkpoint at Orlík Castle. The entry fee entitles participants to refreshments at the finish (alcoholic and non-alcoholic beer). Runners must have both checkpoints marked on their runner card for their time to count. Registration is available online or by email until 8 May 2026; on-site registration is possible subject to the organizer’s terms. The event is for people over 15; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian. The first 100 people to register will receive a medal.

name: FREEDOM RUN
location: Harrachov to Jakuszyce, Czech Republic and Poland
description: FREEDOM RUN is a running race offering two route options through the mountain scenery of the Krkonoše Mountains, with a cross-border atmosphere between Czechia and Poland. The shorter Classic route is 9 km long and runs from Harrachov through Nový Svět to the Mýtiny area and the Polish village of Orle. The longer Mega route is 16 km and is more technically and physically demanding, with greater elevation gain and mountain scenery. Both routes start in Harrachov, and the race combines forest trails with the rolling terrain of the western Krkonoše Mountains. The race is organized with an emphasis on quality and the runners’ experience.
course_highlights: The route passes through the mountain scenery of the Krkonoše Mountains on forest trails
A cross-border atmosphere between Czechia (Harrachov) and Poland (Orle)
Rolling terrain with a gradual elevation gain in the Mýtiny area
additional: The entry fee includes a timing chip and a race bib. The 2027 race was canceled for organizational and technical reasons, and its debut has been postponed until next year. Entry fees already paid will be refunded to participants.

name: Charitativní běh pro Emmičku
description: The Charity Run for Emmička is a traditional sporting event held to support little Emmička, who has serious health problems. The run takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Kramolna, by the fire station, and offers routes suitable for runners and families with children, including the option to run with dogs on a leash. The routes follow paved forest paths that are also accessible to sports strollers and wheelchairs, and participants can choose to run or walk according to their abilities. The event is dog-friendly and fosters a community atmosphere, with the aim of helping Emmička through sport and voluntary donations.
course_highlights: 3 km and 7 km routes along paved forest paths
Option for children to take part in a 200 m race
Accessible to sports strollers and wheelchairs; dog-friendly (dogs must be on a leash)
additional: The event is dog-friendly; dogs must be on a leash or harness throughout the run. Participants can run or walk at their own pace.

name: Běh ve Skalce – Memoriál Radomila Večeři
location: Skalka u Prostějova, Prostějov District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh ve Skalce - Radomil Večeřa Memorial is a traditional running race organized by the Prostějov Marathon Club in the beautiful surroundings of Skalka near Prostějov. The race gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on challenging routes through a natural forest park with good signage. The event is suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of the Olomouc Region. The club also regularly organizes other running events and supports the local running community.
course_highlights: Skalka forest park near Prostějov
Well-marked routes along cycle paths and partly on roads
Beautiful natural surroundings of the Drahany Highlands
additional: Registration has been handled through a partner system since 2026. The race is part of the Prostějov Marathon Club’s regular events. Maps of the routes and information about other running races in the region are available on the website.

name: Běh kolem Babího lomu
location: Kulturní dům, Kuřim-Podlesí, Kuřim, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 100 Kč (zahrnuto občerstvení po závodě, pro děti je startovné dobrovolné)

description: The Run Around Babí lom is a traditional race in the Kuřim Running League, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kuřim-Podlesí. The race offers a hilly 8.4 km course that runs almost entirely through the forest, giving runners an enjoyable trail experience. Children can take part in a fun run on a shorter loop. Race facilities are available at the cultural centre, where participants can change, and refreshments are provided after the race. The start and registration are at the sports field by the cultural centre.
course_highlights: Hilly 8.4 km course, almost entirely through the forest
Children’s fun run on a shorter 2.6 km loop
Changing facilities and refreshments at the cultural centre
additional: Registration takes place at the race venue from 9:00 to 9:45. After the race, refreshments are available at Hospůdka U Anděla in exchange for returning the race number. Online registration is available, with the option of a discount on the entry fee. The race is part of the Kuřim Running League and takes place off public roads.

name: Běh choceňskými sady
location: Park u choceňského zámku, Choceň, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Choceň Gardens is a traditional running race organized by the Choceň Ski Club, held in the picturesque park by Choceň Castle. The race offers various courses for adults and youth categories, allowing participants to enjoy running in a natural setting with high-quality organization. It is part of the ISCAREX Cup and attracts runners of all ages and ability levels. It is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners looking to enjoy a pleasant day of sport in Choceň Gardens.
course_highlights: Run in the park by Choceň Castle
Various course distances from 0.15 km to 15 km
Categories for children and adults
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers a wide range of categories based on age and course distance. It is organized by the Choceň Ski Club. The total number of participants across all editions exceeds 4,500. Registration is available through the ISCAREX Cup website.

name: Modrý Werth
location: Josefov–Hřebeny, Sokolov District, Karlovy Vary Region, Czech Republic
description: Modrý Werth is a forest running race in the area around Luh nad Svatavou, Hartenberg Castle and the Svatava River. The main running routes are 10.5 km and 5.6 km, and the programme also includes children’s races. The event also offers a walking route and a dog trek, giving participants with different goals and paces a choice of activities.
course_highlights: Forest routes around Luh nad Svatavou
A run around Hartenberg Castle and the Svatava River
Main courses of 10.5 km and 5.6 km, plus children’s routes
additional: The programme also includes a walking route, a dog trek and children’s races on courses ranging from 150 m to 1,760 m.

name: Polevský běh
location: Lyžařská bouda na Jedličné, Polevsko–Kytlice, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: předem přes web nazavody.cz do 8.5. za zvýhodněné startovné

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: předem přes web nazavody.cz do 8.5. za zvýhodněné startovné

description: The Polevský Run is a traditional running race organized by the Ski Polevsko club in the picturesque Lusatian Mountains between Polevsko and Kytlice. The race features a varied route across rolling, hilly terrain, partly following winter ski trails, forest paths and pastures, with beautiful views of the surrounding peaks and landscape. Choose between 5 km and 10 km routes; children’s races are also included, making the event suitable for all ages and abilities, including families with children. Race facilities are at the ski lodge in Jedličná, where registration, the start and the finish take place.
course_highlights: Rolling, hilly terrain in the Lusatian Mountains
The route follows winter ski trails, forest paths and pastures
Beautiful views of Klíč, Ještěd, Jedlová, Ralsko, Bohemian and Saxon Switzerland, Bezděz and the Česká Lípa region
additional: You can register online until 8 May for a discounted entry fee. Payment is accepted on site in cash or via QR code. Race numbers must be collected in good time, no later than half an hour before the start; otherwise, runners will not be allowed to start. Parking is available in the nearby parking area in Jedličná and, if it reaches capacity, in the winter car park below Jedličná. The race is part of the Česká Lípa District Running League. The programme also includes children’s races.

name: Lesní běh Kalichem
location: Besedice, Koberovy, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kalich Forest Run is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Koberovy in the beautiful countryside of the Bohemian Paradise, in an area called Kalich. The race is open to all age groups, from preschoolers to seniors over 60 who enjoy running in nature. Starts are divided into several age categories so everyone competes against evenly matched opponents. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent refreshments, and the participation of dozens to hundreds of runners each year. The organizers provide full event management, including timing and refreshments featuring traditional dishes and drinks.
course_highlights: A run through the beautiful countryside of the Bohemian Paradise in the Kalich area
Age categories ranging from preschoolers to seniors
Traditional refreshments including chicken legs, sausages, and draft beer
additional: Race-day registration runs from 8:00 to 9:15, with the first category starting at 9:25. The event is held under the patronage of the Koberovy Municipal Office and is supported by a grant program of the Liberec Region. The organizers provide timing, course setup, and refreshments at the race venue.

name: Běh Violky
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Loučná nad Desnou, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Violka Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Kouty nad Desnou in the Olomouc Region. The race gives runners the opportunity to enjoy challenging terrain, beautiful views and the natural scenery of the Jeseníky Mountains. The course is suitable for experienced runners looking for the challenge of a mountain run. The event is friendly and welcomes everyone who loves running and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with elevation gain
Picturesque views of the Jeseníky Mountains
Forest and mountain trails
additional: A JPG course map is available on the official website. Results from previous editions are published online.

name: Běh na Červenou horu
location: Štěchovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Červená hora is a 3.71 km hill race with 270 metres of elevation gain, held in the scenic surroundings of Štěchovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. The route is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts and offers beautiful views and natural scenery. It’s ideal for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Route length: 3.71 km
Elevation gain: 270 m
Part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Jihlava

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in Jihlava is a charity running event held at the Amphitheatre. Participants can choose between two routes: a short 3 km loop and a long 4.8 km loop. The run starts at 9:00 p.m. and is accompanied by a cultural programme, including a concert. The entry fee is CZK 500, half of which goes to support the Světluška project, which helps people with severe visual impairments. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers and is organised with participants’ safety and comfort in mind.
course_highlights: Two loops: a short 3 km route and a long 4.8 km route
Night run with a choice of entry option including a headlamp or a sports headband
Starts at the Amphitheatre in Jihlava, with an accompanying cultural programme
additional: Registration is via the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or a sports headband. Capacity is limited to ensure participants’ safety and comfort. Children under 15 can attend for free, without a headlamp or headband; holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards can also attend for free, without equipment. A changing room and baggage storage, refreshments and medical services are available on site. Dogs are not allowed at the Jihlava event because the route passes through the zoo.

name: KPMG Noc rekordů
location: Atletický stadion Děkanka, Praha, Czech Republic
description: KPMG Night of Records is a running show held under the patronage of KPMG partner Eva Bláhová, British Ambassador Matt Field, and Czech 5,000-metre record holder Jiří Sýkora. The event attracts elite athletes, enthusiasts, and young sportspeople, while its proceeds support children’s physical activity. Prague’s Děkanka is the venue, where records are regularly broken and more than a hundred children compete. It is an exciting sporting event featuring a live broadcast and a rich programme.
course_highlights: Prague’s Děkanka as the race venue
Czech 5,000-metre record holder Jiří Sýkora taking part
More than 120 competing children and elite athletes
additional: The event includes a live broadcast, start lists, results, and prize money.

name: FyzioRUN
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The charitable sporting event FYZIORUN invites all runners to take part in a certified 5 km race in the beautiful setting of Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve. The event is organized by the Cystic Fibrosis Patients Club and supports people living with the condition. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an enjoyable outdoor sporting experience in Prague 6. Come support a good cause and enjoy a run in good company.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Beautiful setting of Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve
Charity run supporting people with cystic fibrosis
additional: The Club is open Monday–Friday, 8:00–12:00. The organizers can be contacted by phone or email. Visits to the Club must be arranged in advance due to health precautions for patients.

name: Planderský běh
location: Obecní úřad v Plandrech, Plandry, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kè - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line

description: The Plandry Run is a traditional cross-country race organized by the municipality of Plandry and Běžec Vysočiny, held in the picturesque surroundings of Plandry. The race offers various categories for men, women, juniors, veterans and children, with distances from 220 metres to 9 kilometres. The course runs along paved and unpaved paths, including a loop in the former castle park by the Jihlava River, with a turnaround at Brandl’s Mill. The mass start is at 18:00 by the municipal office in Plandry. The race is suitable for people of all ages who enjoy sport, and offers prizes for the top finishers in each category as well as refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: 3 km loop on forest and field paths, with 16% on asphalt
600 m and 220 m loops for younger categories on local roads
Turnaround at Brandl’s Mill in the former castle park by the Jihlava River
additional: Runners aged 3 and over may take part. After the race, refreshments are available at the local volunteer fire brigade clubhouse, with roast pork available for purchase. Běžec Vysočiny sports T-shirts will be sold at a reduced price during the event. The bus from Jihlava departs at 16:20; there is no return bus. According to the available information, the mass start is at 18:00 by the municipal office in Plandry.

name: Závadská desítka
location: Přírodní rezervace Dařanec, Závada, Hlučín, Czech Republic
description: Závadská desítka is a 10 km cross-country race along forest trails around the Dařanec Nature Reserve near Závada. This highly appealing race has become a regular part of the Prajzsko-Opava Running League (POBL), where it is considered the most attractive short-distance race. Safety along the course is ensured by race marshals, and a refreshment station is provided at the 6 km mark. The race is divided into several men’s, women’s and youth categories, including special categories for local residents and people born in Závada, who compete for a travelling trophy.
course_highlights: Cross-country race along forest trails in the Dařanec Nature Reserve
Refreshment station at the 6 km mark
A traditional race in the Prajzsko-Opava Running League (POBL)
additional: The race is divided into five men’s, four women’s and three youth categories. There is one refreshment station on the course. The race has special categories for local residents and people born in Závada, with a travelling trophy at stake. The race is part of the Prajzsko-Opava Running League (POBL) and includes categories for local residents and people born in Závada, who compete for a travelling trophy.

name: Běh města Nýřany
location: Atletický stadion ZŠ Nýřany, Nýřany, Czech Republic
organizer: Atletclub Nýřany, z.s. a komise pro školství, sport a kulturu

price_tiers.distance: Hlavní závod 10 km a týmový běh 2x 5 km

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Děti s bydlištěm mimo okolí Nýřan mají start zpoplatněný částkou 30,00 Kč

description: The Nýřany Town Run is a traditional athletics event organized by ATLETCLUB Nýřany, z.s. It offers a main 10 km race, including a 2 × 5 km team race, as well as additional races for children. The event takes place at the athletic stadium of ZŠ Nýřany and is suitable for all age groups, including children from Nýřany and the surrounding area. After the race, participants can enjoy a disco on the paved court in front of the stadium. Registration is available online and on site, with different fees. The event has a friendly atmosphere and promotes sports activity in the community.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race, with the option of a 2 × 5 km team race
Additional races for children, with free entry for local children
Post-race disco on the paved court in front of the athletic stadium
additional: On-site registration is available for a higher fee. Children’s race numbers are distributed at schools or in the white booth next to the gym. The disco starts at 18:00 and is free for all participants. The event takes place at the athletic stadium of ZŠ Nýřany. Children’s races are free or have a nominal fee; the program concludes with a disco with free admission.

name: Mácháč Run Fest
location: Rekreační zařízení Karolínka pod Borným, Staré Splavy, Czech Republic
organizer: Mácháč brothers crew, Jan Venca Francke
description: Mácháč Run Fest is a hilly cross-country race through the beautiful countryside around Lake Máchovo, offering distances of 160 km, 60 km, 25 km, 10 km, and 5 km. The race is 90% off-road, ensuring a challenging and appealing running experience. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting with varied terrain. The start is at RZ Karolínka pod Borným, an ideal location for nature lovers and trail runners.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country terrain with 90% natural surfaces
Distances from 5 km up to an ultramarathon of 160 km
Picturesque countryside around Lake Máchovo
additional: For the 2024 edition, the 100-mile distance is listed as starting at 19:00 from RZ Karolínka pod Borným; details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Lesempolem
location: Sportovní areál, Veselice, Vavřinec, Czech Republic
description: Lesempolem is a traditional running race held in the scenic village of Veselice in the Moravian Karst. It offers three distances—14 km, a marathon (42 km), and an ultramarathon (84 km)—running mostly along forest and field paths around the Podvrší lookout tower, with beautiful views and a chance to run in nature. The race is suitable for all runners, from amateurs to experienced competitors, and the marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The start and finish are at the sports complex in Veselice, where a varied program, refreshments, and a friendly atmosphere await.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly along forest and field paths around the Podvrší lookout tower
Beautiful views and a chance to run in the natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst
Three distances: 14 km, a marathon (42 km), and an ultramarathon (84 km)
additional: Plenty of refreshments are available on the course and at the finish, including water, tea, sports drinks, fruit, and a traditional rum refreshment stop. At the finish, runners can enjoy homemade soup and vegetarian treats, and all finishers receive a medal. Registration takes place at the cultural center in Veselice, which also serves as race headquarters. Parking is 200 m from registration. Overnight stays in your own sleeping bag are available at the cultural center for a nominal fee. A cultural program and children's races are planned for spectators.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Karlovy Vary 2026
location: nábřeží Osvobození, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The Mattoni 1/2Marathon Karlovy Vary is a unique race in the heart of the spa town of Karlovy Vary. The World Athletics-certified course passes the iconic Thermal and Pupp hotels and other UNESCO landmarks, offering a beautiful run along the colonnade with views of world-famous hotels and historic sites. The race is part of the Mattoni Running Festival and attracts runners of all levels who want to combine the joy of running with discovering the beauty of the city.
course_highlights: The course passes the iconic Thermal and Pupp hotels
It runs along a unique colonnade in the spa town
The route is surrounded by UNESCO landmarks
additional: Registration is available only with a registration code. Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order photos during registration or after the race. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and offers special categories such as relays and a healthcare workers’ run.

name: Dobřichovický kros půlmaraton a 10 km
location: Nádvoří dobřichovického zámku, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Cross-Country Half Marathon and 10 km is a traditional running race organized by Radost v pohybu in the picturesque courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. The race offers courses for children under 10, 10 km runners, and more experienced half-marathon runners. The half-marathon route combines flat terrain with more challenging hilly sections and has refreshment stations. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, from beginners to advanced runners, and creates a pleasant atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: The half-marathon’s first half is flat and its second half is hilly
Refreshment stations at 5, 10, and 15 km on the half-marathon course
The 10 km course is mostly flat, with one refreshment station
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free for children under 10. Results for the children’s race are announced as soon as all the children have finished. The 10 km race awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:30. The routes are available online at mapy.cz. The race is suitable for runners of all levels. The 1 km children’s race is free; there are refreshment stations on the courses, and participants receive a commemorative medal.

name: Rakovnická 100
description: Rakovnická 100 is a challenging ultramarathon covering more than 100 kilometres, with around 2,400 metres of elevation gain, set in the picturesque Křivoklátsko region. The route is known for its fords, rivers and ferry crossing, adding interest and challenge to the race. The event is well organised and is a popular test of fitness and endurance for experienced runners and walkers alike. A shorter 60 km option is also available for less experienced participants. The start and finish are traditionally on Husovo Square in Rakovník.
course_highlights: A route of more than 100 km with 2,400 m of elevation gain
Fords, rivers and one ferry crossing along the route
The picturesque Křivoklátsko region
additional: The race is considered a less demanding ultramarathon, suitable for testing your actual capabilities. The route is revised and extended slightly, and participants can look forward to good organisation and aid stations. The organisers recommend bringing the essential equipment for a long route and offer the option of staying overnight before the start.

name: Májový běh Slapy
description: The May Slapy Run is a family-friendly spring race held in the picturesque woods around Slapy. It offers off-road courses of varying distances and elevation, suitable for both adults and children, who may be accompanied by their parents. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running cup and emphasizes the joy of exercise and shared experiences in nature. The start and registration are at the Sigma Slapy complex, which offers facilities including changing rooms and toilets. The tenth anniversary edition brings its traditional atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Main race: 7.5 km with 225 m of elevation gain on forest paths featuring climbs and descents
Children’s races: 1.4 km and 2.8 km with minimal elevation gain; parents may accompany children
The route passes Vyhlídka Hill and old gold mines and is marked with white arrows
additional: 43. You can change and leave non-valuable belongings near the start. Toilets are available. The route is marked with white arrows on the ground. Expect uneven terrain and, when wet, mud. The first three finishers in each category receive a medal and a small prize; every child receives a reward. Changing facilities and baggage storage are available at the Sigma Slapy complex. Children receive a reward.

name: Městecká desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Městecká Desítka is a traditional running race in Městec Králové, offering 10 km and 5 km courses and a 1 km children’s race. The race takes place on asphalt roads and paths with minimal elevation gain, with the start and finish at Náměstí Republiky. The event attracts hundreds of runners and is known for its course records and friendly atmosphere. Refreshments are available after the race, and results are sent by SMS.
course_highlights: Course with no significant elevation gain
Surface: 80% asphalt roads, 20% paving and paths
Start and finish at Náměstí Republiky in Městec Králové
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. An SMS with your finishing time is sent after the race. On-site registration will not be available. NO.6 technical T-shirt available for 490 Kč. Prizes for the top three men and women in each category.

name: 7 pohoří Orlické hory
location: Deštné v Orlických horách, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: 7 Mountains Orlické Mountains is part of the largest trail running series in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The race offers technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won’t experience anywhere else. The routes pass through the picturesque countryside of the Orlické Mountains, including a climb to their highest peak, Velká Deštná. Whether you’re an experienced runner or a beginner, the race will test your strength, willpower and determination.
course_highlights: Main course: 24 km with 920 m of elevation gain
Climb to the highest peak in the Orlické Mountains, Velká Deštná (1,115 m)
The route follows forest paths, with views of Šerlich and the Polish border
additional: The race time limit is 4 hours. There are aid stations along the course with water, sports drinks, fruit and biscuits. Every participant receives a commemorative medal after finishing. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. Small items can be stored at the registration tent. The race takes place in all weather.

name: Energon běh – Penzion Nový rybník
location: Penzion Nový rybník, Obořiště, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Energon Run at the Nový rybník guesthouse in Obořiště is a traditional running event with courses for children and adults. The main race for adults and relay teams is run over four laps combining asphalt and off-road surfaces. The children’s routes follow a dirt road to Rosovice and back, with distances adapted to age. The event is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers a pleasant atmosphere in a natural setting.
course_highlights: The course combines asphalt, dirt, and forest paths
The main race consists of 4 laps combining asphalt and off-road surfaces
The children’s routes follow a dirt road to Rosovice and back
additional: Start and finish at the Nový rybník guesthouse. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. Children’s races are part of the event. Results are published in the Brdy Running Cup system.

name: Hostivice RUN
location: Litovický rybník, Litovická, Hostivice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hostivice RUN is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Hostivice, offering courses for all age groups, including children’s races. The races take place around the Hostivice ponds and feature distances ranging from 550 metres for children to a half marathon. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to enjoy outdoor sports. It is organised by MKSH, a contributory organisation, which ensures the race runs professionally and provides accompanying services.
course_highlights: Loops around the Hostivice ponds, with natural and forest sections
A choice of 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 4 km cross-country courses
Children’s races of approximately 550 metres, with age-based categories
additional: The start and finish are at the Litovická × Na Hrázi intersection in Hostivice. Race-number collection is available in the days before the race at the Hostivice Municipal Library. On race day, bus services are limited and roads around the course are temporarily closed.

name: Hradubický běh (start Pardubice)
location: Poděbradská bus stop, Poděbradská Street, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Hradubický Run is an unconventional, friendly run connecting the cities of Pardubice and Hradec Králové. The 10 km route starts in Pardubice on Poděbradská Street, by the “Poděbradská” public transport stop. The event is for runners who want to experience a run between two major cities in a friendly atmosphere. The start is scheduled for 15 May 2027 at 9:00.
course_highlights: The route connects the cities of Pardubice and Hradec Králové
The run is 10 km long
The start is on Poděbradská Street, by the “Poděbradská” public transport stop
additional: The event is unconventional and friendly, with two starts and one finish. It is organized by pé há sedmička, an organization dedicated to unconventional cultural and sporting events. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The stated start location in Pardubice is the Poděbradská public transport stop.
