description: Stonařov Alleys is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1978, held in the picturesque surroundings of Stonařov in the Vysočina Region. The main race follows dirt and forest paths along a stream and along Green Alley to a hunting lodge. The course has a gentler elevation profile and is mostly soft underfoot, with about 30% asphalt. The event offers races for various age groups, from preschoolers to veterans, with distances ranging from 200 metres to 10 km. Every participant receives a commemorative prize, while category winners receive prizes and medals.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race follows dirt and forest paths, with 30% asphalt.
The route runs along a stream and Green Alley to a hunting lodge.
A gentler elevation profile and mostly soft surfaces.
additional: The start is at the football pitch. Categories are for participants aged 3 and over. Youth runners can take part for free. Every participant receives a certificate and a small pack. The first three finishers in each category receive prizes; youth participants receive medals. The travelling Stonařov Runner’s Cup is awarded to the best man and woman in the main race. According to the available description, participants receive a commemorative prize and certificate, while category winners receive prizes and the travelling Stonařov Runner’s Cup.

name: Jistebnický VH maraton
location: Sportovní areál TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Jistebník VH Marathon is a traditional running event held amid the picturesque countryside on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area, with routes ranging from 3.6 km to a marathon. The start and finish for all races are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The races offer beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains and also include a children’s Olympics with an accompanying program, making the event appealing to whole families and runners of all ages. The event is organized by Jistebník v pohybu z. s., which focuses on a friendly atmosphere and quality facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Routes run through the countryside on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area, with views of the Beskydy Mountains
Start and finish at the TJ Jistebník sports complex
A varied selection of routes from 3.6 km to a marathon, including relay races
additional: Registration for all races opens at 7:00 and closes 20 minutes before the start of each race. Refreshments are available on the course, and one refreshment is provided at the finish; additional drinks and food are available at the local pub, known for its Marathon Soup. Parking is available near the sports complex and at the railway station; using train and bus connections is recommended. Runners can receive a discount on their entry fee if they donate blood or blood plasma.

name: Vrané – Zvole
description: Vrané - Zvole is part of the KOPEC series, which features hill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers a challenge in the form of a demanding climb and is intended for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. The KOPEC series is a long-running and popular circuit where participants are automatically included in the overall standings without needing to register separately. The races are organized with an emphasis on fairness, safety, and sportsmanship.

name: Štramberská desítka
description: Štramberk Ten is a traditional road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place in the picturesque town of Štramberk and offers a 10 km route over mixed terrain, mostly on roads. The race is open to the general public and is known for its friendly atmosphere and rich history. Participants can expect refreshments at the finish and prizes for the top runners in various categories. The race takes place amid road traffic, and all participants run at their own risk.

name: Berounská desítka
description: Berounská desítka is a revived running race with a long tradition, held in the village of Zdejcina near Beroun. It offers three courses: the main 10 km race for experienced runners, a shorter 4 km route suitable for everyone, and a free 500 m children’s run. The course follows forest paths with 252 metres of elevation gain, reaching its highest point at the Děd lookout tower, 491 m above sea level. Runners can look forward to refreshments during the race and after finishing, as well as a welcoming atmosphere that revives the local running tradition.

name: Orelský běh lesoparkem Skalky, memoriál prof. P. Leopolda Benáčka
description: The Orel Run through Skalky Forest Park is a traditional sporting event organized by Orel, a Christian sports organization, in Olešnice in the South Moravian Region. The Prof. P. Leopold Benáček Memorial gives runners the chance to compete in the beautiful natural surroundings of Skalky Forest Park. The event is part of Orel’s broader program, which promotes sport for everyone in the spirit of fair play and a healthy lifestyle. The race is suitable for the general public and helps develop sporting activities in the region.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov
location: Letkov u Plzně, Sportpenzion Pohoda, Plzeňský
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Letkov is a traditional trail running race near Plzeň, offering scenic routes of varying lengths and difficulty. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Letkov and is part of the celebrations marking the village’s 750th anniversary. The course passes Jandova skála and Čilina, and also includes a marathon with climbs to Maršál and Radyně. A multigenerational relay is available for children and families, encouraging people of all generations to stay active.

name: Libouchecký UltraMaraton
description: Tisá Ultra Trail is a new event that continues the tradition of the Libouchec Ultramarathon. It offers several routes of varying lengths and difficulty in the beautiful surroundings of Tisá and the surrounding area. The races run mostly off paved roads, along forest and field roads and trails, with clear course markings. The event facilities are well equipped, with showers, changing rooms and refreshments, as well as the option to spend the night in your own tent or car. The organizers emphasize safety and environmental responsibility, for example by limiting the use of plastic cups at refreshment stations.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
description: Běhej lesy Brdy is a trail race held in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, not far from Prague and Příbram. The race offers various routes, including short and long distances, which are part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can enjoy beautiful natural scenery, technical sections, and competitions for valuable prizes. The finish straight has been extended to 500 metres, adding an exciting feature for all participants. The Běhej lesy series is known for its community atmosphere and respect for nature.

name: Běh pro hospic Litoměřice
description: The Run for the Litoměřice Hospice is a charity sporting event held to support St. Stephen’s Hospice in Litoměřice. Participants run to help those nearing the end of their lives, contributing to the funding and support of hospice care. The event takes place in beautiful surroundings and features professional timekeeping. “Those who run help” is the race’s main motto.

name: Milada Run
description: Milada Run is part of the popular Milada Tour sports series, held in the unique landscape of a former lignite mine transformed into the natural Lake Milada. The 10th-anniversary edition offers a friendly, family atmosphere, with routes for children and adults. The races follow rolling and flat paths, with beautiful views of the lake and surrounding countryside. The event’s high standard and popularity are confirmed by the participants themselves.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb
location: Horský hotel Čarták, Hutisko - Solanec, Zlínský
description: Salomon Valašský Hrb is a mountain running race suitable for beginners and endurance runners, held in the picturesque surroundings of Horský hotel Čarták in Hutisko-Solanec. The race offers distances of 50 km, 30 km, 20 km, and 10 km, following a paved ridge trail with stunning views. This race is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of nature while enjoying a sporting challenge. Come and enjoy the atmosphere and challenge of mountain terrain in the heart of the Zlín Region.

name: VolšoHEC RUN
description: VolšoHEC RUN is a traditional charity relay race held in the beautiful surroundings of Olšovec pond in the South Moravian Region. The race offers two relay formats: 4×5.5 km and 2×11 km, covering a total half-marathon distance of 21.1 km. The event supports children in need, with all entry fees and voluntary contributions for original running jerseys going directly to the Život dětem public-benefit organization. The program also includes free children’s races and a non-competitive scooter ride. The race is ideal for teams looking to combine athletic achievement with supporting a good cause.

name: Krok za Šimonka
description: A Step for Šimonek is a sporting event organized to support a fundraiser for Šimonek, a boy living with the rare metabolic disorder Lesch–Nyhan syndrome. The event offers a fun-filled day of sports for the whole family at Skalka near Nový Jičín. Its aim is not only to support treatment and rehabilitation, but also to raise awareness of the disorder and the strength of the community. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to support a good cause.

name: Běh pro úsměv – Pelhřimovský půlmaraton
description: Běh pro úsměv is a sporting event for the whole family, held at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov. This half marathon in Pelhřimov is suitable for sporty and non-sporty families, active seniors, and children from the age of 1. You don’t have to run the race—you can walk it. Half of the entry fees go to the Julinka Endowment Fund, which fights childhood obesity. The children’s and parents’ races take place one after the other, and while waiting for their parents, children can enjoy activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, scooter rides, or learning first aid.

name: Memoriál Ivana Belobrada
description: The Ivan Belobrad Memorial is a traditional running race held in Dlouhoňovice and is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The race offers courses of up to 9 km, running along village roads, forest and field paths, with varied surfaces. The event is suitable for the general public, including young people and children, with an option for the youngest participants to start individually. It takes place in a pleasant sports complex and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Přibyslavský kros
organizer: Město Přibyslav ve spolupráci s ACO Industries k.s.
description: Přibyslav Cross-Country Run is a cross-country and trail run held in the picturesque surroundings of Přibyslav near Nová Paka in the Hradec Králové Region. The race offers two courses, 8 km and 4 km long, running through nature and along forest paths. The main category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for both the general public and competitive runners to take part. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec, who ensure the event is well organized.

name: Běh do vrchu Poniklá – Rezek
location: Tuláčkova náves, Poniklá, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Poniklá–Rezek uphill race is a traditional sporting event held in the village of Poniklá. The race starts at Tuláčkovo náves and climbs uphill to Rezek. It is suitable for runners who enjoy challenges on natural terrain and want to spend an active day in beautiful surroundings. The organizer is Petr Holec, who ensures the race runs smoothly.

name: Bóžovo 59ka
description: Bóžovo 59ka is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Ski Club in Aš, Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers a sporting experience in beautiful surroundings, with club members and the public welcome to take part. Jasan Ski Club is known for its long-standing tradition and active approach to training and racing in the region.

name: Běh o štěně okolo Poděbrad - memoriál Zdeňka Slepičky
description: Běh o štěně - Zdeněk Slepička Memorial is a 7.2 km cross-country race held in Hejčín, Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and offers runners an interesting course through natural terrain. It is suitable for cross-country running enthusiasts who want to test themselves on a challenging course with varied surfaces. The race has a long tradition and is named in memory of Zdeněk Slepička.

name: Žlutavská 11
description: Žlutavská 11 is a running race that takes you through the picturesque hills around the village of Žlutava. It offers courses for all age groups, from the youngest children to a race over 11 km long. Runners can enjoy plenty of refreshments and comfortable facilities, including changing rooms and showers. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful countryside around Žlutava.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Brno
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Brno is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place by the Anthropos Pavilion and offers timed runs of 6 km and 10.5 km, a 4 x 2.5 km relay, and untimed family and children’s runs. The route follows the Svratka River on paved paths and asphalt. Participants’ entry fees help fund the recording and preservation of witnesses’ stories and educational programs.

name: Jistebnický vodohospodářský půlmaraton
description: The Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running event, now in its sixteenth year, held in the picturesque countryside on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. Races range from 3.6 km to a marathon, with relay races and a children’s Olympics also on offer. They start and finish at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The routes pass through the countryside, with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains, and run between the villages of Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou and Klimkovice. The event also features a varied programme of activities and is suitable for a wide range of runners and families with children.

name: Krušnej seběh
description: Krušnej seběh is a traditional running race organized by Bike Team Nejdek, held in the picturesque surroundings of Nové Hamry in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers two courses: the longer FullHD, approximately 14 km long, and the shorter HD, 7 km long. They run mainly along forest trails and paved paths, with hilly terrain and technical sections. The start and finish are in Nové Hamry, and the start time has been moved earlier so the race takes up only part of the morning. The race is suitable for all runners looking to experience a challenging but appealing cross-country run in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běšinský běh
description: The Běšinský Run is a traditional running race held in Běšiny near Klatovy, featuring a 4.8 km course. The race is mixed-category and includes a mountain prize, adding to its appeal and challenge for runners. The start is at the football pitch, and the race takes place in all weather. It is organized by Sokol Běšiny, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and a safe event.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Olomouc
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Olomouc is a sporting and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of people who witnessed history. The race takes place in Smetana and Čech Gardens and offers timed 5 km and 10 km runs and a 4 × 2.5 km relay, as well as untimed children’s and family runs. The start and finish are by the collection greenhouses in Smetana Gardens. The event is suitable for all age groups and supports remembrance of heroism and freedom.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Jihlava
organizer: Post Bellum, z. ú. a Parlament Gymnázia Jihlava
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Jihlava is a sporting and community event held in support of the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Český mlýn grounds, with the start and finish behind the skatepark. Runners can choose between timed 4 km and 10 km runs or untimed children’s and family races. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant setting on the paved paths of the cycling trails. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and support for the Memory of the Nation.

name: Zaječice
location: Přehvozdí, Kolín District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno is a family-friendly running event offering distances for recreational and elite runners of 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Brno Reservoir and is part of an eight-race series held across the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy excellent race services, a race pack and a varied programme of activities for the whole family. Every runner contributes to charity and can become a loyal RunTour Master.
course_highlights: 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses in the unique surroundings of the Brno Reservoir
Children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres
Refreshment stations on the 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon courses
additional: The event provides a medical team and pacers, refreshments at the finish and on selected courses, an official gymsack with gifts from partners, and a children’s race pack from Lidl. There is a children’s area with childcare and warm-up sessions for children. Running shoes can be borrowed from the race partner. A dedicated emergency medical service phone line is available for the event. Changing rooms, a bag drop and showers are available; refreshment stations are also provided on selected courses. Race services include medical support and pacers.

name: Sudický hraničák
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Sudice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Vysocká pětka - vzpomínka na Jirku S.
location: Vysoká nad Labem, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Vysocká pětka is a 5 km running race held in the village of Vysoká nad Labem. The race is held in memory of Jirka S. and traditionally follows a cycle path. The start is scheduled for 9:00, with check-in from 8:00. The event is open to all runners and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with a chance to win a prize in the raffle.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Race along a cycle path
Friendly atmosphere with a raffle
additional: Participant check-in from 8:00; race starts at 9:00; the race follows a cycle path; chance to win a prize in the raffle. The race is part of the local sports calendar and is open to the general public. Exact course distances and registration information have not yet been published.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Libčice nad Vltavou is a sports and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The event offers timed 5 km and 10 km races with a mass start, along paved paths and roads through a forest park and along a cycle path. It is suitable for all age groups and helps commemorate the history and courage of freedom fighters. Race numbers are issued at the registration venue on race day. The event also includes a children’s race and the option of a symbolic “Anywhere!” run outside the official courses.

name: Půlmaraton údolím Moravské Sázavy
description: The Moravská Sázava Valley Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Zábřeh na Moravě. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and runs mostly over flat terrain, with a gentle climb between Nemile and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and offers quality facilities, including refreshment stations and a children’s race. The race starts at the swimming complex in Zábřeh, which is also the finish venue. Participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments at the finish.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
location: Sportovní areál U školy - Říčany, Středočeský
description: The Říčany Forest Half Marathon is a running race held entirely on beautiful forest roads and trails, with no asphalt. The surrounding countryside around Říčany is particularly scenic in late May, adding to the enjoyment of the run. The race is ideal for lovers of natural terrain and cross-country running who want to experience the forest atmosphere and the challenge of a half-marathon distance. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and encourage them to share their race experiences.

name: Příbramský půlmaraton
description: The Příbram Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Příbram, offering a half-marathon course, a relay race, a fitness run, and children’s races. The event is known for its new route and magical atmosphere, especially on the descent to the square. It attracts a wide running community every year and provides quality facilities, including refreshments and parking.

name: Běh cestou necestou 13 km Prahou 13
location: Centrální park Stodůlky, Praha 13, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Běh cestou necestou is a running race held in Prague 13, offering 13 km and 5 km courses. The race passes through the picturesque corners of Stodůlky Central Park and Prokopské údolí Nature Park. The start is at 13:13:13, and runners can make use of refreshments along the course and at the finish. The race is open to everyone and is run in the spirit of fair play, with an emphasis on following the marked route.

name: Teplýšovický běh
description: The Teplýšovice Run is a charity race held in the picturesque village of Teplýšovice near Benešov. In 2026, its 6th edition will feature 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km trail races, an 11 km Nordic Walking event, and children’s races. The main course passes the Špulka lookout tower and offers beautiful scenery and a challenging route. All courses are timed using chip timing, and every participant receives a medal. Part of the entry fee supports the restoration of fruit-tree avenues in the surrounding area.

name: Suchdol běží
description: Suchdol Runs is part of the seventh edition of the Běhej s námi 2026 running series, which is open to the general public. The race takes place in Suchdol, Prague 6, with the start and finish at the Community Garden. The course follows surfaced field and forest roads, with 96 metres of elevation gain. It offers runners a pleasant flat section, a descent into the valley and a return along forest roads. Categories are divided into children’s and adults’ age groups. Participants under 18 may take part only with written consent from a parent or legal guardian.

name: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň – květnový závod
description: TEMPO MAKERS RUN Plzeň is a regular running race held in Plzeň, featuring an 8 km course. The race takes place on the cycle path in the Pytel area and is open to all age groups. The start is scheduled for the evening, allowing runners to enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and spend time with fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers emphasize safety and fair competition. Times are recorded manually, and the race goes ahead in all weather except under extreme conditions.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - květen
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a running race organized by Plzeňští Tempo Makers, who organize running races, charity runs, and running training sessions. The event takes place in the picturesque Pytle area of Plzeň and offers an opportunity for runners of all levels. The race is part of a running community that supports an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport.

name: Okolo svaté Juliány
description: Okolo svaté Juliány is a running race in Prague-Přední Kopanina, with a 5,600-metre course that runs mostly along forest paths with minimal elevation gain. The start and registration are at the tourist shelter on the cycle path on K Juliáně Street, easily accessible by public transport. The race is open to various categories, including juniors, adults and veterans, and offers a friendly atmosphere with parking available nearby. The entry fee is symbolic, with a voluntary fee for some categories.

name: Koutecká vertikála
description: Koutecká Vertikála is a 2.5 km uphill race with 510 metres of elevation gain, held at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort. The race has a staggered start and is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which includes cross-country races in Šumperk and the surrounding area. This race offers a demanding, dynamic uphill run, ideal for fans of mountain running and vertical challenges.

name: Rasokros
location: Krčský les, Prague 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Rasokros is a running race in Krč Forest in Prague 4, offering men a 7.5 km course and women a 2.5 km course. The race is part of the SABZO series and is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable cross-country run in a natural setting. The route runs through forest terrain and offers the chance to enjoy a run in a peaceful part of Prague. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to test their strength in this attractive event.

name: 3. Pekelný kilometr
description: Pekelný kilometr is an uphill running race held at the Peklák ski resort in Česká Třebová. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series and features a 1 km course with staggered starts, climbing the ski slope over grass, snow and paths depending on the current weather. The children’s race starts at 17:00, and the main 1 km race begins at 18:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of age categories and is known for its atmosphere and challenging climb.

name: BĚKODO – květen III
location: Teplice-Doubravka, Teplice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: BĚKODO is the traditional 40th edition of a running series in Teplice, intended for recreational, fitness and competitive runners aged 15 and over. The series consists of the ten best-scoring starts during the season; in the event of a tie in points, the better time decides. The time limit for official timing is 35 minutes; runners who exceed it are recorded as 35+. A separate Mladé BĚKODO series is available for younger runners. The event is organized by TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and BK Běkodo.

name: Tolarova pětka
description: Tolarova Pětka is a running race held in Stříbro, offering a 5-kilometer course. The race is part of the Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro calendar and is intended for amateur and recreational runners. The route runs through the town park and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, there is a results ceremony and refreshments for participants.

name: Černovírská osmička
description: Černovírská osmička is a traditional running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Černovír. The race is part of the Haná Running Cup, which offers courses of various lengths and is open to all runners, regardless of age or performance level. The course runs through the picturesque landscape of the Olomouc Region and is suitable for beginners and experienced endurance runners alike. The organizers emphasize a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality race organization.

name: Kamenická 15
description: Kamenická 15 is a traditional running race in Kamenice near Jihlava. Adult runners take on a 15 km loop along paved roads and paths. Younger runners can choose from shorter 1.75 km and 0.4 km loops on paved roads in the village. The course passes through scenic spots in the surrounding area, including the hamlet of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge, and finishes at the starting point. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, from 3 years old, and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments and prizes for winners and young participants.

name: Kapličkobraní
location: Hřiště TJ Ludgeřovice, Ludgeřovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kapličkobraní is a non-competitive charity event that follows a route past 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice, with a total of 14 stops including the finish. The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, or even taking a stroller. The event has a deeper purpose, and all proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons Šimon and Matěj. Participants receive a commemorative magnet, light refreshments at the finish, and a tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels. Kapličkobraní received an award for the best low-budget sports project for small organizations.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
description: The Run through Mimoň Park is a race held in the chateau park in Mimoň, offering a flat course on paved paths along the Ploučnice River. The race is divided into 7-kilometre laps, with 7 km and 21 km distances available. The event is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners and is organised by Lenka Zeťová. The main category starts at 17:00, while the first category starts at 9:00. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and is held under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Nové Město na Moravě is a charity event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps preserve historical memories. The race takes place in and around Vysočina Arena, with 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes; the 5 km route is one lap and the 10 km route is two laps. The event offers timed and untimed runs, including family and children’s races, and is suitable for the general public, including pupils, students and seniors, who may be eligible for a discount on the entry fee. The start and finish are at the Vysočina Arena stadium, where facilities include changing rooms, baggage storage and refreshments.

name: Běh osvobození – Lišanská silniční sedmička
description: The Liberation Run – Lišany Road Seven is a traditional 7 km road race between the villages of Lišany and Lužná. The race takes place on a quiet third-class road and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. The start is in Lišany, where registration also takes place, and the finish is by the U Hřiště restaurant. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories and offers cash prizes, as well as a bonus for breaking the course records. The start time is 11:15. Entries are accepted on site on race day.

name: Běh Emericha Ratha
description: The Emerich Rath Run is a revived cross-country race held in Broumov, inviting runners to take part in the picturesque surroundings of Schroll Park near Cyklodům Broumov. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy a run in nature, with access to amenities such as bike rental, luggage storage, and an e-bike charging station. Registration takes place in the morning before the start, traditionally at 10:00. The organizers warmly invite all runners to join this sporting event with its friendly atmosphere.

name: Tuháčkův běh
description: Tuháček’s Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chrást u Příbrami as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The main race is approximately 8.2 km long and runs mostly along paved and gravel cycle paths around Chrást. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in dedicated children’s races. The main race starts at 11:00 at the Valcha complex. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete with other runners in beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton České Budějovice 2026
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival České Budějovice 2026 invites you to an unforgettable half marathon through the heart of the city’s historic centre. The start is on the second-largest square in the Czech Republic, Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., and the course offers a unique atmosphere and views of historic buildings and special places. This race is part of the popular RunCzech running series and is suitable for all runners who want to experience the charm of the South Bohemian capital during a day of sport. Join thousands of runners and enjoy a great sporting event in České Budějovice.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: The Chlum Three Ways race is the fourth event in the Rozhledny v pohybu series, held near Plzeň. Competitors tackle the prominent Chlum summit in three ways: a mass-start uphill race, an interval hill run, and a stair climb to the observation tower. The overall standings are based on the combined times from all three events, with bonuses for the top three finishers. Children can compete in ten age categories on courses around the observation tower. A relay is also available, with teams of three runners completing all three disciplines.

name: Třanovická 10
description: Třanovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Třanovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The routes run along clay-gravel, forest, field and asphalt roads within the cadastral areas of Třanovice and Dolní Domaslavice. The event is open to the general public and includes a 10 km main race, a 5 km race and a relay. The start and finish are by the municipal office, and the race begins at 9:00. Registration is available online and on-site, with race bibs and medals available for collection by those who register early.

name: DEVIL’S CHALLENGE – ČERTOVSKÁ VÝZVA – 666km aneb superantikontramultiextraunikátní běžecký závod
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Čertovská výzva 666 km is an 8-day stage running race through the beautiful countryside of northern Bohemia. It offers a 666 km route or a shortened 4-stage option. The race passes through Kokořínsko, the Máchův kraj region, the Lusatian Mountains, the Ještěd Ridge and Bohemian Paradise. The final stage follows the same course as the Čertovský ultratrail 66.6 km. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of three, with the option to take turns running the stages. Individual stages can also be selected. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers to the stage starts and GPS navigation. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet.

name: 1/2Maraton Bělský les
description: The Bělský les Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Bělský les in Ostrava-Zábřeh. It offers several distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 4 × 5 km relay, and the Nachmelená 25 km hiking event. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and the general public, and supports charitable causes. The start and finish are at Vodní areál Jih, providing a pleasant atmosphere and good facilities for participants.

name: Běh pro Paměť Národa – Ostrava
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Ostrava is a charity sports and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place in Komenský Park, with timed 4 km (1 lap) and 8 km (2 laps) races. The event is open to all age groups, including children’s races, and offers the option of a symbolic run anywhere. The start and finish are by the statue of J. A. Comenius, with refreshments and restroom facilities for participants.

name: Běh přes tři vsi
description: Běh přes tři vsi is a modern cross-country race that continues the tradition of a road race organized by Spartak Sedlec. The race is intended both for athletes and for runners who want to enjoy the beauty of the countryside. The youngest runners are not forgotten either, as running can bring them lifelong joy. The route passes through three villages—Sedlec, Lhůta, and Tymákov—in the area around Starý Plzenec.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: Chlum Three Ways is a hill race to Chlum, a prominent peak near Plzeň, tackled in three different ways. It starts with a mass-start uphill race over 1.75 km. The event is appealing to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain and wanting to try different routes up the same hill. It is part of the running community and offers an enjoyable experience in nature close to Plzeň.

name: Běh na Děvín
description: Běh na Děvín is an uphill running race offering two distances: 4.4 km and 9.1 km. The route runs mostly over trails and finishes at the summit of Děvín, offering beautiful views and a challenging profile. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Uphill Running and is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in the natural surroundings of the South Moravian Region. The start is by the church in Perná and the finish is at the summit of Děvín, guaranteeing a unique mountain running experience.

name: Běžecké závody AC Praha 1890
description: The AC Praha 1890 Praha–Brandýs races are traditional race-walking events with a history dating back to 1892. The race takes place in Arborka Forest Park in Prague 14 and offers courses for men, women, juniors, and children. The course is a paved circuit suitable for fast running and walking. The race is part of the men’s and women’s leagues and is open to both amateur and club athletes. Race numbers and chips are issued at registration; timing is provided by chips and a finish-line camera.

name: Čertovská výzva - jednotlivé etapy
description: Čertovská výzva is a unique 8-day, 666 km stage running race through the beautiful countryside of northern Bohemia. Shorter options are also available: a 4-stage race or individual stages. The route passes through Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, the Lužické Mountains, the Ještěd Ridge and Český ráj. The final stage follows the same course as the 66.6 km Čertovský ultratrail. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of three, with the option to take turns. Chip timing and a GPS tracker are provided. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers available to the stage starts. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet.

name: WEBER Jičínská10 (CityRun Jičín)
description: Jičínská 10 is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Jičín. The race features a 10 km course suitable for the general public and runners of all levels. The event also includes a training run along the course, allowing participants to prepare better. The atmosphere is friendly and welcomes all runners looking to take on a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Nekořský kros
description: Nekoř Cross-Country Race is a traditional running race held in Nekoř, Pardubice Region, and is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The routes follow varied terrain along forest paths and meadows, with some sections on asphalt, making for an interesting and varied running experience. The start and finish are by the ice rink in Nekoř, where registration also takes place. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, including young people, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and practical prizes for winners in the individual categories.

name: Běh mezi náměstími
description: Běh mezi náměstími is a traditional running race held at Svobody Square in Frýdek-Místek, attracting a wide range of participants, from children to adults. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere, beautiful weather, and the chance to compete on a course that runs to Zámecké Square and back. Special races are prepared for children, with medals, prizes, and refreshments, while adults run the main course, approximately 4.7 km long. Winners and all participants take home not only prizes, but also the joy of exercise and socializing.

name: Chodsko Grand Prix
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic
description: Chodsko Grand Prix is a 9.6 km race with 130 meters of elevation gain, running mostly on roads from the village of Klenčí pod Čerchovem to Hrádek Hill. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska competition and offers runners an interesting route with a gentle climb. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in the picturesque Plzeň Region.

name: Festivalový půlmaraton MONET+ Zlín 2026
description: The MONET+ Zlín Festival Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.097 km road race open to the public, with no club membership required. The race takes place on the streets of Zlín, starting near the Zlín Congress Centre, and also offers other options, including a quarter marathon, relays and a 5 km run. The programme also includes a 1,400-metre Family Run. Part of Zlín’s festival programme, the event offers a unique atmosphere and the chance to run alongside well-known personalities.

name: Zahořanská 10 (Běh okolo Pleše)
description: BOS Zahořanská 10 is a traditional running race organized by SK Zahořany under the auspices of the municipality of Zahořany. The eighth edition will take place and features a 10.2 km main race for men and women with 250 m of elevation gain on forest trails around Zahořany and Pleš. There is also a 5.5 km fun run and children’s races of various distances. Timing and results are provided by 4Timing using chip technology. Registration is available online and on-site, with different price categories for adults, juniors, and children.

name: Maraton a půlmaraton okolo Hracholuské přehrady
description: The marathon and half marathon around the Hracholusky Reservoir offer a beautiful natural route around the reservoir. The course runs mostly along paved paths beside the water, with a few short sections of natural terrain that give it a slightly trail-like character without adding unnecessary difficulty. A standout experience is crossing the Pňovany Bridge, with breathtaking views of the reservoir and surrounding countryside. The race course is 21.1 km long—the exact half marathon distance—and is ideal for runners seeking a combination of beautiful scenery, a motivating atmosphere, and a pleasant course profile.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Lesná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Lesná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km, an adventure route covers 20 to 30 km, and children’s races are also held. The routes are suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, offering a varied sporting challenge for all age groups. The series is organized by Živé Sokolovsko z.s. and Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. in cooperation with local municipalities.

name: Mezinárodní běh Měška a Doubravky
description: The International Měšek and Doubravka Run is a summer race for adults covering 12.5 km. It starts in Mirošov and finishes at AQA Land swimming pool in Meziměstí. The race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix and follows the picturesque landscape of the Polish-Czech border region, through meadows and forests. The start is at the amphitheatre on Parkowa Hill at 11:00; the finish and awards ceremony take place at the swimming pool. Free bus transport from Meziměstí to Mieroszów is provided for Czech competitors. Registration is free and available online or at the venue on race day.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Zadní Třebaň
description: The Berounka Running Series in Zadní Třebaň is a scenic race held amid the beautiful countryside of the Central Bohemian Region. The route follows the Berounka River, crosses meadows with panoramic views, passes the Liteň nature trail, and winds through picturesque countryside reminiscent of Tuscany. The race culminates with a climb to the course’s highest point in Doubce, followed by a final descent to the finish at a pleasant campsite with refreshments. Every participant receives a race number, and the top three in each category receive diplomas and medals.

name: Běh Advenťáka PLZEŇ
location: Krašovské Activity Centre, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Advenťák Plzeň 2026 is a charity run held to support people who are facing difficulties in life. The race takes place at the Krašov Activity Center and offers a 6.45 km course along paved paths around Krkavec. There are also children’s categories with shorter courses. Participants receive a race bib, a diploma with their time, a gingerbread cookie and other gifts, while part of the entry fee goes to support heroes.

name: Krčská 12
location: Velký altán, Kunratický les, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Krčská 12 is a traditional running race organized by the Sabzo Praha running club in Krčský Forest. The race is run on asphalt and features a 12.5 km course consisting of four loops. The start is at the Great Gazebo in Kunratice, usually in the early evening. The event is part of the regular sports and entertainment program in Nové Roztyly Park, which is also suitable for families with children.

name: Běh Advenťáka Praha
description: Běh Advenťáka Prague 2026 is a charity running race taking place on June 3 in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague. The race offers a 6.45 km course on paved paths, suitable for trail shoes, as well as children’s categories with shorter courses. The event combines the joy of running with support for people facing difficulties in life, and participants contribute to a good cause. It also includes activities for children and facilities with refreshments and a cloakroom. The race is part of the Běh Advenťáka series, held in several cities.

name: Štafeta 4 × 5 km v Braníku 2026
description: The 4 × 5 km Relay in Braník is a team running race held on the cycle path in Braník, Prague. The race is for teams of four, with each runner completing a 5 km loop. The event offers a chance to enjoy a team atmosphere, cheer each other on, and celebrate after the race at the Hamr Braník venue. The course follows cycle path A2 along the Vltava and is suitable for a wide range of runners, with a time limit of 2 hours and 20 minutes for the entire race.

name: Okolo Peperku
location: Najdek, Hamry. Za mostkem u hřiště, Vysočina
description: Žďárák - Around Peperk is a cross-country race that takes place mostly off-road in the picturesque Vysočina region, in the village of Najdek, Hamry. The 7 km course features 85% off-road paths and 15% asphalt, with 180 metres of elevation gain, making for an interesting and challenging route. The race starts at 17:00 by the small bridge near the sports field and is organized by SK Žďárák. It is suitable for trail running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in nature.

name: Pohár města Třemošnice
description: The O pohár starosty města Třemošnice firefighting sports competition is a traditional sporting event held in Třemošnice and is part of the Chrudim District League. Men’s and women’s teams compete, showcasing top-level performances in firefighting sports. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and ample refreshments for participants and fans. It is organized by the Třemošnice Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with the town of Třemošnice. Everyone is welcome to attend the next edition, which will take place.

name: 3. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro zdraví is a charitable running series organized by the TJ Jäkl Karviná athletics club in the beautiful setting of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is suitable for anyone who wants to do something for their health while supporting people in need, as the proceeds from entry fees are donated to help those in need. The event is friendly and open to the general public, with participants free to run at any pace. Registration begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this regular sporting event.
course_highlights: A 3 km route in the beautiful setting of Božena Němcová Park
The route follows a cycle path suitable for running
A charity run with proceeds going to help people in need
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, with the start at 17:45 at Lodičky in Božena Němcová Park. A series of seven runs for health, where everyone can run the route at any pace. Charity run; proceeds from entry fees go to help people in need.

name: Běh na Vysoký vrch
description: The Run to Vysoký vrch is a mountain race to the highest hill in the Kladno region. It offers a challenging but short run, with 200 metres of elevation gain over a route approximately 2.8 km long. The race is divided into age and gender categories, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place in Malé Kyšice and is organised by TJ Sokol Unhošť. The race is scheduled to start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for both runners and spectators.

name: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka
description: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka is a popular running race held in Lhota, Central Bohemian Region, traditionally in June. The race features a 7.5 km route along paved roads and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and the atmosphere of spring, when the surrounding area bursts into bloom with gorgeous chestnut blossoms. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities and is a welcome opportunity to meet the local running community.

name: Kolem Trpaslíka v Hybrálci
description: The Kolem Trpaslíka race in Hybrálec is a 10 km running race that runs mostly along unpaved forest paths in the Hybrálec area near Jihlava. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural terrain of the Vysočina region. The course is suitable for fans of forest running and a pleasant sporting experience in nature.

name: Valašské kilo
description: Valašské Kilo is a challenging 100 km ultramarathon through the beautiful, hilly landscape of Valašsko, with at least 3,500 metres of elevation gain. The race challenges not only experienced athletes but also those who want to push their limits and experience an off-road adventure. After the mass start at 22:00, runners plan their own routes between checkpoints within the 30-hour time limit. Race headquarters are at Žerotínova Elementary School in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gym, showers and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers the freedom to navigate the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in Czechia.

name: Čertovskej Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 222 Kč

description: Čertovskej Ultratrail is a challenging trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of the mysterious Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj regions. It offers a main 66.6 km route that is also suitable for beginner ultrarunners thanks to well-stocked aid stations and a friendly atmosphere. A shorter 33.3 km course, called Letní půlčert, is also available. The race is part of the prestigious Ultracup series and offers ITRA points to runners. Capacity is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: A trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
Scenic countryside and a family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: A personal drinking cup is mandatory equipment. You can order one during registration, along with a Čertovskej cup, T-shirt or socks. Race capacity is limited. Categories are available for individuals and relay teams, including a family relay with a child under 15. The route is marked with ribbons and arrows. The time limit for the Čertovskej Wintertrail is 7 hours. Post-race refreshments are provided at the finish, including soup, a main course and drinks. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races and ITRA National League. A personal cup is mandatory at the aid stations. A running cup, T-shirt or socks can be ordered during registration.

name: Jesenická šedesátka
description: Jesenická šedesátka is a hiking and running event along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník Mountains, offering beautiful natural surroundings and the chance to test yourself against the clock. The 60 km route is intended for more experienced participants aged 16 and over and includes refreshment stations. The event is a long-standing favourite, with chip timing and results announced at the finish. The organizers emphasize safety and a relaxed atmosphere, and the event is suitable for both runners and hikers.

name: Čertovskej ultratrail
description: Čertovskej Ultraltrail is a trail race across mountains, mines, castles and waters through the mysterious countryside of Kokořínsko and the Máchův kraj region. It offers a main 66.6 km route through beautiful scenery, with well-stocked aid stations, and is suitable for beginner ultrarunners too. The race is part of the Ultracup series and is also the final stage of the 8-day Čertovská výzva 666 km. The atmosphere is family-friendly, and runners will enjoy unforgettable experiences on the picturesque course.

name: Běh Zelenským údolím
location: Přírodní park Zelenov, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic

name: Skřipovská lítačka
description: Skřipovská lítačka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque countryside of fields, meadows, and woods around the village of Skřipov near Opava. The seventh edition of the race will be based at the TJ Sokol Skřipov football pitch. It offers courses for all ages, from the youngest children to adults, along with a varied program of activities including an inflatable maze, face painting, and refreshments. All courses are clearly marked, and volunteers at intersections point runners in the right direction. The event is organized by Běžecký klub Skřipov, z. s.

name: Happy run
description: Happy Run is a charity run held in Studenec near Třebíč in the Vysočina Region. It is open to everyone—athletes and non-athletes, families with children and individuals—who can choose from several routes to suit their abilities. The event supports Viktorka, a boy with serious health complications, and the proceeds from the run go toward his rehabilitation stay. In addition to the run itself, a varied program of activities and an evening party are planned.

name: Běh napříč republikou
location: Česko (867 km po celé republice), Vysočina
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event, now taking place for the fifth year. Participants run together from different parts of the Czech Republic to its geographical center in Čihošť, at a pace suited to recreational runners and comfortable for conversation. The routes are divided into individual sections, with pacers who help maintain the right pace and follow the route. This is not a race, but a shared experience that offers a chance to discover new places and meet other runners.

name: Z Hejnic do Pekla
description: Z Hejnic do Pekla 2026 is the second edition of a running race held in the Liberec Region, starting at the Hejnice Skatepark. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere, refreshments, medical support, and a race packet for every participant. It is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and seniors, who receive special entry fee conditions. The organizers prioritize runners’ comfort, providing changing rooms, showers, and luggage storage.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S01 – Machnín-Výpřež
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique event that is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace. In 2026, it will take place for the fifth time, with four parallel routes heading from different parts of the Czech Republic (including a route from Liberec-Machnín) to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. The run follows a precise schedule, with pacers on every section to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose how many sections they want to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S02 – Výpřež-Rašovka
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event taking place for the fifth time. It brings together four starts from different corners of the Czech Republic, all heading to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section responsible for the pace and route guidance. Participants can choose any number of sections to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape. The event is suitable for recreational runners and offers a chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S03 – Rašovka-Hodkovice nad Mohelkou

Participants can choose any number of legs from a total of 82 carefully designed routes, which cross varied terrain, from hills to flatlands, forests and towns. The run offers a chance to discover new places, meet like-minded runners and enjoy an unusual sporting experience.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S04 – Hodkovice nad Mohelkou-Frýdštejn
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical center of the country. It is not a race, but a group run with pacers who maintain a conversational pace and provide route guidance. Participants can choose any number of sections from a total of 82 carefully designed segments, which cover varied terrain, from hills and flatlands to forests and towns. The event is suitable for recreational runners who want to discover new places, meet new people, and enjoy an unusual running experience.

description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical center of the Czech Republic. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on individual sections. Runners can choose any number of sections from a total of 82 carefully designed routes, which cross varied terrain, from hills and flatlands to forests and towns. The aim is not only to be physically active, but also to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S06 – Turnov-Vyskeř
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared finish in Čihošť, the geographical centre of the Czech Republic. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each leg. The routes pass through beautiful countryside, forests, towns and hills, and participants can choose any number of legs to run. The event offers a chance to discover new places, meet like-minded runners and enjoy an unusual sporting experience. The start is at 7:00 and the finish is at 17:00 in Čihošť.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S07 – Vyskeř-Podkost
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in the geographical centre of the country, in Čihošť. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section. Runners can choose any number of sections and experience the beauty of the Czech countryside, whether in the hills, on flat terrain, along forest trails or on city streets. The run starts at 7:00 from four locations and finishes at 17:00 in Čihošť.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S08 – Podkost-Dolní Bousov
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical center of the country. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pace leaders on individual sections. Runners can choose any number of sections and join the running “trains” from Liberec, Pohoří na Šumavě, Prostějov, and Rokycany. The route crosses varied terrain—hills, flat stretches, forests, and towns—and offers the chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S09 – Dolní Bousov-Domousnice
description: Run Across the Republic is a unique event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the country’s geographical center. It is not a race, but a group run with pacers who maintain a conversational pace and guide runners along the route. The routes are divided into sections, which participants can choose freely and run as many of as they like. The event offers a chance to discover new places, meet new friends, and enjoy the beauty of the Czech countryside across varied terrain.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S10 – Domousnice-Ledce
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared finish in Čihošť, the geographical center of the country. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section. Runners can choose any number of sections and join the running “trains” from Liberec, Pohoří na Šumavě, Prostějov, and Rokycany. The route crosses varied terrain—hills, flat stretches, forests, and towns—and offers the chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S11 – Ledce-Loučeň
description: Running Across the Republic, S11 - Ledce-Loučeň is a planned running race that will take place in the Ledce and Loučeň area of the Central Bohemian Region. Exact details about the course, distance, or registration are not available in the sources, but the race is part of a broader concept of running or hiking events in the Czech Republic. The race offers runners and hikers an opportunity to discover the region’s beauty and enjoy an active break in nature.

name: Běh na Kohout a zpět
description: Běh na Kohout is a traditional hill race held since 2006 in Besednice, by the swimming pool. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running, and most editions are run on the same course, allowing times to be compared. The start and finish are at the swimming pool in Besednice, which offers excellent facilities. Every year, an accompanying program and a raffle with attractive prizes are prepared. The race will take place, and runners of all categories are welcome.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Ústí nad Labem
description: Barvám Neutečeš in Ústí nad Labem is a colorful run full of joy, friendship, and fun, held in the Severní Terasa district. Participants can choose between a 5 km route with five color zones or a shorter 1.5 km route with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about sharing the experience, enjoying bursts of color, and soaking up a great atmosphere for all ages. Race packages include a T-shirt, colors, a medal, and other accessories that highlight the event’s unique character. Come with family or friends, or on your own, and enjoy a day full of color and fun.

name: Běh na Čerchov
description: The Run to Čerchov is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series, which offers runners a range of routes around the Chodsko region. It is suitable for all running enthusiasts looking to experience a challenging yet beautiful run in nature, with views of Čerchov. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Běh okolo Hostěnic
description: The Run Around Hostěnice is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Hostěnice. The 5.83 km course is flat and combines paved and forest paths. The race starts at 17:00 and is suitable for the general public, including children, who have a shorter, age-appropriate course. Organizers David Šálek and Jan Řebíček warmly invite all runners to take part in this traditional event.

name: 5, 10, 21 km trail okolo hory pro každého
description: The Trail Running Cup is a traditional series of trail races with a history dating back to 2011, offering courses of various distances from 5 to 50 kilometers amid the beautiful scenery of the Czech Republic. The races are suitable for all runners, including children, and provide great entertainment for the whole family. The series features a variety of terrain and difficulty levels, so everyone can find a course to suit them. The overall standings are based on points awarded for results in individual races held throughout the season.

name: Běh dobroučským krajem
description: The Běh dobroučským krajem is a traditional running race organized by the ISCAREX Athletics Club in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč in the Pardubice Region. The race offers technically interesting courses with gentle undulations and a number of turns, running along paved paths. The event is open to the general public and welcomes experienced runners, recreational athletes, and families with children. It is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for runners and spectators alike.

name: Běháme pro radost - Help4Africa
description: Běháme pro radost is a traditional charity run held in the village of Smidary, celebrating its 10th edition in 2026. The event supports children’s projects in Africa through the organization Help4Africa, founded by Marcel Doubrava. The run combines physical activity with helping children in need, and participants can see the direct impact of their support through photographs from the projects. It is not only a sporting event, but also an opportunity to find joy in helping others.

name: Kounovský kros
description: Kounovský kros is a running race organized by TriClub Dobruška, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kounov near Dobruška in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Dobruška Cup and offers a sporting experience for the general public, including amateur runners. TriClub Dobruška is known for its long-standing tradition and for actively involving its members and the public in sporting events. The race is suitable for all age groups and levels of running ability.

name: Řepočetův výběh
description: Řepočetův Výběh is a unique sporting and social event in Rokytnice nad Jizerou, held at the natural amphitheatre in Horní Rokytnice. The race offers two routes: 19.1 km with 650 m of elevation gain for Řepáci, and 12 km with 400 m of elevation gain for Dumliky. The event supports the Run for the Memory of the Nation initiative and offers original race bibs, with the option to donate to the non-profit organization Post Bellum. The start is at 14:00, registration opens at 12:00, refreshments are provided after the race, and the venue can only be reached on foot, with parking available within walking distance.

name: Heroes Race
location: Hradec nad Moravicí, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
description: The Mnichovohradištská Fifteen is a road race with a gently undulating out-and-back course measuring 15 km. It takes place in Mnichovo Hradiště, on T. G. Masaryk Square. The course is well paved and has marked kilometres, helping runners pace themselves. The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00, and the organiser is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners looking for a quality road run with a long tradition.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all age groups. Each participant competes primarily against themselves, creating a friendly and motivating atmosphere. The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, adding to the enjoyment of the run. It is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to test their speed over a short distance.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Run over Červený vrch is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race features a technically interesting course with gentle undulations and numerous turns, suitable for a wide range of runners, from recreational athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and provides high-quality facilities for both competitors and spectators. You can register online or on the day of the race.

name: Babický trail 1/4 maraton 2026
location: Sportovní areál Babice, Topolová 500, Babice, Czech Republic
