It is organized by TJ Růžená, z.s., and is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts looking to combine sport with nature.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Pražský Kelt is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the chance to discover beautiful natural scenery and Celtic hillforts, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 metres. The route winds through Prague’s forested, hilly landscape and passes historic sites such as the Šance, Butovice, Závist and Vyšehrad hillforts, as well as others. It also offers stunning views of the city and the surrounding countryside. The race starts and finishes at the grounds of Kunratice Elementary School and is intended for runners looking to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban setting. The race is limited to 120 participants, creating an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: Cena Metuje
organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.
description: Cena Metuje is a traditional 10 km road race held in Nové Město nad Metují as part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series. This 65th edition also offers races for young athletes in various age categories. The route follows an asphalt road through the Metuje River valley to Peklo and back, providing an enjoyable yet challenging running experience. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, parents, and grandparents, who can earn points in the series. Winners are awarded in both the children’s categories and the main race, with cash and non-cash prizes.

name: VOKOLO priglu
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
description: Vokolo priglu is a traditional running race around the Brno Reservoir. The race offers a unique sporting experience on a 14.1 km course, approximately one-third of a marathon. The route is gently undulating, mostly on asphalt with some sections of rocky terrain, and offers beautiful views of the Brno Sea, Veveří Castle, and the autumn woods. The race is open to individuals, pairs in the steamboat relay, four-person teams, companies, and universities, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Běh Borským parkem
description: The Borský Park Run is a traditional autumn sporting event in Plzeň, with a history dating back to 1970. The race is open to everyone, from beginner recreational runners to experienced athletes of all ages. It offers the excitement of the starting line, the thrill of the race atmosphere, and the joy of crossing the finish line. The organizers provide a welcoming race environment and homemade refreshments for all participants.

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
description: Běhej lesy Lednice is part of a popular running series offering races in some of the Czech Republic’s most beautiful natural settings. The Lednice race takes place in the picturesque Lednice-Valtice Cultural Landscape, where runners pass through the château park, around ponds, and by iconic landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and the Apollo Temple. The routes suit runners of different ability levels and include the shorter Nova 14 km and the longer ČSOB 21 km, both with an international UTMB Index. The event also features competitions on speed sections and an exciting finish straight, providing extra motivation for participants.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
description: Hradčanské Vlnky is a traditional cross-country trail race in Hradčany near Olomouc, offering three main distances: 5.6 km, 10.4 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. The race focuses on off-road running, mostly on forest and field paths, making for an attractive and challenging course. The event also includes children’s categories with various distances. Runners can enjoy refreshments, chip timing, and extensive facilities, including showers. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced trail runners.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
location: Stromovka Park, Prague 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Run of Olymp is a traditional running race organized by the Olymp Prague Police Sports Club. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and a sporting challenge in a pleasant urban park. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes team spirit and an active lifestyle. The organizers welcome all participants and provide support during registration and throughout the race.

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
description: The Benešov Half Marathon and 10K through the Jizera Region is a traditional running race set in the picturesque village of Benešov u Semil in the Liberec Region. The race offers half-marathon and 10-kilometre routes through the beautiful countryside of the Jizera Region, with varied terrain. It is organised by TJ Benešov u Semil, which provides a friendly atmosphere and light refreshments for runners and their supporters. The race is suitable for runners of all levels and is part of the village’s sporting activities.

name: Běh Bukovem
description: Běh Bukovem is an annual running festival held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Bukov and Plískov as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race takes place entirely on meadows, forest roads, and trails, offering runners an enjoyable experience in nature. The event is suitable for a wide range of age groups, from the youngest children to veterans. It is organized by the municipality of Plískov in cooperation with Farma Ekl and is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition.

name: Kašavský kros
description: Kašava Cross is a traditional trail running race in the area around Kašava, offering two main routes for runners aged 16 and over, as well as children’s races. The race is held and is known for its established course with hills and a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA in cooperation with the local municipality and school. The children’s races take place after the main races and are divided into several age categories, with different course lengths.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz is an extreme ultra-trail race held in the Ore Mountains, specifically in Mikulov and the surrounding area. The race is intended for experienced runners looking for a challenging course amid beautiful scenery on marked hiking trails. The organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and high-quality event support. The race is suitable for runners over 18 who are physically and mentally prepared for extreme conditions. We look forward to seeing you at the next edition.

name: Rybský trhák
description: Rybí Challenge is a road race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice in cooperation with the Municipality of Rybí and TJ Sokol Rybí. The race is 7 km long with 135 metres of elevation gain and is open to various age categories for both men and women. The start is at the TJ Sokol Rybí football pitch, and runners can use the provided changing rooms and showers. Refreshments are available at the finish, along with prizes for the top runners in each category, including an award for the oldest participant and the best runner from the municipality of Rybí.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
description: The Run for Kleofáš is a traditional charity run held in the spa park in Třeboň, supporting the local hospice. Participants can choose from several categories, from short children’s races to a 12-kilometre run around Svět Pond. Less experienced runners can enjoy a pleasant four-kilometre route, and there is also a relay for two or four runners. The event offers a varied programme of activities for children and is part of Hospice Week.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad Špindlerův Mlýn, Špindlerův Mlýn, Czech Republic
description: The Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna is the traditional 34th edition of a mountain race held as part of the Czech Cup. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn and features a challenging 14 km course with 901 metres of elevation gain. It is ideal for mountain-running enthusiasts looking to test themselves in the beautiful mountain setting of the Krkonoše.

name: Červený okruh
description: The Red Circuit in Doksy is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League. It gives runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the natural surroundings of Termit in Doksy. The event is part of a series of regional running races and attracts both the general public and experienced athletes. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.

name: Bašťanská šestka
description: Bašťanská šestka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of the reservoir in Baška, Moravian-Silesian Region. The race is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., which has long been dedicated to athletics and supporting sporting activities in the region. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in beautiful natural surroundings. Both experienced runners and recreational athletes are welcome to register and take part.

name: Svatováclavský běh - Tyreto RUN
description: The St. Wenceslas Tyreto RUN 2026 is a charity running race held on October 10 in Děčín. The race offers courses for men, women, and children, including a family run, and supports people with multiple sclerosis through proceeds from entry fees. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The first ten people to register will receive a discount on Tyreto tire purchases.

name: Borský kros
description: Borský kros is a traditional running race organized by Borský klub lyžařů Machov in the picturesque Doleček cross-country skiing area in the Hradec Králové Region. The course offers a range of difficulty levels, from gentle, gradual climbs suitable for families with children to challenging, rugged and steep profiles for experienced runners. The race is part of the club’s varied sporting activities and takes place in beautiful natural surroundings with excellent facilities. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and a high-quality sporting experience for all participants.

name: Podzimní přespolní běh - Memoriál Jiřího Bláhy
description: The Autumn Cross-Country Run – Jiří Bláha Memorial is a traditional race held since 1986; this year marks its 39th edition. The race takes place at the swimming pool complex in Nové Město na Moravě, where registration opens at 8:30. The longest course is approximately 6 km for men; women run 2 km, and youth courses range from 300 m to 1,500 m. The race is run on grass, so spikes are recommended. Category starts are staggered so everyone can make it to Sunday lunch, and the results are announced shortly after the last men’s category finishes.

name: Lesní běh Říčany XCR
description: Lesní běh Říčany XCR is a popular forest race held in Říčany, offering courses for all age groups, from children to veterans. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region and includes courses of various lengths, including 11 km and 5.7 km for adults, with challenging forest trails and steep climbs. The event is intended not only for sports enthusiasts but also for families with children, who can enjoy shorter routes tailored to the participants’ ages. The organizer, Bežecký klub Říčany, invites everyone to spend time actively in nature and take part in this traditional event.

name: Běh na Strandu
description: Běh na Strandu is a distinctive uphill running race held on Stránská skála in Brno-Slatina. Competitors start individually at one-minute intervals, allowing them to focus on the 450-meter course with 47 meters of elevation gain. The course follows a rocky and grassy path, and the race is divided into several age categories, from younger pupils to veterans. After finishing, runners must return their race bibs, and the results are announced after the last competitor finishes. Registration takes place on race day from 9:00 to 10:00, and the start is at 10:01.

name: Hrabenovský kros
description: Hrabenov Cross is a 7.47 km forest cross-country race with 200 metres of elevation gain, held in the picturesque surroundings of Hrabenov near Šumperk. The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers challenging cross-country courses in the Šumperk area. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge on natural terrain with significant elevation gain. The route runs through the forest and offers beautiful natural scenery and technically interesting terrain.

name: Slavkovský lesík
description: The Slavkovský lesík Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by TJ Opava, held in the picturesque woodland near Slavkov u Opavy. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy running in nature on varied terrain in a relaxed sporting atmosphere. The start and registration take place by the TJ Sokol Slavkov football field, with the race traditionally starting at 10 a.m. The organizers invite all runners to take part and promise an enjoyable sporting experience.

name: Rozběháme (i) Klenčí
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rozběháme Klenčí is a traditional running race set in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem in the Plzeň Region. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities a chance to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the region’s beautiful nature. Results and rankings are carefully tracked, and the race is part of the wider Běžec Chodska series. The organizers welcome all runners and provide quality event support.

name: Z Dobřichovic na Šraňk
location: Dobřichovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: From Dobřichovice to Šraňk is a 3.7 km uphill race with 280 meters of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series. This race offers a challenging course with a significant climb, ideal for lovers of mountain running and outdoor challenges. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Dobřichovice and is suitable for runners who want to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain. Come and enjoy the atmosphere of the race and push your limits at this traditional event.

name: Běh na Kraví horu
description: The Run up Kraví hora is a public hill-running race with a mass start, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kraví hora in Teplice nad Metují. The race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and challenges athletes with a demanding climb and beautiful views. It has a long tradition and is popular with runners looking to test themselves on mountainous terrain. The organizer, Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, ensures high-quality organization and a pleasant race atmosphere.

name: Zátopkova pětka
description: Zátopkova pětka is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club in Kopřivnice. The race takes place on the cinder track at Emil Zátopek Stadium and is part of the Lašská Running League. It is open to the general public and offers runners the chance to race on a quality athletics track in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The race has a long tradition and is popular with runners of all ages.

name: Běh Heulosem - memoriál Jiřího Šmrhy
description: The Heulos Run – Jiří Šmrha Memorial is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various categories and distances for men, women, veterans, juniors, youth and children, with colour-coded circuits along the forest park’s paths and trails. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1977 and is part of the Běžci Vysočiny series. The race starts in the afternoon at the Na Stoupách athletics stadium, and its routes are suitable for a wide range of runners, from the youngest participants to veterans.

name: Gladiator Race Praha
description: Gladiator Race Prague is a demanding obstacle course race set in Čihadla Nature Park on the outskirts of Prague. The race combines relatively flat running sections with water, mud and challenging obstacles, including a net over a water sluice. This ninth edition brings a unique atmosphere, new challenges and the camaraderie that participants have come to love. Various race categories are available for adults, children and dogs, making the event appealing to a wide range of participants.

name: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice
location: Velké pardubické závodiště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice is a family-friendly running event offering seven different races for all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from 500 metres for the youngest runners to a half marathon, everyone can find their own challenge. The race takes place at the Velká pardubická racecourse and, alongside the sporting experience, offers a varied programme for the whole family. Participants receive a race pack and contribute to charity. The atmosphere is friendly and welcoming to both recreational and elite runners.
course_highlights: Distances include 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, plus children’s races of 500 and 1,000 m
Start and finish at the Velká pardubická racecourse, with its unique atmosphere
Refreshment stations along the course; at least two on the half-marathon route
additional: The race offers a special emergency medical service phone line during the event. Every runner receives a gymsack with gifts from partners. Children receive a Lidl race pack, and there is a supervised kids’ corner. Pacers are on the course to help runners achieve their target times. Refreshments are available at the finish for children’s races, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The event includes multiple distances, participant medals, refreshment stations, changing rooms, showers, medical support and post-race photography.

name: Půlmaraton Český les
description: The Český les Half Marathon is a traditional trail run held amid the picturesque scenery of the Český les in the village of Nemanice. The race offers two routes: 21 km with 520 m of elevation gain and 7 km with 80 m of elevation gain. Both lead through beautiful countryside, and a GPX route is available to download. On the longer course, overall winners and age-group winners are announced, while the shorter course awards the three fastest men and women. The start and finish are both in Nemanice, with parking available near the start.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (11) – říjnový
description: The 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the running league, where runners can compare themselves with others and with their previous performances. The course is certified, and the 10 km distance offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, runners can enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments and an awards ceremony for the top finishers.

name: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice
location: Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: NN NIGHT RUN České Budějovice is one of the largest running events in České Budějovice, held at Přemysla Otakara II Square. This night run offers the atmosphere of the city illuminated by headlamps and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. More than 2,000 runners take part each year, from beginners to experienced competitors. The program also includes children’s races and charity runs alongside the main 10 km race.

name: Ultramaraton Zapomenuté hory
location: Tábor v Račím údolí - Uhelná 126 - býv. okres Jeseník, Olomoucký
description: The Forgotten Mountains Ultramarathon is an autumn trail race that takes you along superb mountain trails to the most remote parts of the Rychleby Mountains. The routes pass through deep valleys, remote ridges and beautiful viewpoints, including the highest peak of the neighboring Góry Bialskie in Poland. The race offers three route options of varying lengths and difficulty, suitable for experienced runners seeking wild nature and unforgettable experiences. The event also includes an evening program of talks and entertainment. We look forward to welcoming everyone who wants to discover these forgotten mountains as few have before.

name: Běh kolem Ameriky
description: The Run Around Amerika is the third-oldest running race in the Czech Republic and the country’s oldest cross-country race. It has been held since 1925 in Amerika Forest Park in Písek. This traditional forest run gives competitors the chance to test themselves over various distances, with the main race covering 10,400 metres. The race has a rich history and is known for its atmosphere and cooperation with partner cities abroad. Every year, it attracts a wide range of runners, from sprinters to endurance athletes, and is an important sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Amerika Forest Park
Main course covering 10,400 metres
Historic race with a tradition dating back to 1925
additional: The race has 25 competition categories and is internationally recognised thanks to cooperation with partner cities in England and Germany. The start is located by the Interhotel Amerika. Only two editions have not been held in its history: in 1942 and 2020. The 101st edition of the race and the 2nd edition of the Jaroslav Putschögl Memorial are scheduled to take place in 2027.

name: Běh podél Halštrova
description: The Run Along the Halštrov is a traditional autumn running race through the beautiful landscape of the Halštrov Nature Park, from Háj Hill to the mineral springs in Doubrava. The race is open to adults and children, who run a shorter route. Participants can enjoy a mix of paved and forest paths, finishing at the mineral spring, where transport back to Aš and refreshments are provided. The number of starters is limited to 200, so early registration is recommended. The event is organized by Lyžařský klub Jasan Aš with the support of the town of Aš and local forests.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Halštrov Nature Park from Háj Hill to the mineral springs in Doubrava
Adults run approximately 9.7 km; children run 4 km
The race follows both paved and forest paths
additional: The adult race starts at approximately 11:00 at the source of the Halštrov; the children’s race starts at 10:45 in Dolní Paseky. The finish is at the mineral spring in Doubrava, from where transport back to Aš is provided. Refreshments are available at the finish. Registration is possible by email until October 15 at 20:00, or in person at the venue until 9:30. For the 2026 edition, capacity was limited to 200 runners; transport was provided from the registration venue to the start and from the finish back to Aš.

name: Od radnice k radnici
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu Náchod
description: The Run from Town Hall to Town Hall is part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series in the Náchod region. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. The route runs from the square in Hronov along the main road and through the town streets to the town hall in Náchod, making for an interesting urban run with views of the surrounding landscape. The race is suitable for runners of all levels and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Start on the square in Hronov and finish on the square in Náchod
The route follows the main road, crosses a railway bridge and continues through town streets
An urban run combining asphalt and local roads
additional: Registration is online at sportchallenge.cz from 1. 9. 2026 to 17. 10. 2026 at 8:00. Registration is also possible on site on race day for a higher entry fee. Race bibs can be collected at the SK Náchod (Rubena) hall on Friday 16.10. from 13:00 to 18:00 and on Saturday 17.10. from 7:45 to 9:45. Children can earn points by taking part in all races in the series and receive a reward. Competitors participate at their own expense or at the expense of the sending organization. Information on courses and prices is available for the 2026 edition; details for the 2027 edition have not yet been provided. The youngest children may run with a companion.

name: Silniční běh Hronov-Náchod
location: Hronov Town Square, Hronov, Czech Republic
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu v Náchodě
description: The Hronov–Náchod Road Race is a traditional event that runs between two towns in the Náchod region. Runners start in the square in Hronov and follow an 8,850-metre road course to T. G. Masaryk Square in Náchod. The race is also the Náchod District road-running championship and is often part of the Primátor CUP series. The programme also includes children’s races in Náchod.
course_highlights: An 8,850-metre road course from Hronov to Náchod.
The start is in Hronov’s square and the finish is in front of the town hall on T. G. Masaryk Square in Náchod.
The race takes place on roads open to regular traffic.
additional: Children’s “From Town Hall to Town Hall” races are also held in Náchod, with courses ranging from 150 to 1,200 metres. In previous editions, participants in the main race were transported by bus from Náchod to the start in Hronov.

name: Malá křivoklátská
description: Malá Křivoklátská is a traditional forest run with a long history dating back to 1973. It takes place in the picturesque valley of the Rakovnický Stream below Křivoklát Castle. The main race is 6,000 metres long and consists of two laps on forest and asphalt roads, with a gentle elevation gain and beautiful views of the castle. Race facilities and the youth course are located at the Kolečko sports ground, which provides ideal conditions for runners of all ages. The youth course is flat and 600 metres long, with race distance adjusted according to the runners’ age. The race is organised by Sokol Křivoklát, which has a rich sporting tradition and a base in the village of Křivoklát.
course_highlights: Forest course with elevation gain towards the walls of Křivoklát Castle
Two laps of 3,000 metres each in the main race
Flat 600-metre youth course at the Kolečko sports ground
additional: Race facilities and the start/finish are at the Kolečko sports ground. The main race starts in a mass start, and the course crosses footbridges and a ford over the Rakovnický Stream. The youth course is a 600 m loop, run for 1–3 laps depending on age. The course combines forest trails, asphalt and a cycle path with fine gravel. The race has a long history and a stable course dating back to 1975. In 2026, the 54th edition will be held.

name: Běh okolo Lemberka
location: Kaplička u Markvartického rybníka, Jablonné v Podještědí, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub ZŠ Jablonné v Podještědí
description: The Run Around Lemberk is a traditional autumn running race held by the chapel near Markvartický Pond, on the green hiking trail between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová. The race offers various distances, from children’s categories to adult races, including relays. The start is on Saturday morning, and the race is part of the Českolipská District Running League. Participants have access to limited changing facilities, and the first three finishers in each category receive a certificate and a prize.
course_highlights: Courses follow the green hiking trail between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová
Distances range from 50 m for the youngest runners to 10,000 m for adults and veterans
The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League – For the Českolipský deník Cup
additional: Registration from 8:30 a.m. at the start and finish area. Limited men’s and women’s changing facilities are available in a tent near the start. Veteran categories are offered only for the 10,000 m race. The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League – For the Českolipský deník Cup. Children’s and youth races are also held. According to available information, the 2026 edition takes place on October 17; the date of the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: Malá Kunratická
location: Kunratický mlýn, Kunratice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Malá Kunratická is a traditional cross-country race organized by the Czech Athletics Veterans Club 1982 with the support of the Prague 11 Municipal District. The race takes place in Kunratice near Kunratický Mill and features a moderately challenging 3,250-metre cross-country course. It starts at the same location as Velká Kunratická, but the course is entirely different. The event is suitable for runners looking for an interesting off-road race in the pleasant surroundings of Prague 11. Registration takes place at the gazebo near the start from 9:30.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging cross-country terrain
Course length: 3,250 metres
Starts at the same location as Velká Kunratická, but follows a different course
additional: The race is supported by the Prague 11 Municipal District and organized by the Czech Athletics Veterans Club 1982. The start and finish are at Kunratický Mill, Prague 4, Kunratice. In a schedule published previously, registration began at 9:30, veterans over 40 started at 10:30, and men up to age 39 together with women started at 11:00. The times and other details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka
location: Havířov city centre, Havířov, Czech Republic
description: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka is a traditional running race in the center of Havířov that combines athletic achievement with support for athletes with disabilities. The race offers different distances for individuals, families, and corporate teams, including the main 10 km race, a 5 km run, a 4×2.5 km relay, and a 500-meter family run for children. Every year, runners of all abilities come together to share the joy of movement and support a good cause. Race packets include chip timing, refreshments, and participant medals.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race over two laps through the center of Havířov
4×2.5 km relay race, with corporate teams welcome
500 m family run for children under 15
additional: Registration is available until 11:00 on race day for the main race and relay, and until 10:00 for the 5 km run. Chip timing, refreshments on the course and after the race, and the option to order a running T-shirt for 350 Kč. The race supports a good cause: 100 Kč from each entry fee goes to Handicap Sport Club Moravia. The relay is open to everyone over 18, or younger participants with written consent from a legal guardian; teams may be mixed, regardless of gender. According to information for the 2026 edition, the race packet included chip timing, refreshments, and a finisher’s medal. Part of the entry fees paid by runners who are permanent residents of Havířov supports the boccia players of HSC Moravia. Price information applies to the 2026 edition, not the 2027 race.

name: Krumlovský běh
location: Orlovna, Rakšice, Moravský Krumlov, Czech Republic
organizer: AC Moravský Krumlov a Orel Jednota Rakšice
description: The Krumlov Run is a road race held at the Orlovna grounds in Rakšice, Moravský Krumlov. It offers a 10.9 km course for men and a 4.5 km course for women, on asphalt and surrounding paths. The event is listed among runs for health, hobby runs, and children’s races, making it suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov, led by Mgr. Zuzana Marková. Registration is available on a separate page, and the race is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s services for runners.
course_highlights: Courses run on asphalt and surrounding paths
Course distances: 10.9 km (men) and 4.5 km (women)
The event includes a hobby run and children’s races
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletics Federation. It is organized by AC Moravský Krumlov; the contact person is Mgr. Zuzana Marková. The event is open to the general public, including hobby runners and children. The program also includes children’s races, a hobby run, and a run for health. The information provided concerns the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Kros Českým rájem
description: Kros Českým rájem is a trail race in a picturesque, little-known corner of Český ráj, featuring a varied and undulating course that winds among sandstone rocks, forest paths, and white-sand trails. The race is 100% trail and is suitable for nature lovers and technical runners. The start and finish are in the village of Skokovy, which is less than an hour from Prague. Race day also includes children’s races and an accompanying programme, including a children’s area.

name: Podzimní Kiosk
description: Podzimní Kiosk is a cross-country race held in Tyršovy sady in Šternberk, featuring a 7 km course for men and a 3.5 km course for women. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners and gives runners the chance to test themselves in pleasant autumn surroundings. The course runs over mixed terrain, making for an engaging and dynamic race for all participants.

name: Běh Zlínem "Přes valašské kotáry"
description: The “Across the Wallachian Hills” race in Zlín is a traditional running event that gives runners the chance to experience the beauty of the Wallachian countryside and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The race starts at the Mládeže Stadium, and the route takes runners through picturesque hills and natural scenery. The organizers emphasize quality organization and a friendly atmosphere for all participants. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series, which includes various running events in the region.

name: PREFA Brněnská 25
organizer: BehejBrno.com, MARATON BRNO z.s., Aleš Čtvrtníček
description: PREFA Brněnská 25 is a traditional road race held in Brno and the surrounding area, running continuously since 1967. It offers several distances—25 km, 16 km, 8 km, and relays—and is open to a wide range of participants, from competitive runners to beginners. The race takes place at the Olympia Park complex near the rope course in Modřice and is part of the Czech Running Club. The first category starts at 11:00, making it convenient for families and recreational runners to take part.

name: Horokros
description: Horokros is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which offers a challenging cross-country race in the picturesque Jeseníky Mountains near Šumperk. The race is intended for runners looking for a trail challenge with varied terrain and natural obstacles. The course is known for its difficulty and beautiful views, attracting both experienced competitors and mountain-running enthusiasts. The Chlapácký běh series rewards regular participants who complete at least six races in a season. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and push your limits in the unique setting of the Jeseníky Mountains.

name: Běh na Žaltman
description: The Běh na Žaltman is an open hill race with a mass start, part of the Krakonoš Czech Hill Running Cup and the East Bohemia Grand Prix series. The race takes place in Malé Svatoňovice in the Hradec Králové Region and offers a sporting challenge amid beautiful natural surroundings. The route follows demanding terrain with significant elevation gain, attracting runners of all abilities. The event is a traditional part of the running season and welcomes athletes and fans of hill running alike.

name: Běh okolo Rané
description: The Run Around Raná is a race held in the surroundings of Raná near Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. It offers an 8.5 km course for men and a 4.25 km course for women. The race is part of the Louny Running Cup and gives runners the opportunity to enjoy running in natural surroundings with picturesque views. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.

name: Běh pro republiku
location: Památník Vojna, Lešetice, Milín, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro republiku is an annual running event held around the Vojna Memorial near Příbram. It commemorates the founding of the Czechoslovak Republic and the fate of political prisoners. The route follows forest and field paths with asphalt and stony surfaces, and participants remember prominent figures in the struggle for freedom and democracy. The event is held under the patronage of President Petr Pavel and offers races for adults and children, as well as walks and Nordic walking. The programme also includes tours of the Vojna Memorial and other accompanying activities.
course_highlights: The 5 km route starts at the Vojna Memorial, goes through Žežice and Lešetice, and returns to the Vojna Memorial
The route includes asphalt, stony dirt, forest paths and field paths
The run takes place alongside regular vehicle traffic; the route is marked with ribbon and spray paint
additional: Registration is available online for the 5 km race, the 200 m children’s run, the Nordic walking outing and the 5 km dog walk. Parking is available in front of the Vojna Memorial or along the roads; arriving by bicycle is recommended. Refreshments and water are available at the finish. A volunteer with a first-aid kit is present in the start and finish area. Tours of the Vojna Memorial and the accompanying programme take place every hour on the hour until 16:00. The Vojna Memorial is located in Lešetice near Milín.

name: Klánovický 1/2maraton
description: The Klánovice Half Marathon is a trail half marathon through the beautiful surroundings of Klánovice Forest in Prague. The race offers a certified 21.0975 km course along forest paths, a nature trail, and tracks with minimal asphalt and no significant climbs. The event also includes 10 km races, a relay, and children’s races, all with convenient facilities and refreshments along the course. It is ideal for nature lovers and trail runners who want to discover the forest’s beautiful spots and enjoy a friendly atmosphere with an accompanying program.

name: Loučení s oválem
description: Farewell to the Track is a traditional race organized by the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Sports Club. It has been held annually since 2000 as the final track race of the season. Originally intended only for young athletes, it added adult categories in 2014, with distances of 1500 m for men and 800 m for women. After a break from 2017 to 2019, the race returned in 2020 with 800 m events for young athletes and 3000 m for adults. The race takes place at Na Příkopě 1159 in Frýdek-Místek and is a popular event among the region’s athletics community.

name: Mizuno Neon Run Olomouc
description: Mizuno Neon Run in Olomouc is a nighttime running event full of color, lights, and fun. It’s not a race, but an experience for all participants. This neon run offers a wild and crazy glowing experience that celebrates the joy of movement and having fun together. Get ready to shine and enjoy an unforgettable atmosphere at the Výstaviště Flora grounds in Olomouc.

name: Tálínská desítka
location: Náves před obecním úřadem, Tálín, Czech Republic
organizer: Obec Tálín a Progres TT Tálín
description: Tálínská desítka is a traditional running race held in the village of Tálín, bringing together athletes of all ages in the village’s picturesque setting. The race is part of the village’s sports calendar and supports community life and sporting activities for local residents and visitors. The event is organized in cooperation with local sports clubs, including Triatlon Team Tálín, and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The start and finish are on the village square in front of the municipal office, creating a friendly atmosphere and making the event easily accessible to participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the village square in front of the municipal office in Tálín
Picturesque village setting suitable for running
Event suitable for all age groups, including people with physical disabilities
additional: The race is part of Tálín’s sporting events, which support community life and are open to the general public, including children, seniors, and people with physical disabilities. It is organized by local sports clubs Triatlon Team Tálín and Galaxy Cyklošvec Písek. The village also has the V OBRAZE mobile app for following the latest information.

name: Třebíčský maraton
description: The Třebíč Marathon invites you to run through the picturesque streets of Třebíč’s historic centre, where you can admire the atmosphere of its UNESCO landmarks, including the iconic Basilica of St. Procopius. In addition to the marathon, you can choose the half-marathon or the shorter 10K, both of which also pass through the city’s historic and natural beauty. Refreshment stations await you along the course and at the finish, followed by a relaxing AfterRun party—the perfect way to round off a day of sport. Families can also enjoy children’s races right in the city centre, with an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Picturesque streets in Třebíč’s historic centre
The atmosphere of UNESCO landmarks, including the Basilica of St. Procopius
Refreshment stations along the course and a welcoming atmosphere
additional: The registration fee must be paid within 14 days of registration; otherwise, the registration will be cancelled. After completing online registration, you can also register on site, but the number of race packs is limited. An AfterRun party will round off the day after the race. Children’s races take place right in the city centre, with a lively atmosphere. The event offers a marathon, half-marathon, 10K race and children’s races. Prices published for the 2026 edition may not apply to 2027.

name: Slapy Trail Maniacs
description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a marked trail race around the Slapy Reservoir, offering three challenging routes of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km. The main course, with 2,300 metres of elevation gain, follows roads, paths, stream crossings, rocky outcrops, and steep slopes, making for a varied and technically interesting run. There are two special competitions on the course—a hill-climb and a speed prize—and the race is also suitable for earning ITRA points. Medals, diplomas, prizes in kind, and prize money are awarded to the top runners. The event is organised by Š&P Outdoor z.s., which provides high-quality organisation and support for runners.
course_highlights: 61 km main course with 2,300 m of elevation gain
Routes follow roads, paths, stream crossings, rocky outcrops, and steep slopes
The course features hill-climb and speed prizes
additional: ITRA points can be earned by completing the 61 km or 47 km course. The fastest runners can win medals, diplomas, prizes in kind, and prize money. The organiser is Š&P Outdoor z.s.; the contact person is Ondřej Kutiš. The marked race features technically challenging terrain around the Slapy Reservoir. Race facilities are listed at Hořovická chata in Borotice.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Přírodní koupaliště Poděbrady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the natural surroundings of the Poděbrady swimming pool in Olomouc. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region and gives athletes the opportunity to test their fitness and performance in a beautiful natural setting. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners who want to test themselves in a cross-country race.
course_highlights: Run in the natural surroundings of the Poděbrady swimming pool
Part of the Grand Prix of Endurance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Cross-country race with natural obstacles
additional: Available information about previous editions relates to races for children and young people; the program for the 2027 edition has not been confirmed.

name: Skalička run
location: Obecní hřiště, Skalička, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Skalička Run is the fifth edition of a successful off-road running event, held mainly in the valley of the Lubě stream in the South Moravian Region. The race offers three distances: 22 km, 13 km and 7 km, all featuring cross-country and trail terrain. It starts at the municipal sports field in Skalička and is suitable for nature-running enthusiasts looking for varying levels of difficulty. The event is organised by DálRunDál z.s., led by Pavel Matoušek.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly through the valley of the Lubě stream
Cross-country and trail terrain
Distances of 22 km, 13 km and 7 km
additional: The race is organised by DálRunDál z.s.; the contact person is Pavel Matoušek. Race type: cross-country/trail. The first category starts at 11:15. The start venue is the municipal sports field.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Kemp Stříbrný rybník, Malšova Lhota, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of Leskros, the largest Czech running and canicross series, offering an authentic trail-running experience. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Stříbrný rybník campsite in Malšova Lhota near Hradec Králové, and includes various running and canicross categories as well as the unique Leskrosí jednadváca race. Individuals and whole families can take part, with children’s races and a charity walk also on offer. The series emphasizes fairness, transparency, and support for nonprofit organizations through entry fees and donations.
course_highlights: Authentic trail running in interesting locations across the Czech Republic
Canicross on the main route, approximately 4 km, with OPEN and ELITE categories
The unique Leskrosí jednadváca: 19–22 km along an unmarked route through beautiful places in the surrounding area
additional: The race offers running, canicross, and Leskrosí jednadváca categories. The Rozběháček children’s running program is free. A 4 km charity walk is also part of the event. Results for individual races and the whole series are announced. Registration and entries are managed through the Rozběháme Česko app. The organizer is the nonprofit organization Rozběháme Česko z.ú., which supports charitable projects. For the 2026 edition, the first category was scheduled to start at 8:00; this time may not apply to the 2027 edition.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
location: Prokopské údolí, Praha 5, Prague, Czech Republic
description: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí is a traditional autumn running race set amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Prokopské and Dalejské valleys in Prague. It offers two main routes of approximately 8.7 and 14.3 km, running along paved and unpaved paths, meadows and trails, with limited traffic on the asphalt roads. The race is suitable for the general public and has a relaxed atmosphere, with refreshments and accompanying children’s races. The capacity is limited to 500 starters, ensuring a comfortable event. The organizers emphasize clear route marking and runner safety.
course_highlights: The routes wind through the beautiful, wild scenery of Prokopské and Dalejské valleys
Two routes of approximately 8.7 km and 14.3 km, with every kilometre marked
The routes combine paved and unpaved paths, meadows, trails and asphalt roads with limited traffic
additional: Race-day check-in and registration take place from 9:00 to 10:45. The children’s races start from 10:00; the main races start at 10:45 (8 km) and 11:00 (14 km). The race is limited to 500 starters. On-site registration is available for an additional fee of 600 Kč, if capacity has not been reached. There is one refreshment station on the course. The timing chip is attached to the race number and does not need to be returned after finishing. Trail shoes with a more aggressive tread are recommended. The event site has toilets, baggage storage, changing tents, a results ceremony and a raffle. Course, price and start-time information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Běhej Valachy
location: Hotel Galik, Velké Karlovice, Czech Republic
description: Běhej Valachy is a trail-running race across the rugged hills of the picturesque Velké Karlovice valley. The course follows the Hanzlůvka valley and passes the Za Miloňovou bell tower before climbing to the ridge of the Vsetín Beskids, below Vysoká and up to Člověčí. From there, it descends along a steep ridge with beautiful views of the Beskids and Javorníky. The race offers unique views, challenging climbs, and a memorable experience of movement and nature. It also includes children’s races for various age groups and a family race.
course_highlights: The course follows the Hanzlůvka valley and passes the Za Miloňovou bell tower on its way to the ridge of the Vsetín Beskids.
Beautiful views of the Beskids and Javorníky from a steep ridge.
A challenging climb past the U Křenků cottage and a mountain sprint at an elevation of 938 m above sea level.
additional: There are mass starts for adults running 12.5 km and 6.5 km, as well as a 3.2 km family race. Children’s races are divided into age categories from 4 to 15 years. The start area opens at 11:45; check-in and registration for children take place from 8:00 to 9:15, and adult check-in runs from 9:30 to 11:30. The finish straight is attractive and offers plenty of room for a final sprint. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule on race day. According to information available for the 2026 edition, the races on offer are 12.5 km, 6.5 km, and a 3.2 km family run, alongside the children’s races. Facilities include registration, a changing room, showers, and refreshments; prices for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
location: Městský stadion Ostrava-Vítkovice, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Golden Emil Zátopek Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running event offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and mixed team race on a fast, certified course in Ostrava-Vítkovice. The event takes place at the Ostrava-Vítkovice Municipal Stadium, with the start and finish on the stadium track. Runners can follow in the footsteps of the legendary Emil Zátopek and experience the atmosphere of a professionally organized race with an accompanying program. The race pack includes an original performance shirt, a medal, and refreshments during and after the race. The event is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava-Vítkovice
Start and finish on the track at the Municipal Stadium
8 refreshment stations on the marathon course offering water, fruit, and energy supplements
additional: The bib with timing chip must be worn on the chest for accurate timekeeping. After the start, marathon runners complete one lap of the stadium track before heading out onto the course. Lead and sweeper vehicles and cyclists accompany the first and last runners. Changing rooms, toilets, and baggage storage are available at the stadium. Parking is available at Ostravar Arena for a fee, or free of charge in limited spaces on nearby streets. After the race, a wide range of refreshments, an expo, and free physiotherapy are available. The date October 23, 2027, has not been confirmed on the official website.

name: Moravská Sázava
location: Horský Resort Buková Hora, Červená Voda, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné ULTRA 50 je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné DVOJIC je stanoveno na 1.000,- Kč / člen dvojice

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 is a 50 km ultrarunning race that follows the valleys of the Moravská Sázava River from Zábřeh to the summit of Buková hora. The course offers a varied mix of forest roads, natural trails and paved sections, with a total elevation gain of 1,369 metres. The race is suitable for experienced ultrarunners as well as runners looking for a new challenge, and finishes at the summit of Buková hora, from where participants can comfortably ride the cable car down. After the race, camping is available in the finish area, with showers and breakfast on Sunday morning.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1,369 m of elevation gain
A mix of forest roads, natural trails and paved sections
Finish at the summit of Buková hora, with the option to ride down by cable car
additional: Participants receive an ID wristband, race bib and GPS tracker. Aid stations along the course provide water, sports drinks, Coca-Cola and fruit. After the race, camping is available at the finish, with access to showers. The finish area is at the cable car’s upper station, and participants can comfortably ride down by cable car. Results are timed electronically and manually. GPS trackers are mandatory and are used to track participants online. The race is included in the UTMB Index 50K and ITRA 50K - 2. The race base is at Horský Resort Buková Hora.

name: NN Night Run Olomouc
description: NN Night Run Olomouc is the largest running event in Olomouc, held at the Flora Exhibition Centre. The event offers a 10 km night run, a 2 × 5 km relay, a 5 km charity run, and a 3 km family run, including children’s races. It brings an unforgettable atmosphere, a varied programme of activities, and support for charitable projects. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can enjoy running through the city at night by the light of headlamps.
course_highlights: Night run through Olomouc, with an atmosphere illuminated by headlamps
Distances ranging from 300 m for children to a 10 km night run
Bellis Run charity race supporting the fight against breast cancer
additional: Registration and race-pack collection take place from 13:00 to 17:30, depending on the race. A baggage drop and changing rooms are available. After the race, participants can enjoy activities including a photo booth, face painting, a bouncy castle, and testing and sales of running equipment and nutritional supplements. Entry can be transferred to another participant online or on site for a fee. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish. The race facilities are at the Flora Exhibition Centre. Online registration closes on 19 October 2026 at 18:00; on-site registration is subject to available capacity. The time limit for the main race is 90 minutes.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Aswan is a traditional cross-country race held on the embankment of the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague’s Jinonice district. It offers courses of various lengths for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, on gently undulating terrain with a natural surface and an asphalt finish straight. The race is accessible only on foot from several nearby bus stops and is organized by Atletika Stodůlky z.s. The entry fee is voluntary, making the race accessible to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A gently undulating course with a natural surface
An asphalt finish straight
The start and race office are on the embankment of the Aswan retention reservoir and are accessible on foot
additional: Race categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 3600 m for men. The start and race office are located at the southern end of the Aswan retention reservoir. Access is on foot only from the Ovčí hájek and Galerie Butovice bus stops and the Volcano complex. The start and race office are at the southern end of the reservoir; access is on foot only.

name: Běh do vrchu na Pastýřskou stěnu
location: Pastýřská stěna, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Pastýřská stěna uphill race is the oldest uphill race in the Czech Republic, with an elevation gain of 110 metres. The race features an extremely steep climb in the second part of the course, which runs over stairs, paving and forest trails. It takes place in Děčín and is suitable for runners looking for a challenging, technical uphill race. It is organised by AK Loko Děčín under the leadership of Zdeněk Hrnčíř.
course_highlights: The oldest uphill race in the Czech Republic, with an elevation gain of 110 m
An extremely steep climb in the second part of the course
The course surface includes stairs, paving and forest trails
additional: The first category starts at 10:30, and the main category starts at 11:00. The organiser is AK Loko Děčín; the contact person is Zdeněk Hrnčíř. The course is short, at 0.83 km, with a significant elevation gain and technical terrain.

name: Kobeřický půlmaraton
location: TJ Sokol Kobeřice, Kobeřice, Czech Republic
description: The Kobeřice Half Marathon is a road race organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, offering runners the chance to test themselves over the half-marathon distance. The race is part of the official Český běh calendar, which provides comprehensive services for runners and organizers in the Czech Republic. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers quality facilities and a certified course. The start time and further details will be confirmed closer to the race date.
course_highlights: Certified road course
Organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice
Half marathon with quality facilities
additional: In 2024, the first category was scheduled to start at 9:00 by the TJ Sokol sports field; the time and location for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Běh metropole is a series of public running races held in various Prague districts, with the aim of promoting a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Ladronka Park and offers a chance to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. Each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition for Prague’s most athletic district. Original medals are prepared for participants as keepsakes from each edition.
course_highlights: Race in Ladronka Park in Prague 6
A series of races across Prague’s districts
Promoting a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Each participant represents their district based on their permanent residence and contributes to the districts’ score. Special medals are prepared for individual categories as unique keepsakes from the race. The official website lists the previous edition in Ladronka Park.

name: Smaltovaný bažant
description: The Enamelled Pheasant is the final race in the Ruler of Mrdice series, held in the picturesque pheasantry in Heřmanův Městec. This traditional 1,500-metre race offers an opportunity to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere. The Heřmanův Městec Running Club organizes a range of sporting activities and group training sessions throughout the year, complementing the racing season. The Enamelled Pheasant is an ideal event for runners who want to end the season with joy and sporting spirit.
course_highlights: A 1,500-metre race in the pheasantry
Part of the Ruler of Mrdice series
A traditional race in Heřmanův Městec
additional: The race is part of the Ruler of Mrdice series, which includes classic races as well as open, timed group training sessions. The running club holds regular group runs every Tuesday in a friendly atmosphere. A course map and results from previous editions are available. The race is the final round of the Mrdice League. In 2026, the first category was scheduled to start at 18:00; the 2027 race date had not been confirmed in the available materials.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Cycling path near Kempinku, Braník, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The VAŠÍ LIGY Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race held in Prague 4-Braník on the cycle path by Kempink. The route follows a beautiful, flat and fast path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back, often enabling runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to experience a high-quality half marathon in pleasant surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful route along the Vltava on a cycle path
A flat and fast course
Route from Braník to Vrané and back
additional: The race takes place on a flat cycle path that is suitable for fast times and personal bests. It is organized by VAŠE LIGA; Petra Lundák can be contacted. A relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed.

name: Náměšťský tvarůžek
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Náměšťský tvarůžek is a four-year running race in Náměšť na Hané, which is part of the Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The main race is 9.22 km long and consists of three 2.9 km loops, plus an approach and a run-out. The course runs on asphalt and farm tracks, offering a combination of firm surfaces and natural surroundings. The race is open to different age categories, as well as a recreational run with no age limit, with an emphasis on fair play and participant safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9.22 km, consisting of three 2.9 km loops
Surface: asphalt and farm tracks
Approach and run-out outside the loop: 518 m in total
additional: Race-day check-in takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150, which will be deducted at check-in. The results ceremony will take place at the KVS grounds; results will be published on hanackybeh.cz and liga100.cz. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a recreational run with no age limit. The race offers cash prizes for the top runners, registration is available with a chip card, and the course passes through the scenic surroundings of Náměšť na Hané.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
location: Sokolovna Nepomuk, Nepomuk, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no competition, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children and run mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk. The event base is at the local Sokol sports grounds, where participants can collect their race packs and receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the country after finishing. Sports activity stations are set up for children, and refreshments are available at the finish. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the sokol hall car park.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along paved paths and roads through the town of Nepomuk
The route passes the Church of St. John of Nepomuk and crosses the Mihovka stream
The finish is at the sokol hall, after a gentle uphill section
additional: Finish times are not measured, and no results list with rankings is produced. The race pack contains a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Sports activity stations for children are set up at the venue. The event base has facilities for leaving belongings and getting refreshments.

name: Provodovský běh
location: Provodov, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov near Zlín. It offers three distances of 5, 11 and 21 kilometres, running mainly along field and forest paths. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in shorter age-based races free of charge. It is organised by UnArt Provodov, p.s., and takes place regardless of the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play. The start and registration are at Areál mládí and the FC Rak Provodov football pitch.
course_highlights: Trail race mainly along field and forest paths
Three distances: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km, with varying levels of difficulty
Free children’s races, with distances from 30 to 750 metres depending on age
additional: Race registration opens at 9:00 at Areál mládí. The race number must be clearly displayed on the chest. First aid is provided by members of the Czech Red Cross (ČČK). The race takes place regardless of the weather; only extreme conditions may cause it to be postponed or cancelled. The organiser reserves the right to change the programme and rules without prior notice.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Březník
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun, non-competitive run held on October 28. The routes follow the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys, mostly along paved and forest roads with gentle descents and climbs. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. A beautiful medal in the shape of the republic and a gift-filled race pack await everyone at the finish. The run takes place on the border of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve, in a private venue with open restrooms.
course_highlights: The route follows the Oslava and Chvojnice valleys along paved and forest roads
A challenging course with difficult terrain and a steep descent on the 6.2 km route
The run takes place on the border of the Divoká Oslava National Nature Reserve
additional: Finish times are not recorded, and no results list or rankings are produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children. The race pack contains a race bib and gifts. Open restrooms are available. The route includes paved and unpaved forest roads, including a challenging section with a steep descent on the 6.2 km route.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Děčín
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Děčín is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main race route is 5 km long and winds through the picturesque town, past the castle gardens and Mariánská louka, across the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and along the flat Elbe embankment, finishing by crossing Tyršův Bridge back to Smetanovo nábřeží. Children can choose between two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, both following a similar route to the adults’ race. The event offers professional timing, a race pack, and a medal shaped like the country for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km loop through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka
Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Flat stretch along the Elbe embankment and crossing Tyršův Bridge
additional: The race is professionally timed. Every participant receives a medal shaped like the country at the finish. The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Online registration closed on 25 October.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Dolní Újezd
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Dolní Újezd is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a main 8.9 km route through the countryside with gentle elevation changes, combining paved roads and compacted dirt tracks. Children can choose flat 1.4 km routes according to their age category. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Refreshments, changing rooms and parking are available for runners’ comfort.
course_highlights: Main race route: 8.9 km with 112 m of elevation gain
A combination of paved roads and compacted dirt tracks
Children’s 1.4 km routes on a flat paved road
additional: Start and finish at the Sokol Hall in Dolní Újezd. Race packs and medals for registered participants. Times are not recorded by a timing system, but results and a winners’ award ceremony are provided. On-site registration beyond the race capacity does not guarantee a medal or race pack.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Kutná Hora
location: Oleška, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, organized on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. In Kutná Hora, the run will take place for the first time, offering a sporting atmosphere and a chance to meet people with a connection to Sokol. The main race route is just under six kilometers long, with the start and finish at the Sokol gym, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The event is suitable for families and individuals, with an emphasis on safety and professional organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sokol gym, with full facilities
Main race of just under 6 km in the beautiful surroundings of Kutná Hora
Children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds, with no need to cross roads
additional: The race capacity is set at approximately 155 runners to ensure quality organization and timekeeping. A team of volunteers is ready to help with course navigation and event organization. Facilities at the Sokol gym include changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments. The children’s courses are safely routed within the grounds so children do not have to cross roads.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Louňovice pod Blaníkem
location: Louňovice pod Blaníkem, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Louňovice pod Blaníkem is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place on October 28. The 5.6 km main race starts from the town square and passes through the natural and historical beauty of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene stands. The course combines paved sections with field and forest paths. At the finish, participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic, and main-race entrants can take part in a raffle. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and is professionally timed.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural and historical beauty of Malý Blaník
Run past the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved, field, and forest paths
additional: The start and finish are on the town square in Louňovice pod Blaníkem, in front of the castle. A raffle for main-race participants takes place after the winners’ awards ceremony. Every participant receives a medal in the shape of the republic at the finish. All races are professionally timed.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Lužice
location: Lužice, Hodonín District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race celebrating the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 27 October 2027. Runners follow paved paths and roads through a beautiful new park created after a tornado, past orchards and vineyards. Shorter routes for children are set up in the Sokol Hall grounds, which also provide changing rooms, showers and refreshments. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the country and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: The route passes through a new park created after a tornado
The route goes past orchards and vineyards around Strání
Paved paths and roads in Lužice
additional: The race is held without chip timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments are available in the Sokol Hall grounds. Sports equipment and games are provided for children. Parking is available by the Sokol Hall and the Sports Hall.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Mníšek pod Brdy
location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Mníšek pod Brdy is a traditional race held in honor of the founding of Czechoslovakia. It takes place on October 28. The race starts by the state chateau and runs through the picturesque surroundings, including Sokol Hall on Vrška, ponds, and the U Káji Maříka Inn. There are various race distances for adults and children, with predominantly asphalt surfaces and easy courses. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal in the shape of the republic, and a race pack with a race number and gifts is provided. The start area has tents for registration and changing, toilets, refreshments, and benches.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the state chateau in Mníšek pod Brdy
The route passes Sokol Hall on Vrška and ponds
The course is asphalt; children's loops are on a grassy area
additional: The event is held in RACE format without timing, but finish times are recorded and winners are announced. Parking, a bag drop, and a rest area are available at the start.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov
location: Nový Bydžov, Hradec Králové District, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nový Bydžov is a traditional race held on October 28 in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia. The event offers routes for adults and children. The main adult race is 4.8 km long and runs partly through the town and partly along dirt roads, crossing two bridges over the Cidlina River. Shorter children’s races take place on the athletics track at the Sportring complex. At the finish, all participants receive a commemorative medal in the shape of the republic and a goody bag. The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers and volunteers stationed at intersections, and is suitable for runners of all categories.
course_highlights: 4.8 km route with 30% asphalt and 70% dirt roads
Cross the Cidlina River via two different bridges
The most challenging section is the uphill climb in the village of Humburky
additional: The race takes place in live traffic, with organisers at intersections and volunteers along the route. The lead runner is guided by a cyclist. Children’s races take place on the athletics track; times are not recorded, and placings are indicative. A goody bag and medal are included in the race. In bad weather, goody bags are handed out in the lobby of the Sokol hall; otherwise, distribution takes place outdoors by the clay court.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Uherský Brod
location: Uherský Brod, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Uherský Brod is a traditional race held in honour of the founding of Czechoslovakia, taking place on 28 October. The race offers several routes for different age categories, including 5 km and 8 km races for adults and shorter distances for children. The routes pass through the town centre, residential areas, around a pond and past allotment gardens, with professional timekeeping and prizes for the fastest runners. Every participant receives a race pack and an original medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Participants under 18 may register only with the consent of a legal guardian. On-site registration is also available.
course_highlights: The 5 km route passes through the town centre and residential areas, and around a pond
The 8 km route continues further into the countryside, past a spring and the observatory
Start and finish at the Sokol stadium, with professional timekeeping
additional: Race times are measured using professional timing equipment. At the event facilities, every participant can collect a race pack containing a race number and gifts. A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits everyone at the finish.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28 by the Czech Sokol Association. It draws inspiration from the historic 1919 relay race, “Rozestavný běh,” and has become a modern tradition that grows every year, connecting dozens of locations in Czechia and abroad. The race offers runners of all ages, including children, an opportunity to celebrate the founding of the republic through movement. The routes vary and often pass through both urban and natural areas, allowing participants to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of each location.
course_highlights: The route in Děčín passes through the castle gardens, Mariánská louka, the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and the flat Elbe riverbank
Children’s races have shorter routes, some of which follow the same route as the adult race
The routes are mostly flat, with varied sections and iconic landmarks in each city
additional: Registration is available online only and is valid once the entry fee has been paid. Children aged 15 to 18 may take part only in the main race. A race T-shirt can be purchased during registration and must be ordered by October 15. On-site registration is available only while capacity remains and does not include a race pack or a medal for late entrants. Races are divided into the BĚH, ZÁVOD, and VELKÝ ZÁVOD levels, each with different rules. In Děčín, times are recorded using professional timing, and participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Milovice
location: Milovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Milovice is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. The race offers an easy 5.8 km trail suitable for beginner and experienced runners, with a partly paved and road surface. Children can enjoy simple oval courses around Haken Stadium, with distances varying by age. At the finish, all participants receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: An easy 5.8 km trail with a partly paved and road surface
Children’s courses around Haken Stadium with an oval gravel surface
A course suitable for beginner and experienced runners; trail shoes are recommended
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring #SBR graphics, Halls Ice Team & Cola (adults only), and an original medal at the finish. On-site registration takes place at Haken Stadium, which also has changing facilities and restrooms. Parking is available near the stadium. For refreshments, you can visit the RKDM restaurant and Clock Cafe next to the stadium.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Písek
location: Palackého sady, Písek, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Písek is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers several routes for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults, and is part of the broader tradition of runs organised by the Czech Sokol Community. The route passes through the picturesque Palacký Gardens, across the Stone Bridge and along the river, with professional timing and awards for the fastest runners. Every participant receives a race pack and an original republic-shaped medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Start in Palacký Gardens by the music pavilion
Across the Stone Bridge and along the Otava River
The route crosses the footbridge to the right bank and returns to the Ševčík Pavilion
additional: The race pack includes a custom-designed bag featuring SBR graphics, a medal at the finish, and the option to order an official Alpine Pro T-shirt for an additional fee. The main race is limited to 180 runners. Registration and race-pack collection close at 11:45 for the children's routes and at 13:30 for the main race. If capacity is not reached, on-site registration is available.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Prostějov
location: Náměstí T. G. Masaryka, Prostějov, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Prostějov is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28.
