The race offers various distances for adults and children, all running through the city center on paved roads, on a 2.5 km loop. The start and finish are at T.G.M. Square, where participants can expect professional timing and a race pack, followed by a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. The atmosphere is enhanced by music, sports demonstrations, and refreshments for runners and spectators. The route is flat, wide enough, and safe, with no parked cars, making for a comfortable run through the historic center of Prostějov.
course_highlights: The route runs through the city center on paved roads
A 2.5 km loop, run 1, 2, or 4 times depending on the race distance
A flat, sufficiently wide course with no parked cars
additional: Start and finish at T.G.M. Square. At 14:00, the clock on the town hall building starts. Facilities include changing rooms for women and men, and storage for valuables and backpacks. Payment by Apple Pay or Google Wallet is available. A memorial ceremony is held at the statue of T. G. Masaryk, followed by the awards ceremony. Traffic is diverted from the route, and municipal police manage parking in the city center.

name: Podzimní běh Dražovkou
location: Vodojem, Hořovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Autumn Run through Dražovka is a traditional race held in Hořovice in a picturesque woodland setting. The main course is approximately 7.2 km long and runs mainly along forest paths over varied terrain. The race also offers a shorter 3.6 km course for women and children’s races. The start and registration are by the water tower at Dražovka, offering convenient access and a setting in nature. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including junior and veteran runners.
course_highlights: Mainly forest paths over varied terrain
Main course: 7.2 km; women’s course: 3.6 km
Start and registration by the water tower at Dražovka in the forest
additional: Junior men, women, and veterans over 70 run one lap; everyone else runs two laps. Children’s races are also part of the program. The start and registration are in the same place, in the forest by the water tower at Dražovka (Podlužská Street).

name: Vinařský maraton
location: Velké Bílovice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Wine Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Báječné ženy v běhu association in Velké Bílovice. The race offers a marathon course with categories for men and women, as well as special categories for visually impaired runners. The event also includes the charitable Vinařská míle run, which supports children with disabilities. Race facilities are located at the local elementary school, where refreshments and a bag drop are available. The race is limited to 800 participants, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Marathon course in the wine-growing region of Velké Bílovice
Charitable Vinařská míle run for children and families
Facilities and refreshments at the elementary school
additional: The race is limited to 800 participants. A bag drop is available in a tent at the multifunctional sports ground. Participants can enter as relay teams; all team members must be registered under the same team name. Wooden medals are awarded at the finish, and small prizes are prepared for children taking part in the charitable Vinařská míle run.

name: Lhotecká Kaštanka
location: Restaurace U Splavu, Lhota, Kladno District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Lhotecká Kaštanka is a 15 km race on asphalt and firm forest paths around Lhota in the Kladno District. This run is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Running Cup and offers runners a pleasant route combining asphalt and forest surfaces. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting on quality surfaces. The start and finish are at the U splavu restaurant in the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: 15 km route
Asphalt and firm forest paths
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Running Cup

name: Krospůlmaraton
location: Sosnová u České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Krosp half marathon in Sosnová near Česká Lípa is a traditional running race held as part of the Česká Lípa District Running League. The race takes place and offers runners the chance to test their strength in the pleasant autumn setting of the Liberec Region. The event is part of a series of regional races that encourage sporting activity and community gatherings for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Natural terrain suitable for cross-country
Part of a regional running league
Held in the picturesque surroundings of Sosnová near Česká Lípa
additional: The race is part of a regional running series. The exact course profile is not provided, but the terrain is expected to be suitable for running in nature.

name: Lesní kros mezi přeštickými prasaty
location: Střelnice, Přeštice, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic
description: Lesní kros mezi přeštickými prasaty is a traditional 8-kilometre race in Přeštice. Runners follow forest paths, running over dirt, leaves and roots, with the possibility of mud. The start and finish are at Střelnice in Přeštice, which offers convenient facilities, including changing rooms, refreshments and home cooking. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and is open to runners over the age of 15. Registration opens at 9:00 and the race starts at 10:30. The results are announced after the last runner finishes, usually around noon.
course_highlights: Eight kilometres of forest paths with natural obstacles such as roots and leaves
Start and finish at the traditional venue, Střelnice in Přeštice
The race takes place in all weather conditions
additional: On-site registration opens at 9:00. By registering, runners consent to the processing of their personal data for the purposes of organising and promoting the race. The organiser provides changing rooms, refreshments and home cooking at the Střelnice venue. The race is open to runners over the age of 15; minors must have the consent of their legal guardians.

name: Motolské jamky
location: Golf Club Praha, Motol, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Motolské jamky is a traditional metropolitan trail run held on the course of the oldest golf club in the Czech Republic, which is celebrating its centenary. The race features a challenging hilly profile and runs over soft green fairways and forest paths, making it an enjoyable experience for runners of all abilities. The event is part of the Trail Running Cup and is known for its atmosphere, quality services and the opportunity to enjoy a family outing in Prague. The start and finish are at a familiar spot below the central putting green. The course consists of four or two laps, with a total elevation gain of 184 or 92 metres, respectively.
course_highlights: A challenging course with three hills and one steeper climb before the finish
Predominantly soft surfaces, running over green fairways and forest paths
The course passes the golf course’s holes, with views of Prague
additional: The race is part of the Trail Running Cup and offers 28 categories, from the youngest participants to seniors. The course was slightly modified four years ago, with one steeper hill removed. The event has been held without interruption for 22 years and is known for its high-quality race services. After the finish, refreshments are available in the clubhouse restaurant.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - listopad
description: The 2 Mile Run Olomouc is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The event focuses on the joy of running and competing primarily against yourself. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, by the fountain. It also includes a cup competition with a points system based on age coefficients, encouraging participation throughout the year.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
Suitable for all ages and running abilities
Scenic park setting by the fountain
additional: Registration takes place on site from 9:30 to 10:00. The top three finishers are announced in each category. The race is part of a year-round cup competition with a points system, counting each runner’s best results from a maximum of 9 races during the year.

name: HRUŠTICE 10 km - Memoriál Zdeňka Drobníka
location: Metelkovy sady, Turnov, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 200 Kè - přihláška předem - kategorie Z, Z35, Z45, M39, V40, V50, V60

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné 150 Kè - přihláška předem - kategorie V70, Z55

description: The HRUŠTICE Road Race – Zdeněk Drobník Memorial is a traditional race dating back to 1974. Since 2024, it has been run on a new 10 km course through the Jizera River valley in Turnov. The start and finish are in Metelkovy Gardens, an urban park, and the course runs mostly on paved roads and cycle paths, with gentle elevation changes and one steeper hill. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants and offers a pleasant atmosphere in beautiful natural surroundings. It is organized by the AC Turnov athletics club, which provides full race services, including chip timing.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Jizera River valley, mostly on paved roads and cycle paths
Start and finish in Metelkovy Gardens, an urban park in Turnov
One steeper hill, about 200 m long, at around the 3.5 km mark
additional: All categories start together. Registration and race number pickup take place from 08:45 to 10:00 at the AC Turnov clubhouse at Ludvík Daněk Stadium. The start and finish are in Metelkovy Gardens, about 600 m from the stadium, where you can leave your car. Parking at the start and finish is not provided. After the race, race numbers are entered into a draw for prizes.

name: Betelný Bergl – Virtuální běžecká série závodů – Brněnsko
location: Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Běh na Babí lom
location: Babí lom, Kuřim, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Beroun
location: Hospoda na Černém vršku, Prague, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series in Beroun is a night stage through the beautiful Křivoklát forests. The route is marked with yellow reflective signs and red arrows on the ground, and passes over the summit of Děd, with views of Beroun and the surrounding area. The race features a challenging climb to the lookout tower, followed by a descent to the finish. Each participant receives a race number and a headlamp. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site.
course_highlights: Night stage with a headlamp
The route passes the Děd lookout tower, with views of Beroun
Marked with yellow reflective signs and red arrows
additional: The latest start time is 17:45. The top three finishers in each category receive a diploma. Participants are provided with a headlamp.

name: Benešovská dušičková soutěska
location: Občerstvení Pod Lesem, Benešov nad Ploučnicí, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic

name: Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Elbe Valley is a traditional autumn running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Žleb near Děčín. The race offers courses of 4, 8, and 16 kilometres, running through varied terrain, mostly on forest roads and trails. It is organised by the LABÁCI group, which continues the long-standing tradition of local organisers. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy the beauty of the Elbe Valley in autumn.
course_highlights: Varied terrain, mostly on forest roads and trails
Picturesque Elbe Valley in autumn
Courses of 4, 8, and 16 km, suitable for different age and ability groups
additional: Race registration takes place from 10:45 at the gathering point in Dolní Žleb, in front of the “U KOSTI” pub. The organiser does not provide changing rooms, but luggage storage is available. The recommended way to get to the race is by train, departing from Děčín main railway station at 10:41. After the race, runners can enjoy tea and a friendly atmosphere.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky is an autumn trail race held at the historic Velichovky spa, offering varied and beautiful running terrain. The start and finish are located on the spa colonnade, with covered facilities, changing rooms and a restaurant, including a spa café. The race is known for its atmosphere and quality services for runners, including refreshments, medical services and an accompanying programme. Participants receive an original medal, a race pack and electronic chip timing. The race is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the beauty of autumn nature and the spa setting.
course_highlights: The most colourful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: Runners have access to changing rooms, luggage storage, toilets, catering and parking. The entry fee includes an electronic timing chip, refreshments during the race and at the finish, photos and a downloadable certificate (photos are not guaranteed for everyone). Gladiator Race clothing is available for purchase on site.

name: Jizerun
location: Stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Obsahuje : 5x funkční účastnické triko, 5x čelenka, 5x večeře formou rautu v Parkhotelu Smržovka, 5x finisher medaile, předstartovní káva a drobné občerstvení na startu a v cíli, startovní čísla, výsledkový servis a online GPS tracker, finisher párty s živou hudbou.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Obsahuje : 5x finisher medaile, předstartovní káva a drobné občerstvení na startu a v cíli, startovní čísla, výsledkový servis a online GPS tracker, finisher párty s živou hudbou.

description: Jizerun is a relay running race that takes teams of 4–5 runners from Prague to the Jizera Mountains. The total route is approximately 165 km, which competitors complete in one day. The course follows cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains, offering a team experience full of sporting challenges and camaraderie. The race is open to men’s, women’s, mixed, and corporate relay teams. The start and finish are at the stadium in Čelákovice, and a finisher party with live music awaits at the finish.
course_highlights: A 165 km relay run from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
The route follows cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains
Stages of varying difficulty, from 1 to 8 on a scale of 10
additional: The race package includes, among other things, portable toilets, facilities at the finish including showers, a host and sound system, medical services throughout the race, gifts from partners, photos and video, full staffing, and all necessary permits. Check-in is mandatory; the presence of one team member or their representative is sufficient.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: Běh kolem Práchně is a road race around Horažďovice in the Plzeň Region, offering runners the challenge of a course with elevation gain. The race is part of the official Czech Running calendar, managed by the Czech Athletics Federation. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers quality facilities and organization. Exact details about the course distance and start time will be published closer to race day.
course_highlights: A road race with elevation gain around Horažďovice
Scenic surroundings in the Plzeň Region
Part of the official Czech Running calendar

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
location: Příluky, Zlín, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit, just under 2 laps long (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 metres long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal building. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Every runner is timed, and the first three finishers in both the adult and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop).

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
location: Otrokovice, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival 2026 offers a wide range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10K and youth races. The MUDr. Josef Podmolík Memorial is the festival’s premier half-marathon event. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Otrokovice, with the start and finish between the Lanáček rope centre and the Municipal Sports Hall. The festival is a traditional gathering for runners of all ages and abilities, with electronic timing and a varied accompanying programme. Participants can enjoy a high-quality asphalt course and convenient facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: Start and finish between the Lanáček rope centre and the Municipal Sports Hall
The course is 100% asphalt
Course suitable for all ages, including youth
additional: Race registration takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Changing rooms and showers are available in the hall. Refreshments can be purchased at the Lanáček rope centre near the start and finish. Parking is available by the main building of the New Stadium and on nearby streets. The start and finish area is accessible only on foot.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: Atletický stadion TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional endurance running race organized by the athletics and triathlon club TJ Lokomotiva Beroun since 1985. The race offers two routes: 11 km for women and men over 70, and 18 km for men under 70. They run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium in Beroun, with turnarounds in the settlement of V Kozle and in Svatý Jan pod Skalou. The race takes place in normal road traffic; participants must obey traffic regulations and take part at their own risk.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
Two turnarounds: the 11 km route turns in the settlement of V Kozle; the 18 km route turns in Svatý Jan pod Skalou
additional: On-site check-in and registration are available on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Runners who register in advance and pay by November 4 will receive a race number bearing their name. Finish-line refreshments include tea and biscuits. Parking is available in nearby car parks outside the blue zones around the stadium.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Kovárna VIVA, former Svit/Baťa industrial complex, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Kovářská pětka is a 5-kilometre urban road race held in Zlín in the former Baťa industrial complex. The race is for both adults and children and is organised by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with the Běhy Zlín association. The event has a long tradition and attracts strong competition, including international runners. It offers a pleasant atmosphere in the centre of the regional capital and is suitable for the general public.
course_highlights: A 5 km road course in the former Baťa industrial complex
The centre of Zlín, with its historic industrial complex
Events for adults and children
additional: The race has children’s categories and is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. It is organised by the Běhy Zlín association and Kovárna VIVA. Results and photos from previous editions are regularly published on the website.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
location: Královská obora Stromovka, Praha 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague is an open race for the public, held in the beautiful surroundings of Královská obora - Stromovka Park. The course follows the park’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (2 miles, i.e. 3.2 km), while children up to 12 years old run one lap (1 mile + 70 m). The race is part of the year-round Lívancový pohár, which recognizes performances adjusted using an age coefficient. The start is usually at 9:07 a.m. on the first Saturday of each month, and registration is available both on site and online.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km + 70 m)
Královská obora - Stromovka offers beautiful surroundings that are almost always dry
additional: Registration takes place in the area by the Brussels Gate, beneath the Marold Panorama building, from 8:15 to 8:45 a.m. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings, along with a mobile valuables storage facility and toilet cabins. Arriving by bike, on foot, on rollerblades, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský ostrov, on Za elektrárnou Street.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Dostihové závodiště Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held at the racecourse in Lysá nad Labem. It offers two routes of approximately 13 km and 21 km, running through the flat Elbe lowland forest on a combination of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short asphalt sections. The start and finish are in the racecourse grounds, where refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities are available. The race is suitable for the general public and also includes children’s races. Capacity is limited to 730 participants, ensuring a comfortable event.
course_highlights: The routes are flat and run through the beautiful Elbe lowland forest
The start follows approximately 1 km on the racecourse track
The route surface consists of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short asphalt/concrete sections
additional: Race capacity is limited to 730 participants. Parking is available in the racecourse grounds for a fee of 50 Kč. Tents for changing, baggage storage, toilets, and refreshments are provided at the start and finish. The 21 km route has two aid stations (at km 8 and 17), while the 13 km route has one aid station (at km 8). The route is marked with flags, signs, and flour arrows, and each kilometre is marked for guidance.

name: Závod dvojic
location: Kladno, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hostivař Doubles is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team-running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Hostivař. The race is for pairs who want to tackle the course together and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Relay race for pairs
Scenic surroundings of Hostivař
Friendly, sporting atmosphere

name: Hornická desítka
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race in the Moravian-Silesian Region, held in and around Frýdek-Místek. The race has a long history dating back to 1980 and gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on a 10 km course. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and broad participation by runners of all ages, including youth races and a run for health. Hornická desítka is a celebration of exercise and sporting spirit in the region.
course_highlights: The course runs between the former Paskov and Staříč mines
The race is 10 km long
The route is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners
additional: The race is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. and is part of a wider sports event featuring runs for children, youth and adults. In the past, more than 2,000 runners have taken part, including recreational parent-and-child runs.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Pardubice, Pardubice District, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country is a traditional cross-country race organized by the AC Pardubice athletics club. The race takes place in Pardubice and is open to all runners and running enthusiasts. The organizers look forward to welcoming participants and spectators, and publish the race information and results on their website. The race has a long tradition and is part of AC Pardubice's regular events.

name: Během proti závislostem
location: Lesopark Homolka, Plzeň 2, Plzeň, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: MUŽI, ŽENY, HOŠI, DÍVKY – 150,- Kč. Online

description: The Run Against Addiction is a running race in Plzeň, offering courses from 300 metres to 6 kilometres along the paved paths of Homolka Forest Park. The race is open to various age categories and includes a relay for teams of three, with each runner completing one lap of approximately 2,000 metres. The 6 km course is varied and consists of three laps, while the children’s courses are flat. The organisers provide medals and prizes for the top three finishers in each category, and the race takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: The course follows the paved paths of Homolka Forest Park
The 6 km course has varied terrain and consists of three laps
The children’s courses are flat and suitable for younger runners
additional: Race bibs are distributed at the event venue from 9:00 to 10:20. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organiser reserves the right to change the categories and times depending on how the race progresses. The relay team has three members, each running one lap of approximately 2,000 m, with a clearly marked handover zone.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
location: Madal Bal, U Tescomy 244, Zlín-Příluky, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and covers just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. There is also an 800-meter children’s course. Every participant can enjoy a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish. The race is held regularly on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children’s course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 to 127, and children up to 12 years old. Each runner’s time is recorded, and the top three finishers in the men’s, women’s, and children’s categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start are by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The men’s course record is 9:31.8. The start and registration are in front of the Madal Bal company building at U Tescomy 244 in Zlín-Příluky.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - září
location: Bruselská brána, Královská obora–Stromovka, Prague 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague is an open race for the public, held in the beautiful surroundings of Královská obora - Stromovka Park. The course follows the park’s paved paths. Adults run two laps (2 miles, i.e. 3.2 km), while children up to 12 years old run one lap (1 mile + 70 m). The race is part of the year-round Lívancový Cup, which recognizes runners’ performances using age-adjusted coefficients. You can register on site at the Brussels Gate or online in advance for faster check-in. The race usually starts at 9:07 a.m. on the first Saturday of each month.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful surroundings in Královská obora - Stromovka, with almost no rain
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate from 8:15 to 8:45 a.m. Tents are available for changing and storing belongings, along with a mobile valuables storage service in exchange for a race number and toilet booths. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is recommended by the bridge to Císařský ostrov on Za elektrárnou Street. The usual start time for the first category is 9:07 a.m.

name: Ádrkros, memoriál Ivanky Čadové a Míry Šmída
Běh okolo přehrady Křetínky
location: Křetínka Reservoir, Letovice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Běh na Českou chalupu, memoriál Mirko Gräfa
location: Lidové sady, Liberec, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

name: Běh Mrázovkou – o pohár starosty TJ Sokol I. Smíchov
location: Letní cvičiště TJ Sokol I. Smíchov, Mrázovka, Prague, Czech Republic

name: Běh na 2 míle – Praha, Stromovka
location: Bruselská brána, Královská obora Stromovka, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2 Miles Run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for the general public. The course follows paved paths through the Royal Game Preserve Stromovka, where adults run two laps and children up to 12 years old run one. The race usually takes place on the first Saturday of each month, starting at 9:07, and offers a pleasant park setting with changing facilities and toilets. Each participant’s time is recorded, and results count toward the year-long Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Royal Game Preserve Stromovka
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles); children up to 12 run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Start and registration by the Brussels Gate, below the Marold Panorama
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate from 8:15 to 8:45. You can also register online in advance for a faster check-in. We recommend arriving by bike, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Parking is recommended by the bridge to Císařský Island, on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing, along with a mobile valuables storage facility. Results are published online, and times are adjusted using an age coefficient for the Lívancový Cup. Runners are welcomed at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake. Tents for changing and leaving belongings, as well as toilets, are available on site.

name: Běžecký festival - 26. ročník Memoriálu MUDr. Podmolíka v půlmaratonu, Otrokovický maraton a doprovodné závody
Běh o koláč panny z Dívčích Hradů
description: The Běh o koláč panny z Dívčích Hradů is a traditional running race organized by SK Zlíchov Praha, held on the first Saturday in November. The race attracts a wide range of runners, including young aspiring athletes and veterans, and offers a pleasant atmosphere with friendly competition. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and sunny weather, which also prevailed at the most recent edition. After the race, participants can meet and socialize at the club premises.
course_highlights: A traditional race held on the first Saturday in November in Prague’s Zlíchov district
A wide range of participants, from schoolchildren to veterans
A friendly atmosphere and pleasant weather
additional: The race is part of the activities of SK Zlíchov Praha, which also organizes other social and sporting events. The boathouse is accessible only to members with keys or by arrangement with the committee. After the race, it is possible to attend social evenings and other club activities.

name: PLESENSKÁ 7
location: Městské kulturní středisko Plesná, Plesná, Czech Republic

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on both roads and trails, offering varied surroundings for competitors. The race is popular with the regional running community and provides an opportunity to challenge yourself and meet fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on both roads and trails
Part of the regional Českolipsko running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026. Registration and further details are not specified. The event is part of a broader series of regional races.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and features a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the cinder track of TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, and the course runs over cinder surfaces and field paths. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. It is organized by ASK Dipoli, and the main race starts at 13:00.
course_highlights: Start at the cinder track of TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
The course runs over cinder surfaces and field paths
Course length: approx. 6 km
additional: Results are available for the children’s categories and overall. The organizers also hold other races as part of the Brdy Running Cup, including two-person relays and children’s races.

name: Velká kunratická
description: Velká kunratická is a traditional running race in Prague-Kunratice, held without interruption since 1934. The race is known for its challenging course profile and changeable weather, and offers a unique atmosphere for runners of all ages. It is run on six courses ranging from 370 to 3100 metres, with a total of 27 categories. The race is organised by the Spartak Praha 4 athletics club and attracts a broad community of runners, from children to veterans.
course_highlights: Challenging course profile in Kunratice Forest
Six courses from 370 m to 3100 m, marked with coloured signage
Interval starts in pairs, with a ten-second gap
additional: Starts in all categories are in intervals, in pairs with a ten-second gap. The main start is by the gazebo; the children’s start is above the mill. The organiser offers official T-shirts, which can be ordered during registration or purchased later for an already assigned race number. The total number of participants is limited to 3600, with the number of runners crossing Hrádek limited to 2700. The elite men’s categories have special qualification conditions. Race photos are offered directly by the organiser.

name: Krumlovská 11
location: Hornobránský rybník, Český Krumlov, Czech Republic
description: Krumlovská 11 is a sporting, social and charity event in Český Krumlov, offering routes for children, families and adults. The main race is approximately 11 km long and runs through beautiful countryside via Křížová hora and Přídolí, with the start and finish at Hornobránský Pond. The event also includes a family run for children aged 2 to 15 and relay races, including a corporate relay that supports the Personal Assistance social service. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, while also supporting a good cause in the region.
course_highlights: The main route is approximately 11 km and runs via Křížová hora and Přídolí
Family run with a 1–2 km route depending on age group
Relay race: 2 × 5.5 km, with the handover at Hornobránský Pond
additional: Race-number packs can be collected at the event venue from 8:45 to 11:30. The main race is limited to 200 runners, and the family run to 200 children. All relays start together with the main race at 12:11. The corporate relay supports the Personal Assistance social service. Running T-shirts for children are available to purchase on site.

name: Drsný běh okolo hradu Potštejn
location: Řemeslný Pivovar Clock, Potštejn, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

name: PoHodová devítka
location: Football Stadium, Velká Bíteš, Vysočina, Czech Republic

name: Starobělské Lurdy
location: Bělský les, Ostrava-Zábřeh, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

name: Chlumecká pětka - Svatomartinský běh
location: Chlumec nad Cidlinou, Hradec Králové District, Czech Republic

name: Běh na Dobrošov
description: The Run to Dobrošov is a public uphill race with a mass start, held in the picturesque surroundings of Náchod - Běloves. The race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting challenge on courses of 3.8 km and 1.5 km. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience the atmosphere of a running race in the beautiful countryside of the Hradec Králové Region. It is organized by the Redpoint Teplice nad Metují sports club, which ensures high-quality organization and support for the runners.
course_highlights: Uphill race with a mass start
Courses of 3.8 km and 1.5 km through natural surroundings
Picturesque surroundings of Náchod - Běloves in the Hradec Králové Region

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
location: Autokemp Ostende, Plzeň-Bolevec, Plzeň, Czech Republic
organizer: Pilsen Trail pořadatelský team, Jiří Mlátil Bouchal
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn race in the forests around Pilsen, offering courses for all ages, from the youngest children to experienced endurance runners. The race takes place in a beautiful natural setting, with a climb up Chlum, trail sections and wonderful views along the Berounka, followed by a climb up Krkavec. There is always a large turnout at the start, and everyone receives a wooden finisher medal at the finish. The race also includes refreshments along the course and at the finish, as well as electronic chip timing.
course_highlights: Climb up Chlum
Trail sections with views along the Berounka
Climb up Krkavec
additional: Race check-in takes place from 8:30 to 10:50 at the race center. Every participant receives a race number and a chip for electronic timing, which must be returned after finishing. Parking is limited; the car parks around Bolevecký Pond are recommended, followed by a walk to the venue. Results are announced in stages by category, with the children’s races around 11:30 and the main races around 14:20. Children’s courses are also available.

name: BoBoBěh
location: Bedřichov, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: BoBoBěh is the final mountain race in the BoBoloppet trilogy, taking runners through the beautiful Jizera Mountains. The race offers a 30 km route via Vysoký hřeben, Kanál, the Černá Nisa dam, Olivetská hora, Ferdinandov, and the challenging climb up Bílý Štolpich. Less experienced runners can choose the shorter 10 km Buď Fit route, and children can take part in the 1 km MINI run. The race is open to everyone who loves running and nature, offering a unique mountain-terrain experience with beautiful views.
course_highlights: The route runs via Vysoký hřeben and the popular Kanál
Cross the Černá Nisa dam and climb Olivetská hora twice
The toughest climb is up Bílý Štolpich in the Jizera Mountains
additional: The start is not a mass start. Runners have a two-hour window to leave the starting chute, allowing them to choose their start strategy. The route is not marked, making the race partly an orienteering run. Runners can choose their running style during the race.

name: Běh přes Černovírský les
location: Hlušovice, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through Černovír Forest is a traditional, flat 10 km race along the cycle path from Hlušovice to Olomouc and back. It is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix and attracts runners of various age groups. The course is suitable for runners who prefer a fast, easy route in pleasant autumn surroundings. Popular with locals and endurance runners from the surrounding area, the race offers a chance to test your strength in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat course along the cycle path
Route runs from Hlušovice to Olomouc and back
Race distance: 10 km
additional: In the past, the race has been held in November and has attracted runners of various age groups. The course is also suitable for masters runners and offers a pleasant autumn running environment.

name: Běh Dlouhými záhony
location: ZŠ Lány, Úpice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Běh Dlouhými záhony is a demanding 6.8 km cross-country race with significant elevation changes. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Winter Running League for the King of the Jestřebí Mountains, underscoring its prestige and challenge. The course runs around Úpice – ZŠ Lány in the Hradec Králové Region and offers runners the challenge of varied terrain. The race is suitable for experienced runners looking for a quality mountain run with technical sections.
course_highlights: A challenging 6.8 km cross-country race
Significant elevation changes along the course
Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Winter Running League

name: Svatomartinský běh
location: Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The St. Martin’s Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers 5.5 km and 11 km courses for men and women, running through beautiful countryside and suitable for runners of different abilities. The event is part of the sporting programme at Berchtold Castle and attracts runners from the wider area. After the race, participants can make use of the hotel and restaurant facilities on the castle grounds.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque countryside around Petřkovice near Starý Jičín
Two main distances: 5.5 km and 11 km for men and women
A friendly atmosphere and access to the facilities at Berchtold Castle
additional: Results from previous editions are available online. The grounds offer parking for approximately 150 cars across three car parks. After the race, participants can use the hotel and restaurant services on the grounds of Berchtold Castle.

name: Ludgeřovický kros
location: Hřiště TJ Ludgeřovice, Ludgeřovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Ludgeřovice Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in the natural surroundings of the village of Ludgeřovice, attracting runners of all ages every year. The main course is 10 km long and follows varied terrain, including forest roads, field paths and routes past local landmarks. In addition to the main race, there are shorter 4 km runs, a 9 km Nordic walking event and children’s races by age category. The event is part of the Prajzsko-Opavská Running League and is subtitled the Veterans’ Run, paying tribute to heroes from both past and present.
course_highlights: Main 10 km course with 140 m of elevation gain
Terrain includes forest roads, field paths and routes around local landmarks
Additional events: 4 km run, 9 km Nordic walking and children’s races of 100 m and 500 m
additional: A custom-designed metal finisher’s medal; a commemorative magnet for the first 200 participants to register in person; a copy of the book Ještě jeden maraton for the first 300 entrants; cash prizes for the main race winners; chip timing for children’s races too; awards presented down to fourth place in all races; the accompanying Ludgeřovice Veterans’ Day programme; personal race videos and photos; changing rooms, showers and convenient parking; children’s races with an awards ceremony and a raffle. Courses: 10 km, 9 km, 4 km and children’s races. Weather uncertain. Held in conjunction with Veterans’ Day.

name: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka
location: Orlovna, Chelčického 885, Moravské Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: The Father Václav Kosmák Half Marathon is a road out-and-back race that runs from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back. The race offers runners the chance to test themselves over a half-marathon distance in the picturesque Vysočina region. The event is suitable for all runners looking for a quality race with a traditional atmosphere and a well-marked course.
course_highlights: Road out-and-back race
The course runs from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back
Picturesque Vysočina region

name: Hubertův lesní trail
description: Hubert’s Forest Trail is a running race for children and adults, held in the beautiful Hradec Forests on the Forest “Finnish” running trail in Malšovice. The start and finish are located near the Forest Cemetery. The event offers children’s categories with shorter, untimed courses and a main race for adults. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published on the organiser’s website within 24 hours of the race.
course_highlights: Forest “Finnish” running trail in Malšovice
Start and finish 200 m from the Forest Cemetery
Beautiful woodland setting in the Hradec Forests
additional: Children’s categories start from 10:20; registration for children is open from 09:30 to 10:15. The main adult race starts between 11:00 and 11:45. Children’s races start at 10:20 and the main race at 12:00. The entry fee includes timing, refreshments and a medal; the first three finishers in each category also receive a small gift. Public transport: line 9, Forest Cemetery stop; parking is at the Forest Cemetery.

name: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov
location: Malá Víska, Zaječov, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov is a running race divided into two stages held over two days on courses prepared for sled-dog races in Malá Víska near Zaječov. The first day features a long stage of 13 km, and the second day a short stage of 5.7 km. The main challenge is the combined competition over both stages, with a total distance of 18.7 km, where competitors’ times are adjusted using a coefficient based on gender and age. The race is open to everyone regardless of gender or age and offers a beautiful natural setting of meadows and forest trails in the Brdy Mountains.
course_highlights: Two stages on courses prepared for sled-dog races
The course surface consists of meadows and forest trails
Combined competition with a total distance of 18.7 km
additional: After each stage, the top 5 competitors are announced based on adjusted times. Men aged 25–30 have a coefficient of 1.0; all other categories have a lower coefficient. The long stage starts on Saturday 14. 11. at 12:00, and the short stage on Sunday 15. 11. at 11:00. The venue is the meadow in Malá Víska near Zaječov.

name: Kuchařovická výzva
location: Kuchařovice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kuchařovická výzva is a running race held in Kuchařovice, with courses for men, women, and children. The men’s course is 8.4 km with 114 m of elevation gain, the women’s course is 5.9 km with 71 m of elevation gain, and the children’s course is 150 m long. The race runs mainly on forest paths and asphalt, over gently rolling terrain. The start and check-in are in front of the multipurpose building in Kuchařovice. Parking is available by Emrammus Restaurant, the kindergarten, and on Větrná Street.
course_highlights: Men’s course: 8.4 km with 114 m of elevation gain
Women’s course: 5.9 km with 71 m of elevation gain
70% forest paths, 30% asphalt; rolling terrain
additional: Check-in and registration take place from 8:30 to 9:30 in front of the multipurpose building in Kuchařovice.

name: Hrouzovka 2026
description: This race offers a course approximately 15 km long, running through hilly terrain with varied surfaces, including asphalt, grass, and rocky paths. The event is intended for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting and wanting to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. Details about the organizer and registration have not yet been announced, but the race is part of the local running calendar.

name: Za jedovnickým kaprem
location: Jedovnice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

name: Podzimní Řakom
location: Dolany village square, inn hall, Dolany, Plzeň Region, Czech Republic

name: Krosová 12°
description: Krosová 12° is a 12 km or 6 km running race on a hilly 6 km loop around Velešín in the South Bohemian Region. This cross-country race challenges runners with demanding, hilly terrain, making it ideal for those who enjoy trail running and hills. The race is suitable for the general public who want to try running off-road amid beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. Recommended running gear and accessories are presented on the official website.
course_highlights: Hilly 6 km loop with elevation gain
Choice of 12 km or 6 km course
Natural terrain with views around Velešín
additional: The race offers two course distances: 12 km and 6 km, both on a hilly loop. The website recommends running gear and accessories such as Ultra Trail socks, Altra and Puma running shoes, and lightweight jackets suitable for changeable weather. The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an attractive hilly course and a choice of two distances.

name: Běh 17. listopadu
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 17 November Run is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová commemorating an important day in Czech history. It offers two main distances: the certified 10 km Freedom Ten and the 5 km Revolution Five. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and support the idea of freedom. Check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská, with the races starting in the morning. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Ostrava-Hrabová, which is easy to reach by public transport and shared Nextbike bicycles.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km Freedom Ten course
5 km Revolution Five
Routes through Ostrava-Hrabová, with good public transport connections
additional: On-site check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská 110/46 from 8:30 to 9:40. The individual races start in the morning. Public transport is available on lines 27, 39, 41 and 77, with a stop at Šídlovec. Shared Nextbike bicycles are also available. The race includes several course distances, online registration is available, and the event has a long tradition, with results from previous editions.

name: Sametový běh
location: Odolena Voda, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 30. 9., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 200,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 11. 11., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 300,- při registraci on-line od 12. 11. do konání závodu, platba převodem nebo v hotovosti při prezentaci

description: The Velvet Run is a traditional running event held in Odolena Voda, offering races for all age groups, including a family run for parents and children. The event takes place at the football field and includes distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, a handmade gingerbread medal and light refreshments after the race, including tea and mulled wine. The organizers ensure the course is safe and also prepare a raffle with a variety of prizes. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:17.
course_highlights: Distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at the football field in Odolena Voda
Handmade gingerbread medals for participants
additional: Race-day registration opens at 08:45 at the event venue. Light refreshments are available after the race, including tea, mulled wine and homemade buns. Runners receive a race bib with a timing chip and safety pins. Parking is available by Penny Market. The organizers provide course and event safety. Categories are divided by age and gender, including the Fighters, Champions and Legends categories. The course surface includes the football field; the event features a raffle, refreshments and fun activities for families. Registration is available on site.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Přerov
description: The November 17 Run in Přerov is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletika SK Přerov. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities the opportunity to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test themselves on an interesting course. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the city of Přerov and is part of the local athletics calendar. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 9 km cross-country race, with children’s categories also available
Part of the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Online registration and results available
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, offers various courses including cross-country, and attracts a wide range of participants from the region.

name: Běh kolem koupaliště
description: The Run Around the Swimming Pool is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place on a 5,000-meter course that runs around the local swimming pool. The start is at 11:00, and participants can compete in several age categories. Race facilities include registration at the sports hall, changing rooms and showers. After the race, the results are announced and prizes are awarded. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 5,000-meter course (4 laps)
The route runs around the swimming pool in Kopřivnice
Start and registration at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall
additional: Registration from 9:45 at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. Categories are divided by age and gender. Changing rooms and showers are available. The results will be announced at 12:30 in the sports hall buffet, with prizes awarded. Registration takes place at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. The race is open to men and women; participants run 4 laps. Roots and stones are marked for safety. Refreshments are available at the finish, and there is a raffle. The ceremonial start is signaled by a pistol shot fired by the mayor.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Kadaň
location: Rooseveltovy sady, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17 Run in Kadaň is a traditional running race organized by the SK Městská policie Kadaň sports club. The race takes place in Rooseveltovy sady and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community. The race information and further details are available to download in PDF format on the official website.
course_highlights: The race runs through Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň
A course suitable for different age groups
A friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community
additional: The race information is available to download in PDF format. Results and photo galleries from previous editions are published on the website. The organizer is SK Městská policie Kadaň, a sports club with Bc. Jiří Vlasák as its contact. The event includes starts at various distances (e.g. 100 m, 280 m, 550 m, 1300 m, 1800 m, 2500 m, 5000 m). Registration is available on the website, and the event is suitable for all age groups. The venue is in Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň, behind the sports hall.

name: Běh městem Hradec Králové
location: V Lipkách, Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh městem Hradec Králové is a traditional road race held in the city centre on a flat course. The race offers a 9.7 km route consisting of five laps. A shorter 200-metre lap is prepared for children and young athletes. The event is suitable for the general public and is organised by TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové with the support of the Czech Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: 5 laps on a flat course in the city centre
200-metre children’s lap
9.7 km road race
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, and the main category starts at 12:00. The race takes place in the V Lipkách residential area, near ZŠ Josefa Gočára in Hradec Králové. The organiser is TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové z.s.; the contact person is Jiří Brych. Starts are scheduled for 10:00 and 12:00. Registration is available through the sport-reg.cz sports portal.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Polička
location: Lesopark Liboháj, Polička, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč hlavní závod, dobrovolné startovné lidový běh
description: The November 17 Run in Polička is a traditional cross-country race held in Liboháj Forest Park. The main race is 6 km, split into two 3-kilometre loops, and is complemented by a 3 km fun run. The race is part of the ISCAREX running cup and also offers an additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope for the brave. The start is at the ski slope at 11:00, with registration from 10:00 to 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Liboháj Forest Park, with paths and trails
Main race: 6 km (2 × 3 km loops); fun run: 3 km (1 loop)
Additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope
additional: Runner registration is from 10:00 to 10:45. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The additional uphill race on the ski slope is for brave runners. The weather is usually autumnal, and the course may be slippery or icy after overnight rain. The course follows paths and trails in the forest park; a special challenge is the uphill race on the ski slope. Part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025

name: Kružská Kundratická - Memoriál Honzy Šíra
description: Kružská Kundratická - Honza Šír Memorial is a hilly road race in Kruh, Liberec Region. Men run a 12 km course with a turnaround in Kundratice, while women run 5 km, turning around earlier. The race is named in memory of Honza Šír and is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. Contact details for the organizers are available for more information. The race is part of the running community and offers an opportunity to test yourself on a demanding course.
course_highlights: Hilly road course
12 km course for men with a turnaround in Kundratice
5 km course for women with an earlier turnaround
additional: For information about the race, contact Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697). Race information is also available by calling Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697).

name: Přáslavická desítka
location: Přáslavice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Přáslavice Ten is a traditional running race organised by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the village of Přáslavice near Olomouc. The race offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to enjoy a course in the picturesque surroundings of Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the regional running community. The Přáslavice Ten is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje race series and attracts runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque countryside around Přáslavice near Olomouc
Mostly asphalt and forest terrain
Part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje
additional: The race takes place on 21 April 2026 and is part of a series of local runs. The course is mostly on asphalt roads.

name: Běh na Čáp
location: Teplice nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh na Čáp is a public hill running race with a mass start, held in Teplice nad Metují. This traditional race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and gives participants the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain. It is organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hill race with a mass start
Challenging terrain around Teplice nad Metují
Part of the Běžecké vršky series, with a long tradition and history
additional: A hill running race with categories. Registration is available for an entry fee of 50 Kč. The race takes place on terrain with a challenging elevation gain. Results are published regularly, and the race has a long tradition.

name: Forestovo Nočník
location: Záluží u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Forestovo Nočník is a nighttime trail race in Záluží near Plzeň, offering a 5 km course full of fun and challenges. The race takes place in the dark, so a headlamp is mandatory, and the course is marked with reflective elements to ensure safety and create a unique atmosphere. Tea and refreshments are provided for participants after the finish. This race is ideal for fans of night running and trail challenges who want to experience running in an unusual setting with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km nighttime trail course
Course marked with reflective elements
Headlamp mandatory for safe running
additional: Tea and refreshments are provided for runners at the finish. The race is characterized by 100% darkness and 100% fun. The organizers are Jiří Cipra and team. The course is 5 km long, a headlamp is mandatory, the course is marked with reflective elements, refreshments are available at the finish, and the race is intended for various age groups.

name: Slánské běhy
description: Slánské běhy is a traditional orienteering race organized by the Slaný Orienteering Sports Club. The race takes place around the town of Slaný and offers various categories, including a 12 km main category and children’s categories. The race is suitable for the general public and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers provide facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 12 km main category around Slaný
Children’s and youth categories with shorter courses
Facilities provided at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný
additional: The race is traditionally held in November; the most recent edition took place on 29 November 2025. The organizers thank all participants and look forward to the next edition. In the past, around 70 runners took part in the main category, along with several dozen children and young people. The main race is 12 km. Registration takes place at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný, and the races are held on Saturday, 21 November 2026, at 10:00.

name: Vranov Trail
location: Vranov, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Trail is a series of running races organized by friends who run ultratrails and create high-quality events with carefully planned courses, good food, and a relaxed atmosphere. The races take place around Brno and Vranov, often in forests and on trails with carefully marked routes. Each race has its own special feature, such as a winter night run or a spring half marathon symbolizing the balance between day and night. After each race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, adding to the friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: Courses follow forest paths and trails around Brno and Vranov
Routes are clearly marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter night trail with a heated tent and hot drinks
additional: Race facilities are often set up outdoors at the Stará Prádelna or Samovýčep venues. There are plenty of refreshments on the course, including water and sports drinks, and hot food after the finish. After the race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, including mulled wine. Bus travel is recommended, with stops nearby. Parking is limited, and participants should follow the organizers’ instructions. Race bibs are collected at designated times before the start.

name: Loučení s turistickým rokem
location: Krajská organizace Pionýr, Důlce 3092/74, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: 115 km, 64 km, 37 km, 29 km, 16 km, 11 km
description: Loučení s turistickým rokem is a long-distance hike and ultra trail held in Ústí nad Labem, offering several routes of varying lengths from 11 km to 115 km. Routes are marked with KČT hiking signs and, in Germany, Saxon hiking signs, with supplementary reflective-arrow markings where there are no hiking signs. The event is suitable for hiking and ultra-trail enthusiasts who want to end the hiking season with a challenging, well-organized event. The facilities offer overnight accommodation, showers, and luggage storage. There are checkpoints and aid stations with food and drinks along the route.
course_highlights: Routes from 11 km to 115 km, with varying levels of difficulty
Marked with KČT hiking signs and Saxon hiking signs in Germany
Timed checkpoints and aid stations every 20–30 km
additional: Overnight accommodation on the floor in your own sleeping bag is available for 50 Kč per night; showers and luggage storage are also available. Recommended parking is in parking garages in central Ústí nad Labem. A headlamp or flashlight is required for all routes. Participants take part at their own risk and responsibility. The start venue is at the Krajská organizace Pionýr, Důlce 3092/74. Refreshments or restaurants are available approximately every 20–30 km; a headlamp or flashlight is required for all routes. Overnight accommodation in your own sleeping bag is available for 50 Kč per night.

name: GP vytrvalců Kamenného Újezda
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Kamenný Újezd, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The GP of Kamenný Újezd Endurance Runners is a running race held at the football pitch in Kamenný Újezd. The race offers courses of varying lengths, mostly on roads and trails with gentle elevation changes. It is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners looking for an autumn challenge. The event is organized by TJ Sokol Kamenný Újezd, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and good facilities for competitors.
course_highlights: The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
The course runs on roads and mixed terrain with gentle elevation changes
The start and finish are at the football pitch in Kamenný Újezd
additional: The race offers a 6.5 km course. It is organized by TJ Sokol Kamenný Újezd. The race takes place on Saturday, November 21, 2026. The mixed-terrain course is suitable for running in autumn.

name: Běh Komory daňových poradců ČR ... aneb "s daňovým poradcem vás daně nedoběhnou"
description: The courses run around Zamilovaný hájek, partly on paved or dirt-and-gravel paths, or on forest trails. The start is on the meadow in front of the Zamilec bistro. 5 km runners complete one lap; 10 km runners complete two.
additional: Following the very positive response in previous years, we are organizing a race for children again this year. Children can take part on their own or accompanied by a parent. The race is approximately 50 m long for the youngest children and approximately 960 m for older children. The children’s race is for children up to 10 years old. Every child participant will receive a reward. The children’s races have a capacity of 40.

name: BĚHÁMOS - rodinné běžecké závody
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃 BĚHÁMOS – family running races by Holasice Primary and Nursery School
On Sunday, October 4, from 10:00, we’ll get Holasice moving!
Register HERE:
https://forms.gle/duaUcTh2u7ZRpg1v8
BĚHÁMOS is a family running event that brings together what matters to us: children, adults, school, exercise and Holasice. And since we’re a school, our most famous teacher, Jan Amos Komenský, has to be part of it too. That’s where BĚH + ÁMOS = BĚHÁMOS comes from.
We don’t just want to organize a race to see who gets the best times. We want to create a day when children, parents, grandparents, friends and neighbors can all meet in one place. In short, a sports gathering with a family atmosphere.
📅 SUNDAY, 4 OCTOBER 2026
📍 Na Cihelně sports ground, Holasice
https://mapy.com/s/locojejatu
⏱️ Races start from 10:00
📝 Race check-in: 9:00–9:30
🏅 CATEGORIES
AMOS’S LITTLE SPROUTS
born 2021–2023 | 200 m
AMOS’S LITTLE RUNNERS
born 2019–2020 | 250 m
AMOS’S SPEEDSTERS
born 2017–2018 | 500 m
AMOS’S AGILE RUNNERS
born 2015–2016 | 750 m
AMOS’S QUICKSTEPS
born 2013–2014 | 1,400 m
AMOS’S DASHERS
born 2011–2012 | 1,400 m
BĚHÁMOS RUNNERS
born 1592–2010 | 3,200 m
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 AMOS’S FAMILY RELAY
4 × 250 m | 2 adults + 2 children under 14.9 years old
To finish, we’ll join forces in Amos’s family relay. And “family” doesn’t mean you have to show a birth certificate when you register. 😊
Each four-person team simply consists of two adults and two children. Parents can run with their children, a mom with an uncle, two dads, two moms, or even two families who are friends. You don’t have to be related—the important thing is to put together a team of 2 + 2 and BĚHÁMOS!
📝 REGISTRATION
Runners can register online until 2 October here: https://forms.gle/duaUcTh2u7ZRpg1v8
or on race day at the venue (cash only).
Race check-in will take place on race day from 9:00 to 9:30.
👧 Children – FREE
👨 Adults – 100 Kč
🏆 WHAT’S IN STORE?
Medals and prizes will be provided for runners. Refreshments, facilities and portable toilets will also be available.
Above all, though, we want to enjoy a pleasant morning of sport where the most important thing isn’t who finishes first, but that we BĚHÁMOS together.
⚠️ PARTICIPATION AND RESPONSIBILITY
Each runner takes part in the race voluntarily and at their own responsibility and risk. By registering, they confirm that they are medically fit to complete the chosen course. The legal guardian is responsible for the health and safety of any underage runner.
Runners must follow the organizers’ instructions and behave in a way that does not endanger themselves or other participants.
🏫 ORGANIZERS
Holasice Primary School and the Municipality of Holasice
📧 Contact: behamos@seznam.cz
So, who’s going to BĚHÁMOS with us? 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️

images.alt_text: Propagační leták rodinného běžeckého závodu BĚHÁMOS s datem a místem konání

name: Běh o pohár Jehnic
location: Základní škola Jehnice, Brno, Czech Republic
organizer: VSK Univerzita Brno – oddíl atletiky, Atletika UNI CZ s.r.o., ZŠ v Jehnicích, Fakulta sportovních studií MU a ÚMČ Brno-Jehnice
description: The Jehnice Cup Run is part of the 27th edition of the Brno Running Cup, which comprises eleven races in the Brno area. The race takes place at the Jehnice Primary School and offers courses for various age groups, from the youngest runners to adults. The event is open to the general public and is supported by the Statutory City of Brno. Runners can expect a friendly atmosphere, good organization, and the opportunity to score points in the series.
course_highlights: Courses for the youngest runners, children, youth, and adults, with distances of 1, 1.5, 5, and 10 km
Start and registration at Jehnice Primary School
Drinking water is provided; BBP reusable cups are available to borrow
additional: Registration closes 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is open to the public without restrictions. Youth and junior runners may enter the 10 km race and score points in the older category. Drinking water is provided only for runners using their own cups, or they can borrow a BBP reusable cup for a 20 Kč deposit. The race takes place at Jehnice Primary School and is part of the Brno Running Cup. A championship for students and teachers of Brno’s universities is also listed.

name: Podzimní cross – Běh 17. listopadu
location: Fotbalové hřiště, Bořice, Pardubice District, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký oddíl Vejvanovice – TJ Sokol Bořice
description: The Autumn Cross-Country – 17 November Run is a traditional trail race through the Dvakačovice-Podborský Forest near Bořice. The race offers two options: a short 5 km race (1 lap) and a long 10 km race (2 laps), with 110 metres of elevation gain per lap. The course follows forest roads and trails, making for an enjoyable cross-country experience. The event also includes children’s races, and traditional refreshments and prizes for the winners are provided at the finish. It is organized by Běžecký oddíl Vejvanovice - TJ Sokol Bořice.
course_highlights: The course follows forest roads and trails
110 m of elevation gain per lap
Each lap is 5 km; the short race is 1 lap and the long race is 2 laps
additional: The event includes children’s races. Traditional refreshments and prizes for the winners are provided at the finish. The start and finish are at the football pitch in Podboři - Bořice. According to the organizers, registration opens at 9:00 and the race program starts at 10:00.

name: Lysacup – Visalaje, parkoviště
location: Parkoviště ve Visalajích, Visalaje, Staré Hamry, Czech Republic
description: Lysacup is a winter stage running series in the Beskydy Mountains, held mostly on Lysá hora. Each weekend, a stage starts from a different location, and both individuals and teams compete. The start is usually at 10:00, and participants use chips activated for the entire season with a voluntary contribution. The race offers the atmosphere of a traditional mountain run, with the option to take part as a walker too. The overall winner receives a perpetual trophy, and the race is supported by a number of partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: Winter stage race on mountainous terrain in the Beskydy Mountains
Each stage starts from a different location, usually on Lysá hora (1323 m above sea level)
Mountain-running atmosphere with scoring for individuals and teams
additional: The start is usually at 10:00. Participants must have a chip activated for the entire season, which is obtained by sending a voluntary contribution. Chips can also be bought from other competitors or the organizers. If there are many competitors, the organizers reserve the right to adjust the scoring. The two worst stages are discarded from the overall standings, one from each half of the series. It is also possible to take part as a walker, with an assigned number of points. The overall winner and the best teams receive perpetual trophies. The organizers provide refreshments and prizes from sponsors.
